The replies split into two camps: those lower than yours, who make you question your life; and those higher, who instantly make you feel okay.
Conclusion: we're not asking about the bill. We're looking for someone to be wounded by the power company alongside us.
en.editorNote: For the friend who just posted 'is this normal?' online and is now refreshing the replies
variations: 'Is this normal?' was never a question about the number — it's a request for collective comfort.
The most healing thing in summer is seeing someone whose bill is even higher than mine.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價上路 帳單變貴真相 不是漲價是你用更多 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電出面解釋：「帳單變貴，不全是漲價，是你夏天用得更多。」
這句話聽起來像安慰，其實是補刀。
意思是：貴的不是電價，是我那顆一熱就想開冷氣、一開就不想關的軟弱意志。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到帳單想罵台電、結果被官方說「是你自己用太多」的朋友
variations: 台電：「不是我們漲價，是你變了。」這句話用在感情上也通。
原來最貴的不是夏月電價，是我對涼快的依賴。

en.content:
The power company steps out to explain: 'Your bill went up not just from the rate hike — you simply use more in summer.'
It sounds like reassurance. It's actually a second stab.
Translation: the expensive thing isn't the rate. It's my weak-willed heart that craves the AC the moment it's hot, and refuses to turn it off once it's on.
en.editorNote: For the friend who wanted to curse the power company over the bill, only to be told 'you just used too much'
variations: Power company: 'We didn't raise the price — you changed.' Works for breakups too.
Turns out the priciest thing isn't the summer rate. It's my dependence on being cool.

items.sourceNote: 用電超過 331 度 夏季單價漲幅顯著 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天用電的人生分水嶺，叫做 331 度。
超過那條線，每一度都變貴，所以月底我會像在玩拆彈遊戲，盯著電表小心翼翼地過日子。
「今天還能開冷氣嗎？」「再開兩小時會不會引爆？」
我這輩子最緊張的數學題，原來是我家電表。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個月底會每天看電表、把開冷氣當成限時挑戰的精算型室友
variations: 331 度，是台電在你夏天人生裡埋的一條地雷，踩到就漲價。
月底盯電表的緊張感，比期末考還真實，因為這次真的會扣到錢。

en.content:
The great summer dividing line is 331 kWh.
Cross it and every unit gets pricier, so by month's end I'm playing a bomb-defusal game, tiptoeing through life with one eye on the meter.
'Can I still run the AC today?' 'Will two more hours detonate it?'
The most nerve-wracking math problem of my life turns out to be my own electric meter.
en.editorNote: For the spreadsheet-minded roommate who checks the meter daily and treats running the AC like a timed challenge
variations: 331 kWh is the landmine the power company buried in your summer — step on it and the rate jumps.
Watching the meter at month's end is more tense than finals, because this time you actually lose money.

items.sourceNote: 住宅電費平均月增 446 元 其中 326 元來自用電量增加 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞解釋：「電費月增 446 元，其中 326 元是你冷氣開太久，只有 120 元是電價漲。」
我：「所以你的意思是，這筆錢主要不是台電的錯，是我的錯。」
台電：「我們從沒這樣說，但你說得很對。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年都怪台電漲價、但其實是自己捨不得關冷氣的朋友
variations: 原來電費變貴，七成是我自己手賤一直按開機，三成才是電價。
夏天最殘忍的真相：帳單上的數字，大部分是你自己親手養大的。

en.content:
News explains: 'Your bill rose by 446 — but 326 of that is you running the AC longer, only 120 is the rate hike.'
Me: 'So you're saying this is mostly not the power company's fault, it's mine.'
Power company: 'We never said that, but you're absolutely right.'
en.editorNote: For the friend who blames the utility every year when it's really their own refusal to hit the off button
variations: Turns out 70% of my pricier bill is my own twitchy finger hitting 'on', and only 30% is the rate.
The cruelest summer truth: most of the number on that bill is something you raised by hand.

items.sourceNote: standing directly in front of the AC vent meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
下班回到家的第一件事，不是放包包，不是喝水，
是站在冷氣出風口正下方，把上衣領口拉開，讓冷風灌進去，閉上眼睛，像在做某種神聖的儀式。
那十秒鐘，是我這天唯一覺得有付電費值得的時刻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一回家就衝去冷氣出風口下面站著充電的朋友
variations: 冷氣出風口下面那塊地板，是我家風水最好的位置。
夏天的幸福很簡單：出風口、領口、十秒鐘，剩下的我自己想辦法。

en.content:
First thing I do walking in after work isn't dropping my bag or grabbing water —
it's standing directly under the AC vent, pulling my collar open, letting the cold pour in, eyes closed, like some sacred ritual.
Those ten seconds are the only moment all day the electric bill feels worth it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who sprints to the vent to recharge the second they get home
variations: The patch of floor under the AC vent is the best real estate in my entire apartment.
Summer happiness is simple: a vent, an open collar, ten seconds. I'll figure out the rest myself.

items.sourceNote: 變頻冷氣不關更省 是迷思 累進電價跟時段無關 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我一直相信「變頻冷氣別關比較省」，直到看到專家說：累進電價只看你總共用幾度，跟你什麼時候開、關不關沒關係。
等於我這三年來那套精心設計的「不關冷氣省電法」，
從頭到尾都只是我替自己亂吹冷氣找的高級藉口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個堅持冷氣 24 小時不關、還理直氣壯說「這樣才省」的室友
variations: 我以為我在省電，其實我只是發明了一個聽起來很科學的浪費理由。
變頻冷氣最省電的開法，是把那套「不關比較省」的信仰先關掉。

en.content:
I spent years believing 'never turn off an inverter AC, it saves more' — until an expert pointed out: tiered billing only counts total units used, not when you run it or whether you switch it off.
Which means my carefully engineered 'never-turn-it-off savings method' of the last three years
was, from start to finish, just a fancy excuse I invented for cranking the AC.
en.editorNote: For the roommate who insists on running the AC 24/7 and swears it's the frugal choice
variations: I thought I was saving power. I'd actually invented a scientific-sounding excuse to waste it.
The most energy-efficient way to run an inverter AC is to first switch off the belief that 'never off saves more'.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價上路 帳單變貴真相 冷氣設 26 度 循環扇 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電：「冷氣 26 度搭循環扇，冷房更快更省。」
我買了循環扇。
現在我房間有冷氣的涼、循環扇的風、還有我看著兩張發票時的冷汗。
三股氣流，完美交織。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了省電而瘋狂加購各種小家電、結果愈買愈花錢的朋友
variations: 省電神器的共通點：買的時候很省，加進電費才知道不省。
循環扇真的有讓房間更涼，涼到我都忘了它也是要插電的。

en.content:
Power company: 'Set the AC to 78°F and add a circulator fan — faster cooling, more savings.'
So I bought a circulator fan.
Now my room has the AC's chill, the fan's breeze, and a cold sweat from staring at two receipts.
Three air currents, perfectly intertwined.
en.editorNote: For the friend who keeps buying gadgets to save power and somehow spends more each time
variations: Every 'energy-saving gadget' shares one trait: cheap to buy, not so cheap once it joins the bill.
The circulator fan really did cool the room down — so much I forgot it also needs to be plugged in.

items.sourceNote: complaining about heat then freezing when AC finally works meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
白天的我：「熱死了，誰受得了，我願意付任何電費換一點涼。」
冷氣開了二十分鐘後的我：「有點冷欸，把溫度調高一點好了，順便省電。」
人類的記性，永遠撐不過一台冷氣的暖機時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個前一秒喊熱、下一秒就喊冷去拿外套的善變朋友
variations: 我對熱的承諾，總是在冷氣生效的那一刻被我自己背叛。
夏天最大的矛盾，是熱的時候願意賣腎，涼的時候捨不得那幾塊電費。

en.content:
Daytime me: 'It's unbearable, I'd pay any electric bill for a little cool air.'
Me twenty minutes after the AC kicks in: 'Kind of chilly actually, let me bump the temp up — saves power too.'
Human memory never outlasts an AC's warm-up time.
en.editorNote: For the fickle friend who screams it's hot one second and grabs a sweater the next
variations: Every promise I make while hot gets betrayed by me the moment the AC starts working.
Summer's biggest contradiction: I'd sell a kidney when it's hot, then begrudge a few cents of power once it's cool.

items.sourceNote: 「電費太高可能要把房子賣了」meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這個月的電費單寄到，我認真坐下來算了一下：
與其每個月被冷氣電費凌遲，不如直接把房子賣掉，搬去百貨公司住。
至少那裡的冷氣，不用我付。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拆完帳單後說「乾脆搬去 IKEA 樣品屋住」的朋友
variations: 我家最值錢的資產不是房子，是房子裡那台願意為我運轉的冷氣。
夏天的人生規劃：賣房，退租，搬進一個別人付電費的地方。

en.content:
This month's bill landed, and I sat down to do the math seriously:
instead of getting tortured by the AC bill every month, I might as well sell the house and move into a department store.
At least their AC isn't on my dime.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who, after opening the bill, declares they're moving into an IKEA showroom
variations: The most valuable asset in my home isn't the house — it's the AC willing to run for me.
Summer life plan: sell the house, break the lease, move somewhere someone else pays the power.

items.sourceNote: 站在冷氣出風口前 享受 meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
冷氣剛打開的前三分鐘，我會站在出風口正下方，閉上眼睛，雙手張開。
那不是在吹冷氣，那是一場儀式——
我在用全身，迎接今晚這幾度電的恩賜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個冷氣一開就立刻衝去站在出風口下的朋友，他在領聖體
variations: 出風口正下方那個位置，是我家夏天唯一的 VIP 席。
冷氣出風口之於夏天，等同暖爐之於冬天——人類永遠在追著溫度跑。

en.content:
For the first three minutes after the AC turns on, I stand directly under the vent, eyes closed, arms wide open.
That's not cooling off. That's a ceremony —
my whole body receiving the blessing of tonight's few units of power.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who sprints to stand under the vent the second the AC kicks on — they're taking communion
variations: The spot directly under the vent is the only VIP seat in my house all summer.
The AC vent is to summer what the heater is to winter — humans forever chasing a temperature.

items.sourceNote: 舒眠模式 半夜被熱醒 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
睡覺開舒眠模式，據說可以省電。
它的運作原理是：每隔一小時悄悄把溫度調高一度，溫柔到你不會發現。
直到凌晨四點，你在一灘汗裡醒來，才懂什麼叫做「被自己的省電設定背叛」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個堅持開舒眠模式、然後每天清晨四點準時被熱醒的朋友
variations: 舒眠模式的「舒」，是舒服的舒，也是它舒舒服服把溫度調高的舒。
省電與好眠，夏天的我永遠只能選一個，而我每次都選錯。

en.content:
Sleep mode on the AC supposedly saves power.
Here's how it works: every hour it quietly nudges the temperature up one degree, so gently you never notice.
Until 4 AM, when you wake up in a puddle of sweat and finally understand what it means to be betrayed by your own energy-saving setting.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who insists on sleep mode and wakes up drenched at 4 AM like clockwork
variations: Sleep mode lets the AC sleep comfortably while it cranks the temperature up — you're the one who doesn't.
Saving power or sleeping well: summer me can only pick one, and I pick wrong every single night.

items.sourceNote: 為什麼夏天電費貴 尖峰供電成本 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電說：「夏天大家都開冷氣，供電成本高，所以電價才貴。」
我聽完默默點頭，覺得很有道理。
然後我看了一下我的薪水，發現它沒有因為「大家夏天都很需要錢」而跟著漲。
供需法則，原來只對台電有效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個聽完台電解釋後，理性上認同、情感上想哭的朋友
variations: 夏天什麼都因為「需求高」而漲價，只有我的薪水堅持走計畫經濟。
我完全理解夏天電價為什麼貴，理解到一邊流淚一邊繳費。

en.content:
The power company explains: 'Everyone runs the AC in summer, supply costs spike, so rates go up.'
I nod along quietly. Makes total sense.
Then I check my salary and notice it didn't rise just because 'everyone needs money more in summer.'
Turns out the law of supply and demand only applies to the power company.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who rationally agrees with the utility's explanation while emotionally wanting to cry
variations: Everything in summer goes up because 'demand is high' — only my salary insists on a planned economy.
I fully understand why summer rates are high. I understand it while paying the bill in tears.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣是人類最偉大發明 熱浪求生 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
熱浪來襲的這幾天，我終於想通了一件事：
人類史上最偉大的發明，不是火、不是輪子、不是網路，
是冷氣。
火讓我們活下來，冷氣讓我們在夏天「願意」活下來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在熱浪特報那天，對著冷氣外機默默感謝的朋友
variations: 我可以三天不出門，但不能三小時沒冷氣，這是我這個夏天認清的底線。
發明冷氣的人應該被立銅像，立在一個有冷氣的室內。

en.content:
After these few days of heatwave, I've finally figured something out:
the greatest invention in human history isn't fire, isn't the wheel, isn't the internet —
it's air conditioning.
Fire let us survive. AC is what makes us willing to survive summer.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who silently thanks the AC compressor on the day of a heat advisory
variations: I can go three days without leaving home, but not three hours without AC — that's the line I drew this summer.
Whoever invented air conditioning deserves a bronze statue, erected somewhere indoors with the AC on.

items.sourceNote: 近 98% 用戶累進計費 離峰用電不會比較省 商周 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我以為半夜用電比較便宜，於是把所有家事都排到凌晨。
查了才知道：全台快 98% 的人是累進計費，用多少算多少，跟幾點用一點關係都沒有。
也就是說，我熬的那些夜，純屬贈送給黑眼圈。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個堅信「半夜洗澡比較省」、然後把生理時鐘搞壞的朋友
variations: 離峰電價的第一課：先確認你到底有沒有申請時間電價，不然你只是在半夜感動自己。
沒申請時間電價的人熬夜省電，就像沒買票的人排隊入場——很努力，但方向錯了。

en.content:
I assumed electricity was cheaper at night, so I shoved every chore to 2 AM.
Then I looked it up: nearly 98% of us are on tiered billing — you pay for how much, not when.
Which means all those late nights? A free gift, straight to my under-eye bags.
en.editorNote: For the friend who swears showering at midnight is cheaper and wrecked their sleep schedule for it
variations: Off-peak lesson one: check whether you actually signed up for time-of-use rates, or you're just moving your life to 2 AM for feelings.
Saving power at night without a time-of-use plan is like queueing without a ticket — great effort, wrong direction.

items.sourceNote: 夏天冷氣電費高到要賣房 迷因 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這個夏天冷氣的電費高到一個境界，
讓我認真考慮把房子賣了。
這樣就不用付電費了。
畢竟沒有房子，就沒有冷氣；沒有冷氣，就沒有帳單——
完美的解法，只可惜我住的是租的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到帳單當下真的把房仲網打開來看的朋友，純屬情緒發洩
variations: 解決電費最快的方法：把有冷氣的那個空間整個賣掉，包含裡面那個怕熱的自己。
夏天的電費，是唯一能讓人認真思考「無殼蝸牛其實比較省」的東西。

en.content:
This summer's AC bill got so high
I seriously considered selling my house.
Then I wouldn't have to pay for electricity.
No house, no AC; no AC, no bill —
flawless plan, shame I'm renting.
en.editorNote: For the friend who genuinely opened a real-estate app the moment the bill landed — pure venting
variations: Fastest fix for the electric bill: sell the entire air-conditioned space, including the heat-averse person inside it.
The summer bill is the only thing that makes 'being homeless is actually cheaper' feel like a real thought.

items.sourceNote: 網傳夏月三段式電價一度 8.12 元 不實資訊 家庭仍累進 MyGoPen register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
家族群組又轉發了：「夏月電價分三段，最高一度 8.12 元，快關冷氣！」
我查了一下，是假的，家庭用電還是照舊累進計費。
我鬆了一口氣，然後看了看真正的帳單——
發現其實不管真的假的，我都一樣繳不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年都會被「電價爆漲圖表」嚇到、然後叫全家關冷氣的長輩
variations: 電費謠言最厲害的地方，是就算被闢謠了，你看真實帳單還是會心痛。
夏天的謠言和夏天的帳單，都會讓你血壓升高，差別只在一個能查證。

en.content:
The family chat forwarded it again: 'Summer rates now have three tiers, up to eight bucks a unit, turn off the AC now!'
I checked — it's fake, household billing is still the usual tiered rate.
I breathed a sigh of relief, then looked at the actual bill —
and realized that real or fake, I can't pay it either way.
en.editorNote: For the relative who panics at a 'rates are exploding' chart every year and orders the whole house to kill the AC
variations: The scary thing about electricity rumors is that even after they're debunked, the real bill still hurts.
Summer rumors and summer bills both spike your blood pressure — the only difference is one can be fact-checked.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣是夏天的超級英雄 沒有披風但有恆溫器 meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
每個夏天都有一位默默守護我的英雄。
它沒有披風，只有一片濾網；
它不會飛，只會掛在牆上嗡嗡作響；
它拯救不了世界，但它每天下班後，都準時把我從一灘汗裡救出來。
它要的回報也很簡單——只要我的整份薪水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把冷氣當成命中注定的那位朋友，配一張冷氣的照片
variations: 冷氣是夏天唯一沒有請假、沒有擺爛、還願意每天上工的員工，可惜薪水是我在付。
披風是給拯救世界的英雄，恆溫器是給拯救我這個夏天的英雄。

en.editorNote: For the friend who treats the AC like destiny — pair with a photo of the unit
variations: The AC is the only employee who never calls in sick, never slacks, and shows up every day — shame I'm the one paying its salary.
Capes are for heroes who save the world. A thermostat is for the hero who saved my summer.

items.sourceNote: 節電獎勵需上網登錄電號 每省一度 0.6 元 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了領節電獎勵金，我打開台電官網，準備登錄。
第一步：輸入你的電號。
我：「……電號是什麼？在哪裡？」
找電號找了二十分鐘，冷氣也吹了二十分鐘。
領獎勵金的第一關，就先把獎勵金花掉了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年都想領節電獎勵、卻永遠卡在「找不到電號」這關的朋友
variations: 節電獎勵金設計得很有智慧：它需要你先花時間、花電費，才能拿到那 0.6 元。
台電：「每省一度回饋 0.6 元。」我：「好，那我先花半小時找電號，這半小時的冷氣算誰的？」

en.content:
To claim the energy-saving rebate, I open the utility website, ready to register.
Step one: enter your electricity account number.
Me: '…what's an account number? Where is it?'
Twenty minutes hunting for it, twenty minutes of AC running.
Level one of claiming the rebate: spend the rebate first.
en.editorNote: For the friend who wants the rebate every year but is forever stuck at 'can't find the account number'
variations: The rebate is cleverly designed: it makes you spend time and electricity before you can collect that 60 cents.
Utility: 'We pay you 60 cents per unit saved.' Me: 'Great, let me burn half an hour of AC finding my account number first.'

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價 6-9 月共四個月 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人問我為什麼夏天過得特別慢。
我說：因為夏月電價是六月到九月，整整四個月。
別人在數暑假還剩幾天，我在數帳單還要來幾張。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個七月才過一半、就已經在期待九月底的朋友
variations: 夏天的長度，官方認定是四個月，我的錢包認定是四張帳單。
別人的夏天用天氣計算，我的夏天用電費級距計算。

en.content:
Someone asked why summer feels so much longer to me.
I said: because summer rates run June through September — four whole months.
Others count how many vacation days are left. I count how many bills are still coming.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's only halfway through July and already longing for late September
variations: Officially summer is four months long. According to my wallet, it's four bills long.
Other people measure summer in weather. I measure it in billing tiers.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣 26-28 度搭電風扇 官方省電建議 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電的省電公式：冷氣 28 度，加一台電風扇。
我的執行版本：冷氣 28 度，加一台電風扇，加把風扇對著自己，加把自己貼在風扇前，加放棄站起來拿水喝。
省電到最後，我活得像一株需要固定日照的盆栽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個坐在電風扇正前方一整個下午不敢移動的朋友
variations: 省電的最高境界，是讓自己變成一個不太需要移動的家電。
28 度加電風扇能不能涼，取決於你願不願意整個下午都不站起來。

en.content:
The utility's saving formula: AC at 82°F, plus one fan.
My version: AC at 82°F, plus a fan, plus aiming the fan at myself, plus gluing myself to the fan, plus giving up on standing to get water.
By the end of saving energy, I live like a potted plant that needs steady exposure to airflow.
en.editorNote: For the friend who sits directly in front of the fan all afternoon, afraid to move
variations: Peak energy-saving is turning yourself into an appliance that barely needs to move.
Whether 82°F plus a fan feels cool depends entirely on whether you'll stay seated all afternoon.

items.sourceNote: 變頻冷氣不關更省 台電認證關鍵時間 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
查了一整晚：變頻冷氣到底該不該關？
答案是：出門三小時內別關，超過三小時就關。
於是現在我出門前，都要先算好行程幾小時，精準到分鐘。
以前出門想的是要去哪，現在想的是這樣算不算超過三小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個出門前會認真計算回家時間、就為了決定冷氣開關的精算魂朋友
variations: 變頻冷氣把「要不要關」變成一道需要行程表的申論題。
三小時的分界線，讓我出門買個午餐都像在做財務規劃。

en.content:
Spent all night researching: should you turn off an inverter AC or not?
The answer: leave it on for trips under three hours, switch it off for anything longer.
So now before leaving, I calculate my itinerary down to the minute.
I used to think about where I was going. Now I think about whether this counts as over three hours.
en.editorNote: For the analytical friend who plans their return time to the minute just to decide the AC
variations: Inverter AC turns 'off or on' into an essay question that requires a schedule.
The three-hour threshold makes grabbing lunch feel like financial planning.

items.sourceNote: AC humanity's greatest invention meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
人類史上最偉大的發明排名：
第三名，火。
第二名，網路。
第一名，冷氣。
唯一的缺點是，前兩名發明完就免費用了，只有第一名，每個月都要重新付費解鎖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一進冷氣房就發自內心說「發明冷氣的人是天才」的朋友
variations: 冷氣是人類最偉大的發明，也是唯一一個每個月要續訂的發明。
感謝發明冷氣的人，也詛咒發明夏月電價的人，這兩種情緒每天在我心裡打架。

en.content:
Ranking humanity's greatest inventions:
Third place: fire.
Second place: the internet.
First place: air conditioning.
Its only flaw is that the first two came free after invention — only number one has to be re-unlocked with a payment every single month.
en.editorNote: For the friend who walks into a cold room and sincerely declares 'whoever invented AC was a genius'
variations: AC is humanity's greatest invention — and the only one that requires a monthly subscription.
I bless whoever invented the AC and curse whoever invented summer rates; the two feelings fight in me daily.

items.sourceNote: sleeping under blanket with AC blasting heatwave meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天睡覺的標準流程：
冷氣開 24 度，蓋一條薄被，睡到半夜冷醒，把被子拉高，繼續睡。
明明只要把冷氣調到 27 度就能解決，但那需要我起身、清醒、面對現實——太難了，不如繼續多付那幾塊錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個寧願半夜多蓋被子、也不願起來調高冷氣的懶人朋友
variations: 調高一度冷氣要起身，多蓋一條被子只要伸手，人性會選哪個很明顯。
我不是喜歡浪費電，我只是半夜三點沒有力氣跟遙控器搏鬥。

en.content:
Standard summer sleep routine:
AC at 75°F, one thin blanket, wake up cold at 2 AM, pull the blanket higher, go back to sleep.
Raising the AC to 80°F would fix it entirely, but that requires getting up, being awake, and facing reality — too hard. Easier to just pay the extra few bucks.
en.editorNote: For the lazy friend who'd rather pile on blankets at 2 AM than get up to raise the AC
variations: Raising the AC means standing up; grabbing another blanket means reaching out. It's obvious which one human nature picks.
I don't love wasting electricity. I just have no strength to wrestle the remote at 3 AM.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
六月的電費帳單來的時候，我的第一反應是懷疑台電打錯了。
第二反應是拿去跟上個月比對，確認自己沒有幻覺。
第三反應是默默把冷氣調高一度，然後五分鐘後又調回來——反正都繳了，不差這一晚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次收到夏季電費帳單就想裝死的朋友
variations: 夏天最恐怖的不是熱，是月底那張讓人瞬間清醒的電費帳單。
電費帳單教會我的事：省電要趁月初，月底才後悔已經來不及了。

en.content:
When the June electric bill arrives, my first reaction is to assume the power company made a mistake.
My second reaction is to compare it with last month, just to confirm I'm not hallucinating.
My third reaction is to quietly bump the AC up one degree — then turn it back down five minutes later. I already paid for it, one more night won't hurt.
en.editorNote: For the friend who wants to play dead every time the summer electric bill shows up
variations: The scariest part of summer isn't the heat. It's the end-of-month electric bill that snaps you wide awake.
What the electric bill taught me: save power early in the month, because regret at month's end is too late.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我家夏天的權力鬥爭，全在那台冷氣遙控器上。
我覺得 26 度剛好，我媽覺得會冷，我爸覺得浪費電，我妹覺得根本沒開。
最後的結果通常是：溫度設 28 度，然後每個人都偷偷去別的房間吹自己的電風扇。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個家裡永遠喬不攏冷氣溫度的家庭群組
variations: 一家人對冷氣溫度的容忍度，比對彼此的容忍度還難調和。
冷氣遙控器是我家唯一需要聯合國調停的物品。

en.content:
The power struggle in my house every summer comes down to one thing: the AC remote.
I think 79°F is perfect, Mom thinks it's freezing, Dad thinks it's a waste of money, and my sister swears it isn't even on.
The usual outcome: we set it to 82°F, and then everyone sneaks off to their own room to run their own fan.
en.editorNote: For the family group chat that can never agree on a thermostat setting
variations: A family's tolerance for AC temperatures is even harder to reconcile than their tolerance for each other.
The AC remote is the one object in my house that requires UN mediation.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
夏天的辦公室是全世界最矛盾的地方。
外面 36 度，裡面 22 度，我進門前脫外套，坐下五分鐘後又穿回去。
穿短袖進公司、包著外套辦公、再脫掉外套走出去曬太陽——一天之內經歷四季，這就是上班族的養生之道。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在辦公室冷氣下永遠要多帶一件外套的同事
variations: 辦公室冷氣的存在意義，就是讓你在盛夏也需要一件羽絨背心。
外面熱到融化，公司冷到結冰，我的免疫系統每天都在打仗。

en.content:
The summer office is the most contradictory place on Earth.
It's 97°F outside and 72°F inside. I take my jacket off walking in, then put it back on five minutes after sitting down.
Show up in a T-shirt, work wrapped in a jacket, peel it off again to go soak up the sun — four seasons in one day. That's the office worker's version of wellness.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who always keeps an extra jacket under the office AC
variations: The whole point of office AC is making you need a puffer vest in the middle of summer.
Melting outside, freezing inside — my immune system fights a war every single day.

items.sourceNote: electric bill so high might sell the house meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這個月的電費帳單一打開，我認真思考了一下：
是要繼續吹冷氣，還是把房子賣了去付這張帳單。
最後我決定兩個都不要——把帳單摺起來，假裝它還沒寄到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拆開帳單後在群組傳「我完蛋了」的朋友，讓他知道他不孤單
variations: 電費貴到我開始研究，賣掉冷氣是不是比繳電費划算。
帳單金額大到一個程度，你就不會心痛了，只會發笑。

en.content:
The moment I opened this month's electric bill, I seriously weighed my options:
keep running the AC, or sell the house to pay off the bill.
In the end I chose neither — I folded the bill up and pretended it hadn't arrived yet.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who posts 'I'm done for' in the group chat after opening the bill
variations: The bill got so expensive I started calculating whether selling the AC beats paying for it.
Past a certain dollar amount, the bill stops hurting and just becomes funny.

items.sourceNote: 夏月三段式電價 8.12 元 假圖 闢謠 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
家族群組又轉來一張圖：「夏月三段式電價，最高一度 8.12 元！」
我查證後回：「這是假的，一般家庭是累進電價，沒有這種東西。」
三秒後長輩已讀，然後轉發下一則：「冷氣加一顆冰塊省一半電費」。
闢謠的速度，永遠追不上轉發的手速。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每天在家族群組默默當事實查核員的你，辛苦了
variations: 電費的謠言比電費本身還會漲，而且完全免費。
在家族群組闢謠，是一份沒有薪水、也沒有盡頭的工作。

en.content:
The family chat forwarded another image: 'New summer three-tier rate — up to 27 cents per unit!'
I fact-checked it and replied: 'This is fake. Households are billed on progressive tiers, no such thing exists.'
Three seconds later the elders read it, then forwarded the next one: 'Put an ice cube by your AC and cut your bill in half.'
The speed of debunking never catches up to the speed of forwarding.
en.editorNote: For the one who quietly serves as the family chat's fact-checker every day — we salute you
variations: The rumors about electricity rise faster than the rates themselves, and they're completely free.
Debunking hoaxes in the family chat is an unpaid job with no end in sight.

items.sourceNote: 多數家庭累進電價 與時段無關 迷思 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我為了省電，每天堅持半夜兩點才洗衣服。
撐了一個月，帳單來了，跟上個月一模一樣。
這時我才知道：我家用的是累進電價，跟幾點洗根本沒關係。
我犧牲的那一個月睡眠，是免費送給世界的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個信了「離峰便宜」半夜爬起來用電的朋友，先講清楚電價種類再說
variations: 省電迷思最貴的地方，是你為它付出的睡眠沒有退費機制。
凌晨洗衣服省電這件事，只對裝了時間電價的人有效，可惜那不是我。

en.content:
To save on electricity, I insisted on doing laundry at 2 AM every night.
I kept it up for a month, the bill came, and it was identical to last month's.
That's when I learned: my house is on progressive tiered billing — the time of day makes zero difference.
That month of lost sleep was a free gift to the universe.
en.editorNote: For the friend who bought into 'off-peak is cheaper' and set a midnight alarm — check your rate plan first
variations: The most expensive part of an energy-saving myth is the sleep you spend on it, non-refundable.
The 2 AM laundry trick only works if you're on a time-of-use plan. Sadly, I'm not.

items.sourceNote: AC is the season's superhero meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天真正的超級英雄，不會飛，也不會噴火。
它掛在牆上，不聲不響，每天默默拯救全家人的理智，唯一的弱點是——月底那張帳單就是它的氪石。
我一邊感謝它，一邊看著它慢慢掏空我的錢包。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一走進冷氣房就大喊「活過來了」的朋友，配一張冷氣照片
variations: 冷氣是夏天唯一按月收保護費的英雄。
牆上那台冷氣，是我家最沉默、也最花錢的守護神。

en.content:
The real superhero of summer doesn't fly or breathe fire.
It hangs on the wall, silent, quietly saving the whole family's sanity every day. Its only weakness — the end-of-month bill is its kryptonite.
I thank it while watching it slowly empty my wallet.
en.editorNote: For the friend who shouts 'I'm alive again' the second they walk into an air-conditioned room
variations: AC is the only summer superhero that charges a monthly protection fee.
That unit on the wall is my home's most silent — and most expensive — guardian.

items.sourceNote: 節電獎勵金 每省一度 0.6 元 報名 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我認真報名了節電獎勵，每省一度回饋 0.6 元。
為了多拿那 0.6 元，我少吹一小時冷氣，結果熱到跑去便利商店買了一杯 65 元的冰咖啡。
所以我用 65 元的代價，成功賺回了 0.6 元。
這筆帳，台電看了都想幫我算清楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了節電獎勵金拚命省、卻在別的地方花更多的省錢戰友
variations: 0.6 元的獎勵金，是用來提醒你省電這條路，成本遠遠不只 0.6 元。
節電獎勵最療癒的地方，是讓你覺得自己在賺錢，而不是在受苦。

en.content:
I dutifully signed up for the energy-saving rebate: 60 cents back for every unit saved.
To earn that extra 60 cents, I skipped an hour of AC, got so hot I ran to the convenience store, and bought a $2 iced coffee.
So I spent two dollars to successfully earn back sixty cents.
Even the power company would want to sit me down and do the math.
en.editorNote: For the savings warrior who scrimps on power but spends more everywhere else
variations: The 60-cent rebate exists to remind you that saving power costs a whole lot more than 60 cents.
The most soothing part of the rebate is that it makes you feel like you're earning, not suffering.

items.sourceNote: MyGoPen 闢謠 夏月三段式電價一度 8.12 元不實圖表 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
家族群組轉來一張圖：「夏天電費一度飆到 8.12 元，快關冷氣！」
查證後發現是假的，一般家庭根本不是這樣算。
但我還是關了冷氣——不是因為信，是因為那 8.12 元，剛好戳中我心裡最不敢面對的數字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次在群組轉發嚇人電費圖、卻從不查證的長輩，順便附上闢謠連結
variations: 電費謠言最可怕的地方，不是它是假的，是它讓你瞬間相信自己真的付得起才怪。
假的電價圖能在群組傳一萬次，靠的不是數字，是我們每個人心底那份對帳單的恐懼。

en.content:
Someone forwarded a chart to the family chat: 'Summer electricity is now 27 cents a unit — turn off the AC!'
Turned out it was fake; that's not how a normal household is billed at all.
But I switched off the AC anyway — not because I believed it, but because that fake number poked the exact figure I've been afraid to look at.
en.editorNote: Send to the relative who forwards scary utility-bill graphics without ever fact-checking — attach the debunk link
variations: The scariest thing about a bill rumor isn't that it's false — it's how instantly you believe you can't afford it.
A fake rate chart goes viral not because of the numbers, but because of the dread each of us already carries about the bill.

items.sourceNote: 體感溫度飆破 39.8 度 平地體感直逼 42 度 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞：「今日平地體感溫度直逼 42 度。」
42 度是什麼概念？就是我出門走到巷口，回來已經可以直接下鍋。
所以我不是在開冷氣，我是在替一塊快要熟透的肉，爭取最後的保鮮期。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一出門就融化、回家第一件事是撲向冷氣的朋友，配一張氣象局高溫圖
variations: 體感 42 度的意思是：冷氣不是奢侈品，是保命的醫療器材。
當體感溫度比人的正常體溫還高，開冷氣就不叫享受了，叫急救。

en.content:
News: 'Today's ground-level heat index is pushing 108°F.'
What does 108°F feel like? I walk to the corner and back, and by the time I'm home I'm basically ready to be plated.
So I'm not running the AC — I'm buying a little extra freshness for a cut of meat that's nearly done.
en.editorNote: For the friend who melts the second they step outside and dives at the AC the moment they're home — pair with a heat-advisory map
variations: A heat index of 108°F means the AC isn't a luxury — it's life-support equipment.
When it feels hotter than your own body temperature, running the AC isn't indulgence. It's first aid.

items.sourceNote: 外出少於 30 分鐘不關機 超過 1 小時直接關 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電規則：「外出少於 30 分鐘不用關冷氣，超過 1 小時再關。」
於是我現在出門買個午餐，都會在門口先掐指一算：
這趟到底是 28 分鐘的小資輕鬆，還是 63 分鐘的破產遠征？
算完發現，最省的方法是根本不出門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個出門前會認真計算自己要離開幾分鐘、藉此決定冷氣命運的精算師朋友
variations: 自從記住那條 30 分鐘規則，我出門買東西都像在解一道應用題。
省電的最高境界，是把每一次出門都換算成冷氣的度數。

en.content:
Utility rule: 'Out for under 30 minutes? Leave the AC on. Over an hour? Switch it off.'
So now, every time I step out for lunch, I do the math at the door:
is this a breezy 28-minute stroll, or a 63-minute bankruptcy expedition?
Turns out the cheapest move is to just never leave the house.
en.editorNote: For the human-calculator friend who times every outing to decide the AC's fate
variations: Ever since I learned the 30-minute rule, running errands feels like solving a word problem.
The highest form of saving power is converting every trip out the door into kilowatt-hours.

items.sourceNote: Dcard 2026 冷氣推薦 一級能效 靜音 CP值 租屋族 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我認真研究了 Dcard 上所有「一級能效、超省電」的冷氣推薦。
看完得到一個結論：最省電的那台，我最買不起；買得起的那台，最耗電。
所以省電冷氣的意思是——先花一筆錢，才有資格開始省錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在 Dcard 存了三十篇冷氣開箱、卻遲遲不敢下單的租屋族
variations: 省電家電的邏輯：你得先付得起貴的，才有省小錢的權利。
一級能效的冷氣，是給有錢慢慢回本的人準備的省電。

en.content:
I seriously read every 'top energy rating, super efficient' AC recommendation on the forums.
My takeaway: the most efficient one is the one I can't afford, and the one I can afford is the biggest power hog.
So an energy-saving AC really means — you spend a chunk of money first, then you earn the right to start saving.
en.editorNote: For the renter who's bookmarked thirty AC reviews but still can't bring themselves to hit buy
variations: The logic of efficient appliances: you have to afford the pricey one before you're allowed to save on the cheap stuff.
A top-rated AC is energy-saving designed for people who can wait to earn the money back.

items.sourceNote: PTT WomenTalk 大家夏天電費多少 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
版上開了一串：「大家夏天電費多少啊？」
我點進去，本來想找個安慰，結果看到有人 800、有人 5000。
800 的說「我很省」，5000 的說「還好吧」。
只有我，看完默默關掉視窗，決定這個月的電費，不跟任何人比較，自己一個人偷偷難過就好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次看電費討論串都會看到心情更差、還是忍不住點進去的朋友
variations: 電費討論串的真相：不管你多少，永遠有人讓你覺得自己太揮霍或太可憐。
問「大家電費多少」是危險的，因為你想要的是安慰，得到的通常是打擊。

en.content:
A thread popped up: 'How much is everyone's summer electric bill?'
I clicked in hoping for comfort and found people posting $25, and people posting $160.
The $25 person said 'I'm really frugal.' The $160 person said 'not too bad, right?'
Only me — I quietly closed the tab and decided this month's bill wouldn't be compared to anyone's. I'd just be sad about it alone.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always ends up feeling worse reading bill threads but can never resist clicking in
variations: The truth about bill-comparison threads: no matter your number, someone will make you feel either wasteful or pitiful.
Asking 'how much is your bill' is dangerous — you want reassurance, you usually get a gut punch.

items.sourceNote: 台電數據 夏月平均用電 308→418 度 電費多 446 元 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電公布：夏天一到，平均每戶用電從 308 度飆到 418 度。
我看著這 110 度的差距，突然懂了——
那多出來的 110 度，不是冷氣吹掉的，是我想活著的證明。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到「用電量統計」新聞就默默點頭的同事，數字會說話
variations: 夏天多出來的那 110 度，是我跟高溫談判失敗的賠償金。
台電的統計數字裡，藏著全台灣人一起流的汗。

en.content:
The power company reports: come summer, the average household jumps from 308 to 418 kWh.
I stared at that 110 kWh gap and suddenly understood —
those extra 110 units weren't burned by the AC. They're proof I wanted to stay alive.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker who silently nods at every 'average usage' news headline — numbers don't lie
variations: That extra 110 kWh in summer is the settlement I paid for losing my negotiation with the heat.
Hidden inside the power company's statistics is the sweat of an entire island.

items.sourceNote: CNN 'afraid to get my next bill' Americans brace for cooling costs register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我現在最怕的不是恐怖片，
是手機跳出「您的電子帳單已產生」的那則推播。
恐怖片頂多嚇一晚，那則推播能嚇我一整個夏天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把電費帳單通知設成「稍後提醒」、然後一直逃避的朋友
variations: 人生最需要勇氣的一鍵，是點開那封夏天電子帳單。
別人看到未讀通知會焦慮，我是看到「電費帳單」四個字會心律不整。

en.content:
These days the scariest thing isn't a horror movie.
It's the phone buzzing with 'Your e-bill is ready.'
A horror movie scares you for one night. That notification scares you for a whole summer.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who hits 'remind me later' on the bill alert and just keeps running
variations: The tap that takes the most courage in life is opening your summer e-bill.
Other people get anxious over unread notifications. I get heart palpitations at the words 'electric bill.'

items.sourceNote: meme 電費比新車月付還貴 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
拆開這個月電費單，我認真思考了一下：
這個金額，其實可以拿去繳一台新車的月付了。
差別是，車還能開出去兜風，我的冷氣只能把我關在家裡吹。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到帳單金額會下意識換算成「可以買幾杯珍奶」的朋友
variations: 我的夏季電費，已經進化到可以跟房貸月付平起平坐了。
同樣的錢，隔壁在付車貸，我在付一個涼快的權利。

en.content:
I opened this month's electric bill and seriously did the math:
this amount could cover the monthly payment on a brand-new car.
The difference is, a car can take you on a drive. My AC just keeps me locked at home, staying cool.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who instinctively converts every bill into 'how many bubble teas that is'
variations: My summer electric bill has evolved to sit shoulder-to-shoulder with a mortgage payment.
Same money: my neighbor's paying off a car, I'm paying for the right to feel cool.

items.sourceNote: meme 'guess we not using electricity anymore' 收到帳單後斷電宣言 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
收到帳單後，我在家庭群組鄭重宣布：
「從今天起，本戶全面禁用電力。」
三分鐘後，我因為太熱，默默把冷氣打開，並把那則訊息收回。
宣言的壽命，取決於室溫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每個月都會發一次「以後都不開冷氣了」、然後從沒做到的自己或朋友
variations: 夏天所有的省電宣言，都活不過下一波熱浪。
我對電力的抵制，跟我對甜點的抵制一樣，都是說說而已。

en.content:
After the bill arrived, I solemnly announced in the family chat:
'Effective today, this household is banning all electricity.'
Three minutes later, too hot to bear, I quietly turned the AC back on and unsent the message.
The lifespan of a declaration depends on the room temperature.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend (or self) who declares 'no more AC ever' every month and never once follows through
variations: Every summer power-saving vow dies before the next heatwave arrives.
My boycott of electricity is exactly as real as my boycott of dessert — all talk.

items.sourceNote: 台電分析電費漲幅 73% 來自用量增加、27% 來自費率；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電好心解釋：「你電費漲的那筆錢，七成是因為你自己多吹的，只有三成是費率漲。」
我：「所以你的意思是，這一切都怪我？」
台電：「我沒這樣說，但數據這樣說。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次帳單來都想怪台電、但其實是自己冷氣開整天的朋友
variations: 原來夏天電費漲，最大的兇手不是台電，是那個捨不得關冷氣的我。
台電漲的是費率，我漲的是用量，兩個加起來剛好漲爆我的錢包。

en.content:
The power company kindly explains: 'Seventy percent of your bill increase comes from you using more. Only thirty percent is the rate hike.'
Me: 'So what you're saying is, this is all my fault?'
Power company: 'I didn't say that. The data did.'
en.editorNote: For the friend who blames the utility every billing cycle but actually runs the AC all day
variations: Turns out the real villain behind the summer bill isn't the power company — it's the me who can't bear to switch off the AC.
They raised the rate, I raised the usage. Together we raised my bill to catastrophic.

items.sourceNote: meme standing directly in front of the AC vent register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我跟冷氣出風口的關係，比很多感情都認真。
剛開機的那五分鐘，我會整個人站在它正下方，仰著頭、閉著眼，像在領受某種神聖的恩典。
電費：「你這樣站，一度都沒少喔。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一開冷氣就要衝去站在出風口下面、享受那一秒極樂的朋友
variations: 夏天最療癒的姿勢，是站在冷氣出風口正下方，什麼都不想。
別人拜拜是為了求財，我站在出風口下面，是為了求一秒涼快。

en.content:
My relationship with the AC vent is more committed than most of my past ones.
For the first five minutes after it kicks on, I stand directly beneath it, head tilted back, eyes closed, receiving some kind of holy blessing.
The bill: 'Standing like that doesn't save you a single unit, you know.'
en.editorNote: For the friend who sprints to stand under the vent the second the AC comes on, savoring that one blissful second
variations: The most healing pose of summer is standing directly under the AC vent, thinking about nothing.
Some people pray for wealth. I stand under the vent praying for one second of cool.

items.sourceNote: meme sweating while waiting for the AC to actually cool down register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
冷氣最殘忍的設計，是按下開機到真正變涼之間的那段空白。
那三分鐘，你已經在流汗，冷氣還在暖機，你們兩個都很努力，但誰都還沒到位。
這大概就是人生：期待跟現實之間，永遠隔著一段流汗的等待。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個按下遙控器就開始盯著出風口、一秒一秒數它變涼的急性子朋友
variations: 按下開機到真正涼，這段時間，是夏天最長的三分鐘。
冷氣暖機的那幾分鐘，是我一天之中最有耐心也最沒耐心的時刻。

en.content:
The cruelest design in any AC is the gap between hitting the button and actually feeling cool.
For those three minutes, you're already sweating while it's still warming up — you're both trying hard, and neither of you has arrived.
That's basically life: between expectation and reality, there's always a sweaty wait.
en.editorNote: For the impatient friend who hits the remote and immediately stares at the vent, counting the seconds until it cools
variations: The stretch between pressing 'on' and feeling actual cold is the longest three minutes of summer.
The minutes an AC spends warming up are when I'm simultaneously my most and least patient.

items.sourceNote: 只開一間冷氣房 全家集中 省電 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天省電的終極型態，是全家人默默搬進同一間冷氣房。
爸在沙發、媽在地墊、我在角落、貓在最涼的正中央。
四個生命體，一台冷氣，我們不是感情變好了，我們只是都不想付兩間房的電。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個夏天全家自動集中到唯一那間冷氣房、而貓永遠坐最好位置的家庭
variations: 夏天讓一家人團圓的，不是過節，是那間唯一開冷氣的房間。
一台冷氣養活全家，這是我家夏天最真實的共產主義。

en.content:
The ultimate form of summer energy-saving is the whole family quietly migrating into one AC room.
Dad on the couch, Mom on the floor mat, me in the corner, the cat dead-center in the coldest spot.
Four living beings, one AC — we didn't suddenly grow closer, we just don't want to pay to cool two rooms.
en.editorNote: For the family that piles into the single AC room every summer, where the cat always claims the best seat
variations: What brings my family together in summer isn't a holiday — it's the one room with the AC on.
One AC keeping the whole family alive: the truest form of communism my household achieves each summer.

items.sourceNote: 住宅用戶夏月平均用電從 308 度增至 418 度 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞：「住宅用戶進入夏月後，平均每月用電從 308 度增加到 418 度。」
我看了看自己的帳單，默默把它蓋起來。
原來我不是被國家的平均拖累，我是那個把平均往上拉的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次看到「平均用電量」就心虛對照自己帳單的朋友
variations: 全國平均用電 418 度，而我，是那個讓平均升高、卻不敢承認的沉默貢獻者。
我對台灣唯一的貢獻，就是每年夏天把住宅用電的平均值往上抬一點。

en.content:
News: 'After summer rates begin, the average household's monthly usage jumps from 308 to 418 kWh.'
I glanced at my own bill and quietly turned it face-down.
Turns out I'm not being dragged down by the national average — I'm the one dragging it up.
en.editorNote: For the friend who guiltily compares their bill to the 'average usage' figure every single time
variations: The national average is 418 kWh, and I'm the silent contributor who pushes it higher but won't admit it.
My one contribution to this country is nudging up the residential electricity average every summer.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣是人類最偉大發明 迷因 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
如果要我在 Wi-Fi 跟冷氣之間二選一，我會毫不猶豫選冷氣。
因為沒有 Wi-Fi 我還能發呆，
沒有冷氣，我連呆都會被烤熟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個七月已經完全被冷氣馴化、離開房間三分鐘就想回來的朋友
variations: 人類最偉大的發明不是網路，是那個願意在你付得起的價格內給你涼風的機器。
夏天讓我認清一件事：我可以斷網，但我不能斷冷氣。

en.content:
If I had to choose between Wi-Fi and air conditioning, I'd pick the AC without blinking.
Without Wi-Fi I can still sit and stare at a wall.
Without AC, even the staring gets me cooked.
en.editorNote: For the friend so tamed by their AC that they can't last three minutes out of the room by July
variations: Humanity's greatest invention isn't the internet — it's the machine that hands you cold air at a price you can just barely afford.
Summer taught me one thing: I can go offline, but I cannot go off-AC.

items.sourceNote: 電費到 悲傷歌詞突然懂了 迷因 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前聽情歌，覺得那些「心好痛」「撐不下去」很誇張。
直到我收到七月的電費單，
那一瞬間，所有的悲傷情歌，我全都懂了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拆完帳單需要一首歌來療傷的朋友，配一段 emo 音樂限動剛好
variations: 電費單是這世界上最有共鳴的東西，它讓我聽懂了所有失戀歌。
沒有什麼比一張夏季電費單，更能瞬間讓你進入悲情女主角模式。

en.content:
I used to think sad songs were dramatic — all that 'my heart aches,' 'I can't go on.'
Then my July electric bill arrived,
and in that single moment, every heartbreak ballad finally made sense.
en.editorNote: For the friend who needs a whole song to recover after opening the bill — pairs perfectly with an emo story post
variations: The electric bill is the most relatable thing on earth: it made me understand every breakup song ever written.
Nothing puts you into tragic-main-character mode faster than a summer electric bill.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價 6-9 月 七月才過一半 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏月電價從六月一號跑到九月三十號。
現在才七月中，我以為自己撐了好久，
結果一算，這場燒錢馬拉松，我連一半都還沒跑完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個七月就先喊累、卻發現夏天才剛熱身的朋友，一起絕望
variations: 夏月電價是一場四個月的馬拉松，而我在七月就已經想棄賽了。
別問我夏天過得怎樣，我還在起跑線附近喘氣，後面還有兩個月要燒。

en.content:
Summer rates run from June 1st all the way to September 30th.
It's only mid-July, and I thought I'd survived forever —
then I did the math: I'm not even halfway through this money-burning marathon.
en.editorNote: For the friend already exhausted in July who just realized summer is barely warming up
variations: Summer rates are a four-month marathon, and by July I already wanted to drop out.
Don't ask how my summer's going — I'm still gasping near the starting line with two months of burning left.

items.sourceNote: 智慧電表 APP 一直刷用電量 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
自從裝了可以看即時用電的 APP，我的生活多了一個新習慣：
每隔一小時刷新一次，看著數字上升，心跳跟著上升。
它本來是要幫我省電的，現在變成我夏天最主要的焦慮來源。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把用電量 APP 當股票在盯、看到數字跳就手抖的朋友
variations: 台電的即時用電 APP，是我這輩子最不想看卻又刷最勤的排行榜。
以前緊張刷股票，現在緊張刷用電量，賠的都是我的錢。

en.content:
Ever since I installed the app that shows real-time electricity use, I have a new habit:
refresh every hour, watch the number climb, feel my heart rate climb with it.
It was supposed to help me save power. Now it's my main source of summer anxiety.
en.editorNote: For the friend who watches the usage app like a stock ticker and flinches every time the number jumps
variations: The real-time usage app is the leaderboard I least want to see yet refresh the most.
I used to nervously refresh my stocks. Now I nervously refresh my kilowatt-hours. Both cost me money.

items.sourceNote: 朋友移居涼爽國家 羨慕 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友移居到一個夏天只要開窗就涼的國家，
傳來一張蓋薄被吹自然風的照片。
我一邊回覆「好羨慕」，一邊聽著自己家冷氣外機用盡全力運轉的聲音，那是我夏天的白噪音。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個朋友都往涼爽國家跑、只剩自己留在原地繳電費的你
variations: 別人的夏天是開窗自然涼，我的夏天是關窗、拉窗簾、把冷氣當氧氣。
羨慕不是罪，但看到朋友不用電費就能涼快，那一刻我真的有動搖。

en.content:
A friend moved to a country where summer just means opening a window,
and sent me a photo of them under a thin sheet with a natural breeze.
I typed 'so jealous' while listening to my own AC compressor straining at full power — the white noise of my summer.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose friends all escaped to cooler countries while they stayed behind paying the bill
variations: Their summer is an open window and a cool breeze. Mine is a sealed room, drawn curtains, and AC as oxygen.
Envy isn't a sin, but watching a friend stay cool for free genuinely made me reconsider a few life choices.

items.sourceNote: 台電揭帳單變貴真相 73% 來自用電量增加 27% 才是電價；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電出來澄清：「帳單變貴，七成是因為你用得多，電價漲的部分只佔三成。」
翻譯成白話就是：
「別怪我漲價，你只是變熱了，然後你自己受不了。」
這句話，比帳單本身還痛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年都怪台電漲價、卻不肯承認自己冷氣開好開滿的朋友
variations: 帳單變貴的真相：三成是台電的錯，七成是夏天的錯，剩下的零成是我的錯——我從來沒錯。
台電最狠的一招，不是漲價，是告訴你帳單變貴其實大部分是你自己爽出來的。

en.content:
The power company clarified: 'Your bill went up because you used more — the rate hike is only a small part of it.'
Translated into plain English:
'Don't blame me for raising prices. You just got hot, and then you couldn't take it.'
That sentence hurts more than the bill itself.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who blames the utility every year but won't admit they run the AC full blast
variations: The truth about the bigger bill: a third is the rate, two thirds is summer, and zero percent is my fault — I'm never at fault.
The power company's cruelest move isn't the hike. It's telling you the bill grew mostly because you enjoyed yourself.

items.sourceNote: 一台冷氣佔全屋將近一半電費 that one appliance；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說，全家所有電器裡，光是那一台冷氣，就佔了將近一半的電費。
所以我家其他電器都是配角，
只有冷氣是主角，而且是那種戲份最多、片酬最貴、還不能得罪的大牌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為關掉待機小紅燈就能省很多、結果發現主犯是冷氣的朋友
variations: 省電的時候大家忙著拔充電器插頭，真正的大魔王在牆上，開著，笑而不語。
冷氣之於電費，就像房租之於薪水——一個項目，吃掉你半條命。

en.content:
Experts say that out of every appliance in the house, the AC alone eats up nearly half your electric bill.
So every other appliance in my home is a supporting actor.
The AC is the lead — the kind with the most screen time, the biggest paycheck, and a temper you can't afford to cross.
en.editorNote: For the friend who thinks unplugging standby lights saves a fortune, then learns the real culprit is the AC
variations: Everyone unplugs their chargers to save power while the real final boss hangs on the wall, running, smiling silently.
The AC is to your bill what rent is to your salary — one line item, half your life gone.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季降溫成本創新高 較 2020 上漲約 40%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
數據說，這幾年夏天的降溫成本又創新高，比幾年前貴了整整四成。
意思是：同樣的熱、同樣的汗、同樣的冷氣，
我現在要付出比過去多四成的代價，才能買到跟以前一模一樣的「還可以活」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「以前夏天沒這麼貴」不是錯覺、是真的變貴的朋友
variations: 通膨最誠實的地方，是連「涼快」都變成一種需要漲價的奢侈品。
同樣是活過一個夏天，現在的版本比幾年前貴四成，功能卻一模一樣。

en.content:
The data says the cost of staying cool has hit a new high — up about 40% from a few years back.
Which means: the same heat, the same sweat, the same AC,
now costs me 40% more just to buy the exact same 'barely surviving' I had before.
en.editorNote: For the friend who insists summers 'didn't used to cost this much' — turns out that's not nostalgia, it's real
variations: The most honest thing about inflation is that even 'being cool' became a luxury that raises its prices.
Surviving one summer costs 40% more than a few years ago, and the feature set is identical.

items.sourceNote: 專家一圖看每日最貴用電時段 避開尖峰；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家做了一張圖，標出每天最貴的用電時段，叫我避開。
我認真研究後發現，那個最貴的時段，剛好就是——
下午最熱、我最想開冷氣、也最開不起冷氣的那幾個小時。
所謂避開尖峰，就是叫我在最需要的時候，忍住。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把台電時段表存在手機、每天下午跟自己天人交戰的省電魂
variations: 尖峰時段的設計很有哲理：最貴的那幾個小時，永遠是你最撐不住的那幾個小時。
避開尖峰用電的意思，白話講就是：熱死你的那一刻，也是最貴的那一刻，請你再撐一下。

en.content:
Experts made a chart marking the most expensive hours to use power each day, and told me to avoid them.
After studying it carefully, I realized those priciest hours are exactly —
the hottest part of the afternoon, when I most want the AC, and can least afford it.
'Avoid peak hours' just means: hold on through the moment you need it most.
en.editorNote: For the savings soul who saved the peak-rate chart to their phone and wrestles with it every afternoon
variations: There's a dark poetry to peak pricing: the priciest hours are always the exact hours you can't take anymore.
'Avoid peak usage' translated: the moment the heat is killing you is also the most expensive moment — please hang in there.

items.sourceNote: 2026 美國夏季平均電費約 792 美元 較去年漲一成；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
看到國外新聞：今年夏天他們一整季電費平均要花快兩萬台幣，比去年又漲了一成。
我看著自己的帳單，忽然有種被安慰到的感覺——
原來全世界都在為了不被熱死而付錢，我不是一個人。
這大概是繳電費唯一的溫馨時刻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為只有台灣電費貴、看到國外數字後瞬間釋懷的朋友
variations: 全球暖化最公平的地方，是不管你住哪一國，夏天都會用電費提醒你它的存在。
知道別人夏天電費也很痛，不會讓我的帳單變便宜，但至少讓我的崩潰有了同伴。

en.content:
Saw a foreign headline: this summer their season-long electric bill averages nearly 800 bucks, up another 10% from last year.
I looked at my own bill and felt oddly comforted —
turns out the whole world is paying just to not be cooked alive. I'm not alone.
That might be the only heartwarming moment in paying an electric bill.
en.editorNote: For the friend who thought only their country had brutal bills, then found instant peace in the global numbers
variations: The fairest thing about global warming is that no matter which country you live in, summer reminds you it exists via your bill.
Knowing everyone's summer bill hurts doesn't make mine cheaper, but at least my breakdown has company.

items.sourceNote: 情侶為省電冷氣開 26 度 帳單仍 2200 元 傻眼被台電懲罰；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我跟另一半說好，今年夏天冷氣一律設 26 度，能忍就忍。
熱到睡不著的每個晚上，我們都告訴自己：這是為了帳單。
結果帳單來，還是兩千二。
我看著那個數字，忽然懂了——原來省電不是折扣，是一種你付了錢還要被感謝的犧牲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟伴侶一起立志省電、結果一起在帳單前傻眼的同居戰友
variations: 設 26 度那一刻，我以為我在跟台電談判；帳單來的時候，我才知道我只是在跟自己過不去。
省電最痛的地方不是熱，是你熱了一整個夏天，帳單還是給你一個「你不夠努力」的表情。

en.content:
My partner and I made a pact: AC stays at 26 all summer, tough it out whenever we can.
Every sleepless, sweaty night, we told each other — this is for the bill.
Then the bill came. Still seventy bucks.
Staring at that number, it hit me: saving power isn't a discount. It's a sacrifice you pay for and then get thanked for.
en.editorNote: For the live-in partner who vowed to save power together and ended up staring at the bill together
variations: The moment I set it to 26, I thought I was negotiating with the power company. When the bill came, I realized I was only fighting myself.
The cruelest part of saving power isn't the heat — it's sweating all summer and still getting a bill that says 'you didn't try hard enough.'

items.sourceNote: 2026 台電取消每期 84 元保底 改為每省一度給 0.6 元節電獎勵；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前的節電獎勵，是只要有省就給你保底八十四塊，像個安慰獎。
今年台電改規則了：每省一度，給你六毛。
所以現在想拿獎勵，得先讓自己過得比去年更痛。
我算了算，這獎勵的意思大概是——把自己熱到脫水，換一杯手搖飲的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為節電獎勵是躺著領、結果發現要拿汗水去換的省電族
variations: 節電獎勵改成按度數給，等於台電跟你說：想領錢可以，但你得先證明你夠慘。
每省一度六毛，我省到快中暑，換來的錢剛好不夠買一支退冰的雪糕。

en.content:
The old savings rebate gave you a flat consolation prize just for cutting back a little.
This year they changed the rules: a few cents for every unit you save.
So now, to earn the reward, you have to make this summer hurt more than last year's.
I did the math — the reward basically means: dehydrate yourself for the price of one bubble tea.
en.editorNote: For the saver who assumed the rebate was free money, then found out it's paid in sweat
variations: Switching the rebate to per-unit is the power company saying: sure, you can earn it — just prove how miserable you're willing to be first.
A few cents per unit saved. I nearly gave myself heatstroke, and the payout won't cover a single melting popsicle.

items.sourceNote: 查核 網傳三段式電價最高一度 8.12 元圖表為不實 家用仍以累進電費為主；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
群組又在瘋傳一張圖：說夏天用電最貴一度飆到八塊多，叫大家半夜再開冷氣。
查核出來是假的，家用根本沒這回事。
但我最有感的不是謠言，是我看到那張圖的第一反應——
手已經先把冷氣關掉了，大腦才慢半拍地說：欸，這好像是假消息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個家庭群組永遠在轉電費謠言、而你永遠先關冷氣再查證的長輩剋星
variations: 電費謠言最厲害的地方，不是騙到你的錢，是騙到你的膝反射——先關冷氣，再問真假。
每年夏天群組都會出現一張嚇人的電價圖，唯一真實的，是我看完之後那身冷汗。

en.content:
The group chat is passing around an image again: claims summer power spikes to eight bucks a unit, so run the AC only at night.
Fact-checkers say it's fake — home billing doesn't work that way.
But the part that got me wasn't the rumor. It was my first reaction to that image —
my hand had already switched off the AC before my brain caught up and went, wait, this is probably fake.
en.editorNote: For the family-chat survivor who kills the AC first and fact-checks the scary rate image second
variations: The scariest thing about power-bill rumors isn't that they cost you money — it's that they hijack your reflexes: AC off first, ask questions later.
Every summer the group chat coughs up a terrifying rate chart. The only real thing about it is the cold sweat I break into after reading it.

items.sourceNote: Dcard 分離式冷氣推薦 網友讚冷房快到像住冰庫；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
看網友推薦冷氣，說某台冷房快到像住冰庫，二十分鐘整間涼透。
我一邊心動一邊清醒：問題從來不是冷氣不夠力，
是我不敢讓它發揮實力。
我家這台其實也能把房間變冰庫，我只是每次快到冰庫的前一刻，就先按了關機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個滑冷氣開箱文滑得心癢、卻連自己現有冷氣都不敢開好開滿的省電魂
variations: 冷氣廣告說涼得像冰庫，我的日常是涼到剛好可以繳得起帳單的那個溫度就停手。
不是我家冷氣不夠強，是我每次都在它正要展現實力的時候，親手把它請下班。

en.content:
Saw people online raving about an AC that cools so fast the whole room feels like a walk-in freezer in twenty minutes.
I was tempted and clear-eyed at once: the problem was never that my AC isn't powerful enough,
it's that I don't dare let it show what it can do.
Mine could turn the room into a freezer too — I just hit the off button the exact second before it gets there.
en.editorNote: For the savings soul who scrolls AC reviews longingly but won't even run the unit they already own at full blast
variations: The ad says it cools like a freezer. My reality is stopping at the exact degree I can still afford to pay for.
It's not that my AC is weak — it's that I personally clock it out every time it's about to prove what it can do.

items.sourceNote: 情侶為省電冷氣設 26 度 結果電費 2200 傻眼；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了省電，我們把冷氣鎖死在二十六度，連被子都不敢多蓋。
結果帳單來了，兩千二。
女友說：「我們明明有在省耶。」
我說：「有，我們省的是尊嚴，不是電費。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明整個夏天都在克制、帳單卻毫不留情的另一半，一起苦笑
variations: 省電省到不敢蓋被子，帳單還是給你來個兩千二，這不叫節能，這叫被台電當提款機。
我們以為忍耐就會有回報，台電用一張帳單溫柔地告訴我們：不會。

en.content:
To save money, we locked the AC at 79°F and didn't even dare pull up a blanket.
Then the bill came: seventy bucks.
My girlfriend said, 'But we were being so careful.'
I said, 'We were. What we saved was our dignity, not our money.'
en.editorNote: Send to the partner who rationed all summer and still got no mercy from the bill
variations: We sacrificed the blanket, the comfort, everything — and the bill still showed up like nothing happened.
We thought suffering earned a discount. The utility company gently proved us wrong.

items.sourceNote: 台電：變頻冷氣外出 1 小時內不用關 超過反而更耗電；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電說：「變頻冷氣出門一小時內別關，開開關關反而更耗電。」
我：「所以我下樓丟個垃圾，冷氣要繼續開著等我？」
台電：「對，它比你男朋友還忠誠。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次出門都在糾結「到底要不要關冷氣」的省電魂
variations: 以前覺得離開房間就該關冷氣才叫美德，現在才知道，那一開一關的瞬間，比開整晚還傷。
冷氣：「你只是去便利商店，何必跟我說再見？」

en.content:
The power company says: 'With an inverter AC, don't switch it off if you're gone under an hour — restarting burns more.'
Me: 'So when I run down to take out the trash, the AC just waits for me?'
Them: 'Yes. It's more loyal than your ex.'
en.editorNote: For the savings soul who agonizes over 'do I turn it off or not' every time they leave the room
variations: Turns out flipping it off every time you step out isn't virtue — that on-off jolt costs more than just leaving it be.
The AC: 'You're only going to the corner store. Why the dramatic goodbye?'

items.sourceNote: 查核：網傳夏月一度上看 8.12 元為不實 高壓用戶非住宅；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
群組瘋傳：「夏天一度電要八塊一！」
大家開始互道珍重，準備關冷氣共赴國難。
查核出來：那是工廠高壓電，跟你家沒關係。
所以我們白緊張了一場，還是回去繼續吹——用兩塊五的那種。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那個在家庭群組被嚇到差點把冷氣拔插頭的親戚，先幫他把血壓降回來
variations: 謠言把電價講得像世界末日，真相只是：你家那度電還是兩塊五，冷氣可以放心開。
被假消息嚇到關冷氣流一身汗，才發現虛驚一場，這才是今年夏天真正的耗電原因。

en.content:
A message went viral: 'Summer electricity is now 27 cents a unit!'
Everyone started saying goodbye and preparing to switch off the AC together.
The fact-check: that rate is for industrial high-voltage users. It has nothing to do with your home.
So we panicked for nothing, and went right back to the cheap kind.
en.editorNote: Forward to the relative who nearly unplugged their AC over a group-chat rumor — talk them down first
variations: The rumor made it sound apocalyptic. The truth: your rate didn't change, go turn the AC back on.
Sweating from panic over fake news turned out to be the real energy drain this summer.

items.sourceNote: 2026 節電獎勵取消保底 84 元 改為每省 1 度回饋 0.6 元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前只要有省一點電，台電保底給你八十四塊，像個安慰獎。
今年改了：省多少算多少，每一度回你六毛。
我算了一下，我要省到能請一杯珍奶，得先熱到中暑。
台電：「加油，你離免費飲料只差一場熱衰竭。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個認真研究節電獎勵、卻發現回饋還不夠買一杯飲料的省電同好
variations: 節電回饋每度六毛，意思是我省下的錢，剛好夠買一個「早知道就開冷氣」的後悔。
以前有保底安慰獎，現在是實績制——努力流汗一整個月，換一杯半糖少冰。

en.content:
It used to be that if you saved any power at all, they handed you a flat consolation payout.
This year it changed: you get paid per unit you actually save, a couple cents each.
I did the math — to earn one iced coffee, I'd have to sweat myself into heatstroke first.
Them: 'Keep going, you're just one heat collapse away from a free drink.'
en.editorNote: For the earnest saver who studied the rebate scheme and found it won't even cover a beverage
variations: The rebate per unit is so small that what I 'earn' is exactly enough to buy one 'I should've just run the AC' regret.
The old flat bonus was mercy. The new pay-per-unit is a performance review — a whole sweaty month for one small coffee.

items.sourceNote: 台電揭帳單變貴真相 逾七成來自用電量增加 費率調整僅約 27%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我一直以為夏天帳單暴漲，是台電偷偷漲價害的。
結果台電出來說：漲的錢裡有七成，是你自己吹得多。
真正因為調價的，只有兩成七。
這句話最傷的地方在於——它把責任，溫柔地還給了我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次看到帳單都想罵台電、看完真相卻只能安靜反省的自己
variations: 原來帳單不是被漲價背刺，是被自己每晚二十六度的溫柔一刀一刀加上去的。
台電：「不是我們貴，是你太愛涼。」我：「……你可以不要講得這麼準嗎。」

en.content:
I always assumed my summer bill exploded because the utility quietly jacked up prices.
Then they came out and said: over seventy percent of the increase is just you using more.
The actual rate change? Barely a quarter of it.
The cruelest part of that sentence is how gently it hands the blame back to me.
en.editorNote: For the you who wants to curse the utility every billing cycle, then goes quiet after reading the truth
variations: Turns out the bill wasn't stabbed in the back by a price hike — I added every dollar myself, one cold night at a time.
Them: 'We're not expensive, you just love being cool.' Me: '...did you have to be this accurate?'

items.sourceNote: 史上最貴電價 最高級距每度 8.86 元 漲幅 26%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說今年是史上最貴的夏天，最高級距一度快九塊。
我看著冷氣遙控器，突然覺得它不是遙控器，是計程車跳表。
每按一下溫度往下，錶就多跳一格。
差別只在於，計程車會載你到目的地，冷氣只會載你到下期帳單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個按冷氣遙控器前會先猶豫三秒的室友，一起面對跳表人生
variations: 一度快九塊的夏天，我開冷氣的手，抖得像在簽本票。
史上最貴級距是每度八塊八六，湊個整數的話——那零頭，是我最後的尊嚴。

en.content:
The news says this is the most expensive summer on record, top tier almost nine bucks a unit.
I looked at the AC remote and realized it's not a remote — it's a taxi meter.
Every press downward, the meter ticks up another notch.
Only difference is, a taxi takes you somewhere. The AC just takes you to next month's bill.
en.editorNote: For the roommate who hesitates three seconds before touching the thermostat — meter life, together
variations: Nine bucks a unit, and my hand shakes on the remote like I'm signing a promissory note.
Top tier is $8.86 a unit. That last six cents? That's my remaining dignity, rounded up.

items.sourceNote: 半夜用電比較省是迷思 住宅累進電價與時間無關；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我一直以為半夜洗衣服、半夜開冷氣比較省錢，過得像個特務。
後來才知道，一般住宅是累進電價，跟你幾點用一點關係都沒有。
意思是我這三年來的凌晨兩點洗衣人生，
省下的不是電費，是睡眠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個堅持半夜偷偷用電、以為自己在跟台電鬥智的家人
variations: 半夜用電比較省是迷思，真正被省掉的，是我的黑眼圈額度。
我以為我在避開尖峰，其實我只是在避開睡覺。

en.content:
For years I believed running the laundry and AC at midnight was cheaper, living like a secret agent.
Turns out most homes are on tiered pricing — the hour you use power makes zero difference.
So those three years of 2 a.m. laundry runs?
What I actually saved wasn't money. It was sleep.
en.editorNote: Send to the family member who sneaks midnight loads thinking they're outsmarting the utility
variations: 'Midnight power is cheaper' is a myth — the only thing it saved was my eye bags' budget.
I thought I was dodging peak hours. I was just dodging bedtime.

items.sourceNote: 住宅兩個月一期 六七八月冷氣疊加 帳單突然跳很多；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台灣的電費帳單是兩個月一期，這件事我以前覺得很方便。
直到夏天——兩個月的冷氣，一次跟你算總帳。
那不是帳單，那是連續劇的季終合輯，
把你整季的軟弱，濃縮在一張紙上重播給你看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拆兩個月一期帳單、需要有人陪著一起深呼吸的鄰居
variations: 兩個月一期的帳單好處是省信封，壞處是傷害也一次結清。
夏天的帳單不是月結，是季末結算——把你六七月的每一次「再冷一點」全部打包送回。

en.content:
Bills here come every two months, which I always thought was convenient.
Until summer — two months of AC, settled up all at once.
That's not a bill, it's the season finale recap,
replaying every moment of weakness you had, compressed onto one sheet.
en.editorNote: For the neighbor opening a two-month bill who needs someone to breathe deeply alongside them
variations: The upside of two-month billing is you save envelopes. The downside is the damage arrives in one lump too.
Summer bills aren't monthly, they're a season-end reckoning — every 'just a little colder' packaged and shipped back.

items.sourceNote: 清洗濾網每 2-3 週一次 可省電高達 10%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說：「濾網每兩三週洗一次，可以省到一成的電。」
我點頭如搗蒜，然後看向我那台濾網——上面的灰，已經厚到可以種菜。
原來我不是不想省電，
我只是先一步，把冷氣養成了一座溫室。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上喊省電、濾網卻半年沒拆的自己，該動手了
variations: 省電第一步是洗濾網，而我卡在第零步：找到梯子。
台電要我洗濾網省一成，我的濾網回我：「你先解釋一下這半年發生了什麼事。」

en.content:
The expert says: 'Clean the filter every two to three weeks and save up to ten percent.'
I nodded eagerly, then glanced at my filter — the dust is thick enough to grow vegetables in.
Turns out it's not that I don't want to save power.
I just accidentally turned my AC into a greenhouse first.
en.editorNote: For the you who preaches saving power but hasn't opened the filter in six months — time to move
variations: Step one to saving power is cleaning the filter. I'm stuck on step zero: finding the ladder.
They told me to clean the filter for ten percent off. The filter replied: 'First, explain what happened these six months.'

items.sourceNote: 千度以上每度 8.86 元 創新高；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今年夏天，用電超過一千度的部分，一度 8.86 元，創歷史新高。
我盯著這個數字，突然懂了什麼叫「涼快是有價的」。
以前我以為冷氣吹的是風，
現在我知道，那是一張一張的鈔票，被壓縮機打成霧狀，噴在我臉上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個用電量常年破千度、每到夏天就開始練習面無表情的重度使用者
variations: 8.86 這個數字，唸起來像電話號碼，付起來像分手費。
台電的最高級距，是我離「電費自由」最遠的那一段路。

en.content:
This summer, the portion of usage over a thousand units costs 8.86 each — an all-time high.
I stared at the number and finally understood what 'cool comes at a price' means.
I used to think the AC blew air.
Now I know it's cash, atomized by the compressor and misted onto my face.
en.editorNote: For the heavy user whose usage clears four digits every year and practices a blank face each summer
variations: 8.86 reads like a phone number and pays like a breakup fee.
The top pricing tier is the longest stretch of road between me and 'bill freedom'.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣搭配電風扇 減少壓縮機耗能；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說：「冷氣配電風扇一起吹，壓縮機沒那麼操，比較省。」
於是我家客廳現在同時開著冷氣、電風扇，還有一台我。
三個都在運轉，三個都在耗能，
唯一的差別是，只有我這台，關不掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在客廳給那個為了省電同時開兩台電器、結果自己最累的省錢達人
variations: 冷氣加電風扇是團隊合作，省電是團隊 KPI，我是那個扛績效的。
電風扇負責把涼分送到全家，我負責把帳單一個人扛回房間。

en.content:
The expert says: 'Run a fan with the AC, the compressor works less, you save.'
So now my living room runs the AC, the fan, and one more unit — me.
All three are running, all three burn energy.
The only difference: mine is the one that can't be switched off.
en.editorNote: For the money-saver running two appliances at once to cut costs, and ending up the most worn-out of the three
variations: AC plus fan is teamwork. Saving power is the team KPI. I'm the one carrying the numbers.
The fan delivers the cool to the whole house. I deliver the bill, alone, back to my room.

items.sourceNote: 台電節電獎勵 每節省 1 度 0.6 元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電節電獎勵：比去年同期每省一度，回饋你 0.6 元。
我算了一下，如果我今年整個夏天都不開冷氣，
大概可以換到一杯手搖飲。
然後我就會在中暑的路上，喝著那杯用命換來的飲料，覺得一切都值得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個認真研究節電獎勵、算完發現省下的錢還不夠買杯冰的朋友
variations: 0.6 元一度的獎勵，是台電在跟我說：「加油，但也別太拚。」
節電獎勵的意義不在錢，在於讓你知道，你的犧牲被看見了——雖然只值六毛。

en.content:
The utility's savings reward: save one unit versus last year, get 0.6 back.
I did the math — if I skip the AC all summer,
I can roughly afford one bubble tea.
Then I'll sip that hard-earned drink on the way to heatstroke, feeling it was all worth it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who studied the savings rebate carefully, then realized it barely buys a cold drink
variations: A 0.6 reward per unit is the utility saying: 'Try hard, but not too hard.'
The point of the rebate isn't the money — it's knowing your sacrifice was seen. Even if it's worth 60 cents.

items.sourceNote: 夏月用電比非夏月增加近 4 成 308→418 度；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
數據說：一到夏天，每戶用電量會從三百多度，暴增到四百多度，多了快四成。
我看著這個「四成」，覺得它形容的不是電，是我。
夏天的我，忍耐力少四成，脾氣多四成，
意志力全數繳械，只剩下一句：「冷氣先開了再說。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一到夏天整個人設就崩掉、把原則全部拿去換涼快的自己
variations: 用電量多四成，是因為我對夏天的抵抗力，剛好少了四成。
非夏月的我三百度，夏月的我四百度——那多出來的一百度，是我投降的聲音。

en.content:
The data says household usage jumps from three hundred-ish units to over four hundred in summer — nearly forty percent more.
I look at that 'forty percent' and realize it's describing me, not the power.
Summer me has forty percent less patience, forty percent more temper,
and willpower fully surrendered, down to one line: 'AC first, we'll talk later.'
en.editorNote: For the you whose whole personality collapses in summer, trading every principle for a little cool air
variations: Usage is up forty percent because my resistance to summer is down exactly forty percent.
Off-season me is three hundred units. Summer me is four hundred. That extra hundred is the sound of me giving up.

items.sourceNote: 離峰時段用電較便宜 建議夜間用電；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電暗示：離峰時段用電比較便宜，最好把用電挪到深夜。
於是我現在洗衣服、開冷氣、連做夢都排在半夜。
白天的我，是省電模式；
深夜的我，才是完整版——只是這個完整版，明天早上會很想死。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了離峰電價把整個生活作息搬到半夜、隔天上班像遊魂的省錢戰士
variations: 離峰時段最便宜，也最沒有人陪你一起清醒。
白天貴的是電，晚上貴的是我的睡眠——台電只肯幫我省其中一種。

en.content:
The utility hints: off-peak power is cheaper, so shift your usage to late at night.
So now I do laundry, run the AC, and even schedule my dreams for the small hours.
Daytime me runs in power-saving mode.
Late-night me is the full version — except this full version will really regret it tomorrow morning.
en.editorNote: For the money-saving warrior who moved their whole schedule to midnight for off-peak rates and drifts through work like a ghost
variations: Off-peak hours are the cheapest, and the loneliest to be awake in.
By day the power costs more; by night it's my sleep that costs more. The utility only helps me save one of them.

items.sourceNote: 台電節電獎勵 每節省1度得0.6元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電節電獎勵：每省一度電，回饋你零點六元。
我認真算了一下——為了那零點六元，我今天少開了兩小時冷氣、流了三公升汗、跟室友吵了一架。
這獎勵金，最後大概只夠買一顆貢丸，安慰我破碎的夏天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了節電獎勵斤斤計較、結果省下的錢還不夠一杯飲料的省錢夥伴
variations: 節電獎勵一度零點六元，我流的汗一公升值多少，台電從來沒算給我聽。
省一度換零點六元，這不是獎勵，這是台電請我喝半口珍奶。

en.content:
The utility's energy-saving reward: cut one unit of power, get about two cents back.
I did the math — for those two cents, I skipped two hours of AC, sweated three liters, and picked a fight with my roommate.
That reward money is barely enough to buy a single meatball to console my ruined summer.
en.editorNote: For the frugal friend who obsesses over the rebate, only to save less than the price of a drink
variations: Two cents per unit saved. Nobody at the utility ever priced out the liter of sweat it cost me.
That's not a reward, that's the power company buying me half a sip of bubble tea.

items.sourceNote: 台電：夏月電價非漲價 是全年平均一部分；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電再三強調：「夏月電價不是漲價，只是把全年平均電價，挪到夏天收。」
喔，我懂了。
就像分手不是不愛你，只是把愛平均分給別人；
帳單沒有變貴，只是選在你最熱、最脆弱的時候，一次讓你看清現實。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼給每年都被『這不是漲價』這句話安慰、然後帳單還是照樣燙手的你
variations: 「不是漲價，是全年平均」——這句話的溫柔程度，跟「我們只是暫時分開」差不多。
台電把一整年的溫柔，全部濃縮在夏天一次還給我，難怪這麼痛。

en.content:
The utility keeps insisting: 'Summer rates aren't a price hike. We just collect the year's average bill during summer.'
Oh, I get it now.
Like a breakup isn't about not loving you — it's just spreading the love around.
The bill didn't get bigger. It just picked the hottest, weakest moment to show you reality all at once.
en.editorNote: For everyone comforted every year by 'it's not a hike' while the bill still scorches their hand
variations: 'Not a hike, just the yearly average' is exactly as gentle as 'we're just on a break'.
They saved a whole year's worth of tenderness and handed it back in one summer. No wonder it stings.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣濾網每2-3周清洗 可省電10%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說：冷氣濾網每兩三週洗一次，可以省電百分之十。
我看著那片積了整個夏天灰塵的濾網，深吸一口氣，然後把冷氣關掉、拉開，決定——
明天再洗。
於是那百分之十，就跟我的減肥計畫、我的存錢目標，一起排隊等一個永遠不會來的明天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年都說要洗濾網、結果濾網比帳單還先養出感情的拖延大師
variations: 省電百分之十的方法我知道，我只是缺一個願意站起來洗濾網的自己。
濾網上的灰，是我這個夏天唯一堅持累積下來的東西。

en.content:
Experts say: clean your AC filter every two or three weeks and you'll save ten percent.
I look at the filter that's collected a whole summer of dust, take a deep breath, pop the cover open, and decide —
I'll wash it tomorrow.
So that ten percent joins my diet plan and my savings goal, all lined up waiting for a tomorrow that never comes.
en.editorNote: For the procrastination master who vows to clean the filter every year, then bonds with the dust instead
variations: I know exactly how to save ten percent. I'm just missing the version of me willing to stand up and clean the filter.
The dust on that filter is the only thing I've faithfully accumulated all summer.

items.sourceNote: 拉窗簾遮陽 隔熱省電 網友自嘲像吸血鬼；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了省電，我白天把窗簾全部拉上，讓陽光一絲都進不來。
室友問我：「你這樣住在黑漆漆的房間，不會很憂鬱嗎？」
我說：「不會，因為陽光進來，我的心情不會變好，但我的帳單一定會變壞。」
這個夏天，我活得像一隻精打細算的吸血鬼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了隔熱把家裡搞得暗無天日、寧可當吸血鬼也不想當冤大頭的省電同好
variations: 陽光是免費的，但陽光帶進來的熱，最後都要我用電費買單。
我不是怕光，我是怕光後面那張帳單。

en.content:
To save power, I keep every curtain shut all day, so not a single ray of sun gets in.
My roommate asks: 'Living in a pitch-black room like this, don't you get depressed?'
I say: 'No. Because sunlight won't make my mood better, but it will definitely make my bill worse.'
This summer, I'm living like a very budget-conscious vampire.
en.editorNote: For the fellow saver who blacked out the whole apartment for insulation, choosing vampire over sucker
variations: Sunlight is free, but the heat it drags in, I pay for on the electric bill.
I'm not afraid of the light. I'm afraid of the bill standing right behind it.

items.sourceNote: 省電迷因『把燈關掉…冷氣關掉…全部關掉』的絕望；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
收到夏月帳單後的我，開始了一場漸進式的斷捨離。
先關燈。
再關電視。
再關冷氣。
最後看著一片黑暗中還在呼吸的自己，默默想：
「其實，我這口氣，好像也算是在耗電。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一收到帳單就想把家裡所有插頭拔光、連自己都想關機的省電戰友
variations: 省電的盡頭不是關電器，是關掉那個一直想吹冷氣的自己。
把所有東西都關掉之後，我發現最耗電的，是我對舒適的渴望。

en.content:
After the summer bill arrived, I began a gradual decluttering.
First, turn off the lights.
Then the TV.
Then the AC.
Finally, sitting there still breathing in total darkness, I quietly thought:
'Honestly, even this breath of mine kind of counts as using power.'
en.editorNote: For the fellow saver who wants to yank every plug in the house — and power themselves off too — the second the bill lands
variations: The end of saving power isn't switching off appliances. It's switching off the you who keeps wanting the AC.
After turning everything off, I realized the biggest power drain was my own craving for comfort.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季高溫新聞：中南部體感逼近 40 度、大台北盆地高溫燈號；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
氣象主播說：「今天體感溫度四十度。」
我腦中自動跑出翻譯字幕：
「今天冷氣要開十小時，換算大概一百二十塊。」
以前聽氣象是看要不要帶傘，
現在聽氣象，是在對帳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每天看氣溫預報都會下意識心算電費的同事
variations: 現在的氣象預報對我來說不是天氣，是報價單。
體感溫度每升高一度，我的體感存款就少一格。

en.content:
The weather anchor says: 'Feels like 104 today.'
My brain auto-generates subtitles:
'That's ten hours of AC, roughly four bucks.'
I used to check the forecast to decide on an umbrella.
Now I check it to reconcile my budget.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who mentally converts every forecast into dollars before breakfast
variations: The forecast stopped being weather to me. It's a price quote now.
Every degree the heat index climbs, my felt bank balance drops a bar.

items.sourceNote: 台電說明：住宅平均月電費由非夏月 638 元升至夏月 1084 元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說，一般家庭夏天電費平均從六百多變成一千出頭。
我看著自己手上那張帳單，
忽然覺得它很努力，也很孤獨——
它一個人，就把全國平均往上拉了一點點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個帳單金額永遠超出新聞平均值、還被家人念的人
variations: 所謂平均，就是有人幫你分擔數字，而我顯然是被分擔的那個。
我家的帳單不是超標，它是在為統計學做出貢獻。

en.content:
The news says the average summer power bill went from about sixty bucks to just over a hundred.
I looked at the bill in my hand
and suddenly felt for it — so hardworking, so alone.
All by itself, it nudged the national average up a little.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose bill blows past every 'average' figure in the news and gets a lecture about it at dinner
variations: An average means someone's carrying the number down for you. Clearly I'm not that someone.
My bill isn't over the limit. It's contributing to statistics.

items.sourceNote: 專家教冷氣設定一招三個月可省約 1296 元電費的報導；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說，冷氣多按一個鍵，三個月可以省一千兩百多塊。
我立刻照做，然後認真計算：
一千兩百塊除以九十天，
一天十四塊。
剛好是我熱到受不了、跑去便利商店買的那罐冰紅茶。
所以我省下的，是一個循環。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個努力執行所有省電攻略、卻發現錢從別的地方漏光的朋友
variations: 省電攻略的效果都是真的，只是它們沒算到我會因為太熱而多花的錢。
我省下的電費，最後都變成便利商店的冰櫃業績。

en.content:
An expert said one extra button on the AC saves about forty bucks over three months.
I did it immediately, then did the math:
forty bucks over ninety days
is about forty cents a day.
Exactly what I spend on the iced tea I buy when the heat breaks me.
So what I saved was a loop.
en.editorNote: For the friend who follows every energy-saving hack and still watches the money leak out somewhere else
variations: Every saving tip works. None of them account for what I spend because I'm too hot.
The money I saved on power all ended up in the convenience store cooler.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣不必固定 26 度、建議室內外溫差不超過 8 度的專家建議；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家：「室內外溫差不要超過八度。」
我很配合，外面三十六度，我開二十八度。
身體確實沒有不舒服。
不舒服的是心情——
因為我跟月初那個還有存款的自己，溫差已經超過八千。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個乖乖照專家建議設定溫度、帳單還是不留情面的人
variations: 溫差八度我做得到，價差八百我做不到。
我跟外面的溫差控制得很好，跟錢包的落差完全失控。

en.content:
Expert: 'Keep the indoor-outdoor gap under fifteen degrees.'
I complied. It's 97 outside, so I set it to 82.
My body genuinely feels fine.
What doesn't feel fine is my mood —
because the gap between me and the version of me who had savings on the first of the month is way past fifteen.
en.editorNote: For the person who followed the recommended setting to the letter and got no mercy from the bill anyway
variations: I can handle a fifteen-degree gap. It's the three-figure gap I can't.
My temperature gap is perfectly managed. My wallet gap is in free fall.

items.sourceNote: 遠端工作／在家上班使日間冷氣電費轉嫁到員工的角度；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前我超羨慕可以遠端工作的人，覺得他們自由。
現在我懂了：公司省下的那八小時冷氣電費，一塊都沒少，全部轉進我家的帳單。
遠端工作最大的隱藏成本，不是孤獨，
是六月到九月，我用自己的電，替公司的冷氣省了錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在家上班、白天冷氣從開機開到下班的同事，一起認清真相
variations: 在家工作的自由，是用你自己家的電表換來的。
公司關掉一盞燈叫節能減碳，我在家開一整天冷氣叫自費上班。

en.content:
I used to envy people who got to work from home. So free, I thought.
Now I get it: the eight hours of AC the office saves? Not a cent lost — it all just moved onto my bill.
The biggest hidden cost of remote work isn't loneliness.
It's June through September, cooling my apartment on my own dime so the company doesn't have to.
en.editorNote: Send to the WFH friend whose AC runs from clock-in to clock-out on their personal meter
variations: The freedom of working from home is paid for by your own electric meter.
The office turning off one light is 'sustainability'. Me running AC all day at home is 'paying to go to work'.

items.sourceNote: 換電動車以為省油錢、夏天卻被冷氣電費抵銷的角度；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我換了電動車，本來很得意，想說終於不用被油價綁架了。
夏天一到才發現：
每個月省下來的油錢，剛好拿去付冷氣多出來的電費。
地球是圓的，我的錢包也是——
轉了一大圈，最後停在原點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為換電動車就能省錢、結果被夏月電價一次追平的人
variations: 省下的油錢和多繳的電費，在我家帳單上握了個手，說聲彼此彼此。
我不是不省錢，我只是把加油站的錢，改繳給台電而已。

en.content:
I switched to an electric car, feeling pretty smug — finally free from gas prices.
Then summer hit.
Every dollar I saved at the pump goes straight to the extra AC on my bill.
The earth is round, and so is my wallet —
after a full loop, it lands right back where it started.
en.editorNote: For the person who thought going electric meant saving money, until summer rates evened the score
variations: My gas savings and my AC overage shook hands on the bill and called it even.
I didn't stop spending. I just moved the money from the gas station to the power company.

items.sourceNote: 遊戲電腦本身發熱、反而讓冷氣更操的雙輸角度；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我的電腦跑遊戲的時候，會把整個房間變成一台暖爐。
所以夏天的我，一邊開冷氣拼命降溫，一邊開電腦拼命升溫。
兩台機器在我房間裡對打，
戰場是我，賠款也是我付。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一邊打電動一邊開冷氣、帳單直接翻倍的遊戲同好
variations: 我房間裡有兩個高耗電怪物，一個負責製冷，一個負責發熱，然後互相加班。
顯示卡愈跑愈熱，冷氣愈開愈涼，中間那個一直付錢的是我。

en.content:
When my PC runs a game, it turns the whole room into a space heater.
So summer me is cranking the AC to cool down while cranking the PC to heat up.
Two machines duking it out in my bedroom —
I'm the battlefield, and I'm the one paying the damages.
en.editorNote: Send to the gamer buddy whose bill doubled from running a rig and the AC at the same time
variations: Two power-hungry monsters in one room: one makes cold, one makes heat, and they both bill me overtime.
The graphics card gets hotter, the AC gets colder, and the guy in the middle just keeps paying.

items.sourceNote: 把冷氣比喻成夏天唯一不敢取消的訂閱制；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
串流平台我看膩了可以隨時退訂，健身房我懶了可以停會籍。
只有冷氣，是我整個夏天唯一不敢取消的訂閱制。
而且它最狠的地方是——
六月自動幫我升級成尊爵不凡的夏月方案，漲價從來不先問過我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個手機一堆訂閱都砍過一輪、只有冷氣砍不下去的朋友
variations: 人生所有訂閱制我都能斷捨離，只有冷氣這一項，退訂等於中暑。
冷氣是那種你明知道每期都在漲、卻連猶豫期都不敢用的訂閱。

en.content:
I can cancel a streaming service the second I'm bored, freeze a gym membership when I get lazy.
AC is the one subscription I don't dare cancel all summer.
And here's the brutal part —
come June it auto-upgrades me to the premium summer tier, and it never once asks before it raises the price.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's trimmed every subscription on their phone except the one that keeps them from heatstroke
variations: I can Marie Kondo every subscription in my life — except this one, where canceling equals heatstroke.
AC is the subscription you know is hiking the price every cycle, yet you don't even use the grace period.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣睡眠定時模式半夜關機熱醒；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
睡前我很有骨氣地設了冷氣睡眠定時，三小時後自動關，跟自己說這樣省電。
凌晨三點，冷氣準時熄火，我準時被熱醒。
我在黑暗裡伸手把它按回去的那一刻突然懂了——
所謂睡眠模式，省的不是電，是我對「一覺到天亮」的所有幻想。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每晚都在設定時、每晚都在半夜手動開回去的室友
variations: 冷氣睡眠定時的意思是：先讓你睡三小時，再用一場汗把你叫醒收尾。
設定時省電這招唯一的成果，是我現在每天凌晨三點都會準時醒來跟冷氣搏鬥一次。

en.content:
Before bed I bravely set the AC sleep timer — off after three hours, told myself it'd save money.
3 a.m. sharp: the AC shuts off, and I wake up sweating right on schedule.
Reaching out in the dark to switch it back on, it finally hit me —
sleep mode doesn't save electricity, it saves me from ever believing I'll sleep through the night again.
en.editorNote: Send to the roommate who sets the timer every night and turns it back on at 3 a.m. every night
variations: The AC sleep timer means: let you sleep three hours, then wake you up with a full-body sweat for the finale.
The only result of my timer trick is that I now wake up at 3 a.m. every night to wrestle the AC back on.

items.sourceNote: 小孩放暑假在家整天吹冷氣電費暴漲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前我以為暑假是小孩放假，後來才知道，是我家冷氣開始上工。
他們不上學的每一天，冷氣就從早開到晚，一秒都沒歇過。
開學那天我送小孩進校門，回頭看著空掉的客廳，第一次覺得——
學校收的不是學費，是幫我省下的那半個月電費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個天天盼開學、比小孩還期待的家長朋友
variations: 暑假兩個月，小孩在家長大，冷氣在家全力運轉，帳單在信箱默默集氣。
別人數暑假還剩幾天，我數的是我家冷氣還要連續加班幾天。

en.content:
I used to think summer break was for the kids. Turns out it's when my AC clocks in for its shift.
Every day they're not in school, that unit runs from morning to night without a single break.
On the first day of the new term I dropped them at the gate, looked back at the empty living room, and realized —
school isn't charging tuition, it's the two weeks of electricity it saves me.
en.editorNote: For the parent friend who counts down to the first day of school more eagerly than the kids do
variations: Two months of break: the kids grow up at home, the AC runs full blast, the bill quietly powers up in the mailbox.
Other people count how many days of summer are left. I count how many more days my AC has to pull overtime.

items.sourceNote: 改洗冷水澡消暑省冷氣費；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了少開一點冷氣，我改成睡前沖個冷水澡消暑。
涼快維持了整整十五分鐘，然後我又開始流汗，只好再去沖一次。
一個晚上沖三次，水費默默往上爬。
我這才明白，省電費最貴的方法，是把它偷偷轉嫁到水費頭上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為不開冷氣就是省錢、結果被水費反殺的省錢魂
variations: 冷水澡的涼，撐不過一集電視劇，然後你就得再去洗一次。
我沒有少花錢，我只是把冷氣的帳，轉了一手記到自來水公司名下。

en.content:
To run the AC a little less, I switched to a cold shower before bed to cool off.
The cool lasted a solid fifteen minutes, then I started sweating again, so I took another one.
Three showers a night, and the water bill quietly creeps up.
That's when I got it: the priciest way to save on electricity is to secretly pass the cost over to the water bill.
en.editorNote: For the budget soul who thought skipping AC meant saving, then got ambushed by the water bill
variations: A cold shower's chill doesn't outlast one episode of a show, and then you're back in the bathroom.
I didn't spend less. I just moved the AC's tab over and charged it to the water company instead.

items.sourceNote: 頂樓水泥屋頂可達 60 度、西曬冷房需求多 20-30% register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
別人開冷氣是為了涼，我住頂樓，開冷氣是為了活。
頭頂那片水泥屋頂，白天被曬到六十度，晚上再慢慢把熱釋放給我，像一台我沒訂購的暖爐。
所以我付的不是電費，是跟太陽的贖身費。
