zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給每個住頂樓加蓋、冷氣開整天房間還是不涼的難友
variations: 西曬房的冷氣，設 26 度只是它的夢想，實際上它連 30 度都達不到。
頂樓的終極省電攻略只有一條——搬到二樓。

en.content:
Normal people run the AC to feel cool. I live on the top floor, so I run it to stay alive.
The concrete roof over my head bakes to 140°F by day and slowly radiates it all back at me by night, like a space heater I never ordered.
What I pay isn't an electric bill. It's ransom to the sun.
en.editorNote: For anyone in a top-floor unit whose AC runs all day and the room still won't cool
variations: Setting my west-facing room to 79°F is the AC's dream. In reality it can't even hit 86.
The only real energy-saving tip for a top-floor apartment: move to the second floor.

items.sourceNote: 租屋族移動式冷氣免安裝評比 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
租的房子不能裝分離式，我買了一台移動式冷氣，滿心期待。
結果它一邊從前面吐冷風給我，一邊從後面那條粗管子，把熱氣排到——也是我房間的另一頭。
我等於花錢，請了一台人格分裂的機器。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給不能裝冷氣、只能靠一台移動式冷氣硬撐整個夏天的租屋族
variations: 移動式冷氣最誠實的地方，是它連涼快都要先讓你聽一整晚它有多努力。
它叫「移動式」，但夏天一到，它就一步都不肯離開，跟我一起蹲在房間唯一涼的那個角落。

en.content:
My lease won't allow a wall unit, so I bought a portable AC, full of hope.
It blows cold air at my face from the front while its fat exhaust hose dumps hot air out the back — into the other end of the same room.
Basically I paid good money for a machine with a split personality.
en.editorNote: For renters who can't install real AC and are toughing out summer on a single portable unit
variations: The most honest thing about a portable AC is that it makes you listen to how hard it's working all night before it hands over any cool.
They call it 'portable', but come summer it won't move an inch — it just squats in the one cool corner with me.

items.sourceNote: 夏季電費省電懶人包、長輩省電觀念 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
阿嬤說：「我們以前哪有冷氣，一把扇子搧一搧，不也活到現在。」
我說：「阿嬤，那是因為妳們以前的夏天，沒有現在這麼熱。」
阿嬤搧著扇子，看了一眼窗外三十八度的太陽，沉默了。
那一刻，我們隔著兩個世代，一起認命。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一開冷氣就被長輩念、但長輩自己也快中暑的家庭
variations: 長輩的省電哲學，是建立在一個比較涼的地球上，而那個地球，已經不在了。
阿嬤的扇子搧的不是風，是一整個沒有冷氣也活得下去的年代。

en.content:
Grandma says, 'We never had AC back in the day. A hand fan, a few waves, and we survived just fine.'
I say, 'Grandma, that's because summers back then weren't this hot.'
She fans herself, glances at the 100°F sun outside the window, and goes quiet.
Just like that, two generations sit and accept our fate together.
en.editorNote: For the household where opening the AC earns a lecture from an elder who's also quietly overheating
variations: An elder's frugal wisdom was built on a cooler planet — and that planet is gone.
Grandma's fan isn't moving air. It's moving a whole era that could survive without AC.

items.sourceNote: 夏季電價計算、中央空調冷氣費隱藏於管理費 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友住那種有中央空調的大樓，冷氣費全灌在管理費裡，看不到度數，也拆不開帳單。
我原本很羨慕，後來才懂：
他不是不用付冷氣錢，他只是被溫柔地矇著眼付。
看得見的痛，跟看不見的痛，我不知道哪種比較好，但至少我的，有明細。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個常嫌管理費貴、卻永遠說不清貴在哪裡的大樓住戶
variations: 把冷氣費藏進管理費，是溫水煮青蛙的高級版——你連水什麼時候變燙的都不知道。
有明細的帳單，至少讓我痛得清楚；沒明細的，是連該恨誰都不知道。

en.content:
A friend lives in one of those buildings with central AC, where the cooling cost is folded into the HOA fee — no meter reading, no line item you can pull apart.
I used to be jealous. Then I understood:
he isn't skipping the AC bill. He's just paying it blindfolded, very gently.
Visible pain versus invisible pain — I'm not sure which is better, but at least mine comes itemized.
en.editorNote: For the condo dweller who gripes the HOA fee is high but can never say exactly why
variations: Burying the AC cost in the HOA fee is the deluxe version of boiling a frog — you never even feel the water turn hot.
At least an itemized bill lets me hurt with clarity. The un-itemized kind won't even tell me who to blame.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價與冷氣使用討論；冷氣本質是把室內熱能排到室外，都市密集住宅互相排熱；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
冷氣其實不會製造涼，它只是把屋裡的熱，搬到屋外去。
昨晚我站在巷子裡等外送，聽見整排室外機轟轟作響，每一台都在往外吐熱風。
所以我的涼，是鄰居的熱；鄰居的涼，是我的熱。
我們一起花錢，把同一團熱推來推去，最後推出一條比誰家客廳都還要燙的巷子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個窗戶正對別人家室外機、整個夏天一開窗就等於開暖氣的朋友
variations: 冷氣的工作內容不是降溫，是搬家——把你房間的熱，搬到你鄰居的窗戶下面。
整條巷子的室外機一起轉的時候，我們不是在對抗夏天，我們是在集資把夏天加熱。

en.content:
AC doesn't actually make cold. It just moves the heat from inside your place to outside.
Last night I stood in the alley waiting for a delivery and heard every condenser on the block roaring, all of them exhaling hot air outward.
So my cool is my neighbor's heat, and my neighbor's cool is mine.
We're all paying money to shove the same heat back and forth, until the alley ends up hotter than any living room on it.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose window faces someone else's condenser unit, where opening it all summer is basically running a heater
variations: An AC's job description isn't cooling. It's moving — relocating your heat to a spot under your neighbor's window.
When every condenser on the street runs at once, we aren't fighting summer. We're crowdfunding it.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏月電價 6/1-9/30、住宅平均每月電費增加約 446 元；延伸到繳費與分期情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我打去台電，很客氣地問：「請問這期電費，可以分期嗎？」
客服也很客氣，一步一步跟我說明可以怎麼辦。
掛掉電話我才發現，我真正想分期的其實不是那筆錢——
是六月一號到今天，我每天伸手按下遙控器的那幾百個瞬間。
可惜那個沒得分期，它一次就跟我結清了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到帳單金額後，第一個念頭是打去問「可不可以慢慢還」的夏日戰友
variations: 電費可以分期，後悔不行——後悔是一次付清，而且不接受刷卡。
我不是繳不出這筆錢，我只是希望有人願意讓我，把整個六月分成十二期慢慢還。

en.content:
I called the power company and politely asked, 'Can I pay this bill in installments?'
The rep was just as polite and walked me through exactly how.
Only after hanging up did I realize the thing I actually wanted to pay off slowly wasn't the money.
It was the few hundred moments since June first when I reached over and hit the remote.
Those don't come in installments. They settled up with me all at once.
en.editorNote: For the summer comrade whose first instinct on seeing the total is to ask whether they can pay it off slowly
variations: The bill can be split into installments. The regret can't — that one is due in full, cash only.
It's not that I can't cover it. I just wish someone would let me pay off the entire month of June over twelve months.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價上路後民眾各種迴避開冷氣行為；延伸為車內冷氣情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
下班開回大樓地下室，我沒有馬上上樓。
我坐在車裡，冷氣開到最強，音樂放著，多待了十五分鐘。
理由很單純：這台冷氣，不算在我家那顆電表裡。
直到油表默默跳了一格，我才想通——
我沒有省到錢，我只是把電費換成了油費，然後多付了一份，在停車場裡一個人吹冷氣的孤獨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個到家了卻不想上樓、寧願在車上多坐十分鐘的通勤族
variations: 在車上吹冷氣不會出現在電費帳單上，它會出現在加油站，而且更貴。
所謂省電，就是把同一筆錢，換一個比較不痛的名字繳出去。

en.content:
I got back to the building's underground garage after work and didn't go straight up.
I sat in the car with the AC on max and the music going, for a solid fifteen extra minutes.
The logic was simple: this AC doesn't run through my apartment's meter.
Then the fuel gauge ticked down a notch and it clicked —
I didn't save anything. I just converted the electric bill into a gas bill, plus a surcharge for sitting alone in a parking garage.
en.editorNote: For the commuter who gets home and still doesn't want to go upstairs yet
variations: Running the car AC never shows up on the power bill. It shows up at the gas station, and it costs more.
Saving electricity mostly means paying the same money again under a name that hurts less.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電費上路後網路討論熱度；延伸為朋友群組互貼帳單情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友群組這幾天多了一個固定節目：貼帳單截圖。
兩千一。兩千八。三千四。
有人貼出四千二的時候，群組安靜了三秒，然後所有人開始安慰他。
那一刻我才發現，我們不是在比誰最慘，
我們是在確認——原來這麼痛的不只我一個。而那個第一名，是我們今年夏天共同的英雄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼進那個開始互相曬電費金額的朋友群組，順便替目前最高分的那位默哀
variations: 夏天的朋友群組沒有炫富，只有炫慘，而且大家都很真誠地在鼓掌。
看到別人的帳單比我高的那一秒，我的痛沒有減少，但我的孤單有。

en.content:
My group chat has a new recurring segment this week: posting screenshots of the bill.
Seventy bucks. Ninety. A hundred and ten.
When someone dropped a hundred and forty, the chat went quiet for three seconds, then everybody started comforting him.
That's when it hit me — we aren't competing over who has it worst.
We're confirming that it hurts this much for other people too. And whoever's in first place is our shared hero for the summer.
en.editorNote: Drop into the group chat that's started swapping bill totals, and pour one out for the current record holder
variations: Summer group chats don't flex wealth. They flex damage, and everyone claps sincerely.
The second I see a bill higher than mine, the pain doesn't shrink. The loneliness does.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價 6/1 上路、住宅兩月一期抄表，首張帳單僅部分落在夏月；七月下旬起才是完整夏月帳單；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上一期帳單其實只吃到夏月電價的一半，我還天真地說：「欸，也還好嘛。」
這一期不一樣，整整兩個月，一天都沒漏，全部照夏月的價錢收。
我這才懂——上一張根本不是帳單，是預告片。
而預告片的功能，就是讓你以為自己看得起這部電影。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七月下旬拆開第一張完整夏月帳單時傳出去，給所有以為上個月就是極限的人
variations: 上一張帳單是試閱版，這一張才是完整版，而且沒有退訂選項。
我以為六月那張已經是谷底，結果它只是入口，門票還特價。

en.content:
The last bill only caught about half of the summer rate period, and I naively said, 'Eh, that's not so bad.'
This one is different. Two full months, not a single day missed, every unit charged at summer pricing.
That's when I got it — the last one wasn't a bill. It was a trailer.
And the whole point of a trailer is to make you think you can afford the movie.
en.editorNote: Send this in late July, when the first fully-summer bill lands on everyone who thought last month was the worst of it
variations: The last bill was the free preview. This one is the full version, and there's no cancel button.
I thought June's bill was rock bottom. Turns out it was the entrance, and the ticket was discounted.

items.sourceNote: 台電省電招數：冷氣出風口朝上，冷空氣會下沉；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電說：「冷氣出風口記得朝上，冷空氣會自己往下沉，整間才會涼得均勻。」
我震驚了。
原來這幾年，我一直把出風口對準自己的臉狂吹，
以為離風越近越涼，其實只是把電費集中吹在鼻子上。
人生也是，越想抓住的，越要先放手往上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個夏天永遠把冷氣對著自己吹、還怪冷氣不夠力的室友
variations: 冷空氣會下沉，所以最聰明的吹法，是把風送去它根本不想去的地方——這件事我懂得太晚。
把出風口朝上那天，我涼了，也悟了：對著自己猛吹的，從來都不是最省的活法。

en.content:
Taipower says: 'Point the AC vents upward — cold air sinks on its own, so the whole room cools evenly.'
I was floored.
All these years I'd been aiming it straight at my own face, thinking closer meant cooler.
Turns out I was just spraying the entire bill onto my nose.
Life's the same: what you grasp at hardest, you have to let float up first.
en.editorNote: Send to the roommate who aims the AC at their own face all summer, then blames it for being weak
variations: Cold air sinks, so the smartest move is to send the wind somewhere it doesn't even want to go. Took me way too long.
The day I tilted the vents up, I got cooler and I got wiser: blasting it straight at yourself was never the cheap way to live.

items.sourceNote: 專家：別固定 26 度，改用相對溫差；外面越熱設定跟著調；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說：「冷氣不用死守 26 度，要看外面幾度，用相對溫差來設。」
於是我現在每次開冷氣前，都要先出門用臉量一下氣溫，
再回來調遙控器。
我沒有買到更省的冷氣，
我只是把自己升級成一台會流汗的氣象站。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了省那 6% 電、每天研究溫差研究到走火入魔的家人
variations: 自從改用相對溫差，我對室外溫度的敏感度，已經超過我對薪水入帳的敏感度。
氣象局有百葉箱，我家有我。差別是百葉箱不用付電費。

en.content:
The expert says: 'Don't cling to 78°F — set the AC by the outdoor temperature, using relative difference.'
So now, before switching it on, I step outside and gauge the heat with my face,
then come back and adjust the remote.
I didn't buy a more efficient AC.
I just upgraded myself into a weather station that sweats.
en.editorNote: For the family member who got so obsessed with temperature-difference math they lost the plot chasing that 6%
variations: Ever since I switched to relative-difference mode, I'm more sensitive to outdoor temperature than I am to payday.
The weather bureau has a measuring station. My house has me. The difference is the station doesn't pay the bill.

items.sourceNote: 大暑一年最熱 台電教省電、6 家電待機耗電快關；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
大暑，一年裡最熱的節氣。
台電貼心提醒：「有六樣家電最好隨手關掉，能省不少待機電。」
我認真對照清單：電視、機上盒、電腦、開飲機、微波爐、路由器。
關掉之後我才發現，
這六樣，剛好就是我一整個人的生活。
所以省電的意思是，叫我把自己也關機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個大暑當天邊擦汗邊研究「到底哪台可以關」的你
variations: 台電叫我關六樣家電。我照做了，現在家裡最耗電、又關不掉的那台，是我。
最熱的一天，收到最貼心的提醒：關掉你所有的快樂來源，就能省電了。

en.content:
Great Heat — the hottest solar term of the year.
Taipower kindly reminds me: 'Six appliances are best switched off to cut standby power.'
I check the list carefully: TV, set-top box, computer, water dispenser, microwave, router.
After unplugging them, I realized
those six things are, basically, my entire life.
So 'save power' really means: please power yourself down too.
en.editorNote: For the you who spent the hottest day of the year wiping sweat and deciding which box was safe to kill
variations: Taipower told me to switch off six appliances. I did. Now the most power-hungry thing left that won't turn off is me.
Hottest day of the year, kindest reminder of the year: unplug every source of joy and you'll save a little.

items.sourceNote: 住宅累進費率：用愈多每度愈貴；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
住宅電費是累進的：你用得越多，每一度就算你越貴。
我終於懂了，這是全世界唯一一款
「你越痛苦、關卡就越難」的遊戲。
天氣越熱，我越需要冷氣；冷氣開越久，電價爬越高。
別人打怪是越打越強，
我是越熱越窮，還沒有存檔點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年夏天都不小心衝上最高級距、然後對著帳單懷疑人生的朋友
variations: 累進電價的邏輯是：你越需要它，它就越貴。聽起來很渣，但它是我夏天唯一的依靠。
這遊戲沒有難度選項，因為難度是隨著氣溫自動上調的。

en.content:
Home electricity is progressive: the more you use, the more each unit costs you.
I finally get it — this is the only game in the world
where the more you suffer, the harder the level gets.
The hotter it is, the more I need the AC; the longer it runs, the higher the rate climbs.
Other people grind monsters and get stronger.
I just get hotter and broker, with no save point in sight.
en.editorNote: For the friend who accidentally hits the top tier every summer, then stares at the bill questioning everything
variations: Progressive pricing logic: the more you need it, the more it charges you. Sounds toxic, but it's my only summer support.
This game has no difficulty setting, because the difficulty auto-scales with the temperature.

items.sourceNote: 26 度其實是商場寫字樓的公共節能標準，非住家標準；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
後來我才知道，冷氣「設 26 度最省電」這句話，
本來是給商場、辦公大樓那種公共空間訂的節能標準。
問題是——
我家不是商場，我也不是來上班的，
我只是想在自己家，涼得有尊嚴一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被『26 度神話』綁架、熱到睡不著還不敢調低的室友
variations: 26 度是寫字樓的規矩，不是你家的家規。你在自己家，溫度你說了算。
別人叫你守 26 度的時候，記得問一句：那是你要繳電費，還是我要繳？

en.content:
Turns out '26°C is the most efficient setting' was originally
a public-energy guideline written for malls and office towers.
Problem is —
my home isn't a mall, and I'm not clocking in for a shift.
I just want to be cool with a little dignity, in my own house.
en.editorNote: For the roommate held hostage by the '26 degrees' myth, sweating through the night, afraid to touch the dial
variations: 26°C is an office-tower rule, not your house rule. In your own home, you set the temperature.
When someone tells you to hold 26, ask them one thing: are you paying this bill, or am I?

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電價漲幅史上最高、最高級距約 26%；與冷氣 26 度做雙關；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今年夏天，我的人生被兩個「26」夾殺。
一個是台電說最省電的冷氣 26 度，
一個是新聞說史上最高的電價漲幅 26%。
我照著第一個 26 乖乖設定，
還是躲不過第二個 26 的追殺。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在冷氣遙控器旁邊，給每個乖乖守 26 度卻還是被帳單背刺的人
variations: 設 26 度救得了電量，救不了漲幅——這兩個 26，一個要我忍，一個要我痛。
我以為守住 26 度就沒事了，結果另一個 26 從帳單後面繞過來偷襲。

en.content:
This summer, my life got squeezed between two '26's.
One is the AC set to 26°C — the 'most efficient' number.
The other is the rate hike: a record-high 26%.
I obeyed the first 26 to the letter,
and still couldn't outrun the second one.
en.editorNote: Stick it by the remote — for everyone who held the line at 26 degrees and got backstabbed by the bill anyway
variations: Setting 26 saves your usage, not the hike. Two 26s: one asks you to endure, the other makes you hurt.
I thought holding 26 degrees would keep me safe. The other 26 snuck around the back of the bill.

items.sourceNote: 一般家庭夏天電費比平常月多約 400-500 元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
報導說，夏天一般家庭電費會比平常月多個四五百塊。
四五百，聽起來好像還好。
但那是每個月，一路多到九月底，
而且是我用汗水、失眠跟一整季的忍耐，親手換來的「優惠價」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個安慰你『才多四五百而已』的人，讓他看看這四五百的重量
variations: 四五百不是多，是一張我每個月都要重簽一次的隱形合約。
別人的四五百是一頓飯，我的四五百是整個夏天的贖身費。

en.content:
The report says a typical household pays about 400 to 500 more each summer month.
Four or five hundred — sounds manageable, right?
Except it's every month, all the way to the end of September,
and it's the 'discount price' I paid in sweat, insomnia, and a whole season of holding back.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who comforts you with 'it's only a few hundred more' — show them what those few hundred weigh
variations: It's not just a few hundred extra. It's an invisible contract I re-sign every single month.
For other people, five hundred is a nice dinner. For me, it's the ransom for surviving summer.

items.sourceNote: 累進電價與時間無關的迷思、網路上人人爭論冷氣溫度；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天一到，網路上就會多出一種人：冷氣溫度專家。
有人堅持 26 度，有人力推 28 度，還有人半夜跳出來說『要開整晚才省』。
吵了三千樓，結論只有一個——
每個人都很會省別人家的電。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在那種每年都會為了冷氣幾度吵翻天的家族群組或論壇串
variations: 網路上省電高手很多，可惜他們省的都不是自己家的帳單。
冷氣溫度的戰爭，唯一的贏家是那台默默轉著的壓縮機。

en.content:
Every summer, the internet grows a new species: the AC temperature expert.
One swears by 26, another pushes 28, and someone always shows up at midnight insisting 'leave it on all night to save.'
Three thousand replies later, there's only one conclusion —
everyone's an expert at saving someone else's electricity.
en.editorNote: Drop it into the family group chat or forum thread that erupts over AC temperature every single year
variations: The internet is full of energy-saving geniuses. Shame none of them are saving their own bill.
In the war over AC temperature, the only winner is the compressor quietly spinning in the corner.

items.sourceNote: 2026 十大吃電怪獸 冷氣冰箱排名新聞；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞公布「夏季十大吃電怪獸」，冷氣不意外奪冠。
我看著排行榜，心裡卻很平靜：
這些怪獸我一隻都打不贏，因為牠們住在我家，而我，是那個每個月付贖金的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配一張家裡電器全開的照片，發在被電費榨乾的朋友群組
variations: 別人打怪拿裝備，我在家打怪，怪贏了還要跟我收電費。
十大吃電怪獸的排行榜，其實就是我家的裝潢清單。

en.content:
The news released the 'Top 10 Power-Eating Monsters of Summer.' AC took first place, no surprise.
I stared at the ranking, strangely calm:
I can't beat a single one of these monsters — because they all live in my house, and I'm the one paying their ransom every month.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a photo of every appliance running at once; post to the group chat of the electricity-drained
variations: In games you fight monsters for loot. In my home I fight monsters, lose, and still get billed.
The 'Top 10 Power Monsters' list is basically my apartment's furniture inventory.

items.sourceNote: 夏季高溫 想逃去涼快國家的厭世玩笑；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
熱到快融化的時候，我認真研究了一下北歐。
那裡夏天二十度，不用開冷氣，電費便宜到像佛心。
然後我看了機票價格，默默把冷氣調低一度——
原來投胎到涼快的地方，也是要有本錢的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每逢夏天就喊著要移民的朋友，一起做白日夢
variations: 下輩子想投胎在需要開暖氣的國家，起碼夏天台電管不到我。
移民北歐的門票太貴，我只好用電費，買一張留在台灣的門票。

en.content:
Melting in the heat, I did some serious research on the Nordics.
Summers hover at 20°C there, no AC needed, electricity practically a charity.
Then I checked the airfare, quietly nudged my AC one degree colder —
turns out even being reborn somewhere cool takes money you don't have.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who threatens to emigrate every single summer — daydream together
variations: Next life I want to be born somewhere that needs a heater — at least summer won't cost me the power company.
A ticket to the Nordics is too pricey, so I just keep paying the electric bill: my ticket to stay put and suffer.

items.sourceNote: 手機低電量警示比喻荷包；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
手機電量剩 20%，會跳出黃色警告，叫我省著用。
夏天我的荷包也一直在跳警告，只是沒人幫它跳。
等我發現的時候，通常已經是紅色的 1%，
而冷氣，還在毫無罪惡感地吹。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配一張手機低電量截圖，發給每個月底都在省電模式過活的人
variations: 如果荷包也有低電量模式，我大概從六月一號就一直開著。
手機沒電可以充，荷包沒電只能等下個月薪水慢慢回血。

en.content:
At 20% battery my phone flashes yellow and begs me to conserve.
All summer my wallet flashes warnings too, except no one lights them up for me.
By the time I notice, it's usually the red 1% —
and the AC just keeps blowing, guilt-free.
en.editorNote: Pair with a low-battery screenshot; send to anyone living in power-saving mode by month's end
variations: If wallets had a low-power mode, mine's been stuck on since June 1st.
A dead phone you can recharge. A dead wallet just waits for next month's paycheck to slowly refill.

items.sourceNote: 地球暖化與冷氣的惡性循環反諷；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
因為地球太熱，所以我開冷氣。
因為我開冷氣，所以地球更熱。
因為地球更熱，所以我電費更貴。
這個循環唯一的出口，好像只有——我的存款先被熱死。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配一張溫度計爆表的照片，發在邊自責邊開冷氣的環保矛盾時刻
variations: 我一邊心疼地球，一邊心疼電費，最後兩個都救不了。
冷氣是我對抗暖化的武器，也是我親手加速暖化的證據。

en.content:
The planet's too hot, so I turn on the AC.
Because I run the AC, the planet gets hotter.
Because it's hotter, my bill gets bigger.
The only exit from this loop seems to be — my savings dying of heatstroke first.
en.editorNote: Pair with a maxed-out thermometer; post it during that guilty eco-moment of blasting the AC anyway
variations: I feel bad for the planet and bad for my bill, and end up saving neither.
The AC is my weapon against warming and the very proof I'm speeding it up.

items.sourceNote: 涼感衣涼感被小風扇等消暑小物越買越多；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了少開冷氣，我買了涼感衣、涼感被、USB 小風扇、退熱貼。
一個夏天下來，消暑小物的錢，剛好夠我把冷氣開好開滿。
我不是在省電，我只是把電費，換成一整櫃用不到明年的雜物。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配一張堆滿消暑小物的桌面，發給每年都被涼感商品燒到的自己
variations: 省電的第一步，是先花一筆錢買一堆宣稱能省電的東西。
涼感小物買到最後，最涼的其實是我的荷包。

en.content:
To use less AC, I bought a cooling shirt, a cooling blanket, a USB mini fan, and cooling patches.
By summer's end, the money spent on 'stay-cool' gadgets could've run the AC full blast the whole time.
I wasn't saving electricity — I just swapped the bill for a drawer of junk I won't touch till next year.
en.editorNote: Pair with a desk buried in cooling gadgets; for the you who falls for 'cooling' products every single year
variations: Step one of saving electricity: spend a fortune on stuff that claims to save electricity.
After all the cooling gadgets, the coolest thing in the room is my empty wallet.

items.sourceNote: 能源署實測冷氣除濕模式耗電約 1～2.1kW、除濕機僅 0.116kW，相差近十倍；有人開兩個月電費破萬。改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
「開除濕比開冷氣省電」這句話，我整整信了兩個月。
實測數字出來：冷氣的除濕模式一小時吃一到兩度，真正的除濕機只吃零點一度出頭，差了快十倍。
所以我這兩個月不是在除濕，我是在用全世界最貴的方式，把空氣裡的水，一滴一滴買回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那位堅持「除濕比較涼又比較省」的家人，附上這期帳單截圖效果更佳
variations: 除濕模式最厲害的地方，是讓你一邊流汗，一邊以為自己很會理財。
我房間的濕度降了一成，我的存款降了一半。

en.content:
"Dry mode uses way less power than cooling" — I believed that for two solid months.
Then the numbers landed: AC dry mode pulls one to two kilowatts an hour, while an actual dehumidifier pulls barely a tenth of that. Roughly ten times the difference.
So I wasn't dehumidifying for two months. I was buying the water out of my own air, one drop at a time, at premium rates.
en.editorNote: Send to the relative who swears dry mode is cooler and cheaper; attach the bill for full effect
variations: The genius of dry mode is that you sweat and feel financially responsible at the same time.
My humidity dropped ten percent. My savings dropped fifty.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏月電價六月至九月，颱風天在家整日用電情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
宣布放颱風假的那一刻，公司群組一片歡呼，我也跟著發了三個貼圖。
開心維持到隔天中午，我才想通一件事：原本那八小時該由公司負擔的冷氣，今天全部記在我家的電表上。
颱風放的是我的假，不放的是我的帳單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 颱風天窩在家吹冷氣時發限動，配一張窗外風雨的照片
variations: 颱風假的隱藏費用：一整天的冷氣，加一頓貴兩倍的外送。
風雨越大，我越不敢出門；越不敢出門，冷氣就開得越久。

en.content:
The second the typhoon day got announced, the work chat erupted. I threw in three celebration stickers myself.
The joy lasted until noon the next day, when it hit me: those eight hours of AC my office normally pays for are now billed straight to my meter.
The typhoon gave me the day off. It did not give my bill the day off.
en.editorNote: Post while riding out a storm day indoors with the AC on, over a shot of the rain outside
variations: Hidden cost of a typhoon day: a full day of AC plus delivery at double the fee.
The harder it storms, the less I go out — and the longer that AC runs.

items.sourceNote: 遮陽隔熱可降低冷氣負載的省電建議；西曬房情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我的房間西曬，每天下午三點準時變成一座窯。
為了對抗它，我買了遮光窗簾、隔熱紙，還有一整捲貼在玻璃上的銀色泡棉。
現在我房間白天像防空洞，晚上也像防空洞，但冷氣終於不用一直全力跑。
西曬房的租金比較便宜，原來是房東把那筆差價，先幫我付給台電了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合租到西曬房的人；配一張貼滿隔熱材的窗戶特寫
variations: 我不是在裝潢，我是在跟太陽談判，而且籌碼只有一捲泡棉。
花錢把家變醜，只為了少花一點錢——這就是西曬房住戶的日常。

en.content:
My room faces west. Every day at three sharp it turns into a kiln.
To fight back I bought blackout curtains, window film, and a whole roll of silver foam taped to the glass.
Now my room looks like a bunker by day and a bunker by night, but at least the compressor gets a break.
West-facing units rent cheaper — turns out the landlord just forwarded that discount to the power company on my behalf.
en.editorNote: For anyone stuck in a west-facing rental; pair with a close-up of foil-covered windows
variations: I'm not decorating. I'm negotiating with the sun, and my only leverage is a roll of foam.
Spending money to make my apartment uglier so I can spend slightly less money. West-facing life.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價期間為寵物整日開冷氣的常見情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
出門前我固定做兩件事：跟貓說掰掰，然後把冷氣留給牠。
所以我家夏天的分工是這樣的：牠負責涼，我負責熱，順便負責付錢。
我不是牠的主人，我是牠的房東，兼台電代繳窗口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 為毛小孩開整天冷氣的鏟屎官專用，配一張牠攤在涼墊上的照片
variations: 這個夏天，我的貓過得比我涼，也比我貴。
牠一天在家躺八小時，我一天在外面曬八小時，帳單寄給我。

en.content:
Two things I do before leaving the house: say bye to the cat, and leave the AC running for her.
So the summer division of labor at my place is: she stays cool, I stay hot, and I also handle payment.
I'm not her owner. I'm her landlord, doubling as her utility billing department.
en.editorNote: For every pet parent running the AC all day; pair with a shot of them sprawled on the cooling mat
variations: This summer my cat lives cooler than me and costs more than me.
She spends eight hours lying down indoors, I spend eight hours baking outdoors, and the bill comes to me.

items.sourceNote: 老屋門窗氣密不佳導致冷氣效率低落的省電討論；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
老公寓的窗戶，關到底還是留了一道縫。
我把手貼上去，感覺到冷氣正一絲一絲，往外面三十六度的世界逃跑。
那一刻我懂了：我付的電費裡，有一部分是拿去幫整條巷子降溫的。
後來我用膠帶把那道縫封起來，房間確實涼了，代價是那扇窗再也打不開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 租老屋的人專用；配一張貼滿膠帶的窗框
variations: 我家最大的漏財漏洞，不是溫度設太低，是那道關不緊的窗縫。
省電的最後一步，是把家封起來，順便把自己也一起封在裡面。

en.content:
In an old apartment, the window shuts all the way and still leaves a gap.
I put my hand over it and felt the cold air slipping out, thread by thread, into the 97-degree world outside.
That's when it clicked: part of my electric bill goes toward air-conditioning the entire alley.
I eventually taped the gap shut. The room got cooler. The window never opened again.
en.editorNote: For anyone renting an old place; pair with a photo of a taped-up window frame
variations: My biggest money leak isn't the thermostat setting. It's the window that won't quite close.
The final step of saving electricity is sealing up your home, and sealing yourself in with it.

items.sourceNote: 商周夏季電價專題與網友繳費討論；改寫成超商代收櫃台的原創場景

zh-tw.content:
我拿著兩個月的電費單走進超商，很豪氣地放在櫃台上：「這張，繳一下。」
店員刷完條碼，看了一下螢幕，語氣忽然變得很客氣：「不好意思，這個金額超過我們代收的上限，要麻煩您跑一趟銀行。」
後面排隊的人假裝專心看關東煮。
我人生第一次被一間便利商店禮貌地拒收，理由是我今年夏天，涼得太超過了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合拆完夏季帳單、金額誇張到自己都想笑的那天；配一張帳單照或超商櫃台的手機視角
variations: 超商能代收水電、罰單、學費，唯一收不下的，是我兩個月的冷氣。
店員：「這張要去銀行繳。」我：「那我可以只繳一半嗎，另一半算它自己吹的。」

en.content:
I walked into the convenience store with my two-month electric bill like I owned the place. "Paying this one."
The clerk scanned it, glanced at the screen, and got very polite very fast: "Sorry, this amount is over our counter limit. You'll have to take it to the bank."
The guy behind me suddenly found the hot food case fascinating.
First time in my life a convenience store has turned me down, and the reason was that I'd been too comfortable all summer.
en.editorNote: For the day you open a summer bill so absurd you have to laugh; pair it with a photo of the bill
variations: That counter takes utilities, parking tickets, and tuition. The one thing it can't take is two months of my AC.
Clerk: "This one has to go to the bank." Me: "Can I pay half and bill the AC for the rest?"

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價上路後民眾外出避暑、減少在家開冷氣的行為討論；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
週末我又在咖啡廳坐了四個小時，桌上就一杯冰美式。
朋友問我為什麼不在家看書，家裡不是比較安靜？
安靜是真的，家裡的涼要另外付費也是真的。
那杯咖啡除以四小時，比我自己開冷氣划算太多。唯一的成本，是我得整個下午都維持一種「我真的有在忙」的表情，才配得上這張椅子的溫度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合咖啡廳打卡，或跟朋友解釋為什麼你整個夏天都不在家
variations: 一杯冰美式換四小時的涼，我點的不是咖啡，是這個座位的溫度。
夏天的咖啡廳賣的不是咖啡，是按小時計費的冷氣，還附贈 Wi-Fi。

en.content:
Spent another four hours at a coffee shop this weekend. One iced americano on the table.
A friend asked why I don't just read at home — isn't it quieter?
It is quieter. It's also warmer, and cool air at my place is a paid feature.
Divide that coffee by four hours and it undercuts my own AC by a mile. The only real cost is holding a "no really, I'm working" face all afternoon so I feel like I've earned the temperature of this chair.
en.editorNote: For a cafe check-in, or explaining to friends why you're never home in summer
variations: One iced coffee, four hours of cold air. I'm not buying a drink, I'm renting the temperature of a seat.
In summer a cafe isn't selling coffee. It's selling AC by the hour, Wi-Fi included.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣關機後風扇繼續運轉屬乾燥防霉功能、耗電極低的原廠說明；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
按下關機以後，冷氣的風扇還會自己慢慢轉個十幾分鐘。
它不是在賴帳，也不是在偷電。那是在把機體裡的水氣吹乾，免得下次開機噴你一臉霉味，用掉的電少到幾乎算不出來。
也就是說，這台被我罵了一整個夏天的機器，每天都會把自己收拾好才肯休息。
而我，襪子還躺在客廳地板上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在整個夏天都在罵冷氣之後，發一則帶點溫度的貼文；也很適合回覆「關機還在轉是不是很耗電」
variations: 我對冷氣最大的誤會，是以為它關機後還在轉是在偷電，它只是不想發霉。
連冷氣都有下班儀式，只有我，每天往沙發上一躺就算收工。

en.content:
After you hit off, the fan keeps turning for another ten or fifteen minutes.
It isn't stalling and it isn't stealing. It's drying the moisture off its own coils so it doesn't breathe mildew at you next time, and the power that takes barely registers.
Which means the machine I've been cursing all summer tidies itself up before it rests.
Meanwhile my socks are still on the living room floor.
en.editorNote: For a softer post after a whole summer of complaining about the AC; also a good reply to "does it waste power when it keeps running after you turn it off?"
variations: My biggest misread of my AC: I thought the post-shutoff spin was theft. It just doesn't want to get moldy.
Even the AC has a wind-down routine. I just fall onto the couch and call the day done.

items.sourceNote: 台電 APP 電力即點專區「住家節電預測」活動（抄表日前預測用電度數換金點，100 點折抵 1 元）；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電 App 有個活動：抄表日前先猜自己這期會用幾度，猜得越準，拿到的金點越多。
我盯著那個空格看了十分鐘。
填低一點，是我對自己的期待；填高一點，才是我對自己的了解。
最後我填了一個很誠實的數字，然後非常精準地達成了它。人生第一次靠不節制拿到滿分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合參加台電節電預測活動的那天，或想自嘲用電量的人；配一張填表截圖
variations: 這是我這輩子最不希望自己猜中的一次考試，偏偏就中了。
猜自己會用幾度，比對統一發票還準——因為那台冷氣從來不會讓我失望。

en.content:
The power company app has a game: before your meter reading, guess how many kilowatt-hours you'll use. The closer you land, the more points you win.
I stared at that blank box for ten minutes.
A low number is what I hope I am. A high number is what I know I am.
I typed something honest and then hit it dead on. First time in my life I aced a test by having no self-control.
en.editorNote: For the day you enter the utility's usage-guessing promo, or roast your own consumption; pair with a screenshot of the entry form
variations: The one test I was praying to fail, and of course I nailed it.
I can predict my own power usage to the decimal. That AC has never once let me down.

items.sourceNote: 台電 APP「節電日挑戰」規則（指定日晚間 6-8 時較前一日同時段節電 0.5 度可得金點）；家庭場景改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
那天晚上六點一到，我家客廳的燈全部熄掉。
電視關了，冷氣調到二十九度，一家三口坐在暗暗的沙發上小聲聊天——因為節電日挑戰的規則是，這兩個小時要比昨天同時段少用半度電。
我媽說：「這感覺好像我小時候遇到颱風。」
我說：「對，只是這次是自願的，而且獎品大概值十塊錢。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合參加節電挑戰當晚發限動；也很適合形容全家一起省電的荒謬感
variations: 為了省半度電，全家在黑暗裡坐了兩小時，安靜到像在辦某種家庭儀式。
一千金點折十塊，我媽算完之後說：「那我少買一顆蛋不就好了。」

en.content:
At six on the dot, every light in our living room went off.
TV off, AC nudged up to 84, the three of us sitting on the couch in the dark talking quietly — because the rules of the save-power challenge say these two hours have to use half a kilowatt-hour less than the same two hours yesterday.
Mom said, "This feels like a typhoon when I was a kid."
I said, "Right, except this time we signed up for it, and the prize is worth about thirty cents."
en.editorNote: For a story posted the night you're doing the challenge; also nails the absurdity of a whole family saving power together
variations: Two hours sitting in the dark as a family to save half a kilowatt-hour. Quiet enough to qualify as a ritual.
A thousand points knocks about thirty cents off the bill. Mom ran the math and said she'd rather buy one less egg.

items.sourceNote: 台電 APP 可查詢每日用電與智慧電表用電資訊的功能說明；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
換了智慧電表以後，我睡前滑的不是限時動態，是我家的用電曲線。
昨天那根柱子比前天高一點，我可以躺著想很久：是因為多洗了一次衣服，還是因為我八點就把冷氣打開了。
以前失眠是想著沒回的訊息，現在是想著沒關的插座。
科技讓生活更方便，也讓我多了一張可以自責的圖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合裝了智慧電表、每天查用電的人；配一張 App 用電長條圖截圖
variations: 智慧電表最大的功能不是省電，是讓你看得很清楚，自己是怎麼把錢燒掉的。
我研究自己的用電曲線，比研究健檢報告還認真。

en.content:
Since the smart meter went in, the last thing I scroll before bed isn't stories. It's my own usage chart.
Yesterday's bar is a little taller than the day before, and I'll lie there a long time working out why: the extra load of laundry, or the fact that I caved and turned the AC on at eight.
I used to lose sleep over unanswered texts. Now it's the outlets I forgot to switch off.
Technology made life easier and handed me one more graph to feel bad about.
en.editorNote: For anyone with a smart meter checking usage daily; pair with a screenshot of the bar chart
variations: A smart meter doesn't save you power. It shows you, in high resolution, exactly how you burned the money.
I study my own usage graph harder than I study my blood test results.

items.sourceNote: 遠見 2026 夏季電價專題（6-9 月夏月電價使家戶冷氣成本上升）；出差飯店情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這次出差住飯店，我進房第一件事是把冷氣壓到十六度。
不是因為熱，是因為終於有一間房間的涼，不用從我的戶頭裡扣。
那晚我蓋著兩件被子睡，冷到半夜醒過來，心裡卻莫名踏實。
退房那天我還特地看了溫控面板一眼，像在跟一段短暫但慷慨的關係道別。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合出差或旅行入住飯店時發文；配一張房間溫控面板或床鋪照
variations: 別人出差看夜景，我出差看遙控器上那個不用我付錢的數字。
飯店最豪華的設備不是浴缸，是一台可以任性開整晚的冷氣。

en.content:
First thing I did checking into the hotel: crank the AC down to 61.
Not because I was hot. Because for once, a cold room wasn't coming out of my account.
I slept under two blankets, woke up shivering at three in the morning, and felt strangely at peace.
On checkout day I gave the thermostat one last look, like saying goodbye to a short but very generous relationship.
en.editorNote: For posting from a hotel on a work trip or vacation; pair with a photo of the room thermostat
variations: Other people travel for the city views. I travel for a number on a thermostat that isn't billed to me.
The most luxurious thing in a hotel room isn't the tub. It's an AC you can run all night without doing math.

items.sourceNote: 夏季省電建議中「減少熱水器使用」的常見項目；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
夏天我家唯一在放暑假的家電，是熱水器。
六月開始就沒人碰過它，洗澡直接轉冷水，而且洗得很開心。
我算了一下，這樣一個月大概省下一百多塊。
然後我看了一眼冷氣一個晚上吃掉的度數，決定今天不要再算下去了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合吐槽「小地方省半天、大地方照樣噴」的省錢日常；也適合回覆勸你省電的長輩
variations: 我在熱水器上省下來的錢，冷氣兩個晚上就幫我花光了。
省電這件事，我認真的地方都很小，花錢的地方都很大。

en.content:
The only appliance in my house on summer vacation is the water heater.
Nobody's touched it since June. We turn the tap straight to cold and honestly enjoy it.
I ran the numbers: that's maybe four bucks a month saved.
Then I looked at what the AC eats in a single night and decided to stop running numbers for today.
en.editorNote: For roasting the way we save pennies in one corner and hemorrhage cash in another; also a good reply to anyone lecturing you about saving power
variations: Everything I save on the water heater, the AC spends for me in two nights.
With saving power, I'm meticulous about the small stuff and hopeless about the big stuff.

items.sourceNote: 2026 節能建議中「室外機散熱環境影響效率」的原則；情境與結尾為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
師傅說：「你室外機整個下午被太陽正面烤，散熱不掉，當然吃電。」
於是我上網買了遮陽板，爬上陽台，量尺寸、鎖螺絲，弄了一個下午。
八月的太陽底下，我一邊流汗一邊想：這台機器現在有遮陽，我沒有。
這個夏天我唯一認真幫忙防曬的對象，是一台不會謝謝我的機器。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在自己動手做完居家防曬工程之後；也適合吐槽「我對家電比對自己好」
variations: 全家最需要遮陽的其實不是我，是那台室外機。
我幫室外機撐了傘，然後自己站在太陽底下鎖螺絲。

en.content:
The repair guy said, "Your outdoor unit bakes in full sun all afternoon. It can't dump heat, so it eats power."
So I bought a sun shade, climbed onto the balcony, measured, drilled, and burned an entire afternoon on it.
Sweating under the August sun, it hit me: the machine has shade now. I don't.
The only thing I've seriously protected from the sun this summer is an appliance that will never thank me.
en.editorNote: For posting after a DIY heat-proofing project; also great for roasting how we treat our appliances better than ourselves
variations: The one in this house that needed shade wasn't me. It was the condenser.
I built the outdoor unit an umbrella, then stood in full sun to install it.

items.sourceNote: 夏季省電報導中「減少室內熱源可降低冷氣負擔」的通用建議；生活情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
我算過了：夏天在家開火煮一頓飯，廚房的熱會整間散開，冷氣得多做半小時的工。
所以我很理性地決定：八月不開伙。
一個月後我打開記帳 App，電費確實少了兩百多，外送費多了三千。
我省下的是電，付出的是全部。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合吐槽「省電省到後來更花錢」的夏日日常；也可以拿來替自己叫外送找理由
variations: 為了不讓廚房加熱我家，我把錢拿去加熱外送員的機車。
電費省兩百，外送花三千，這叫節能。

en.content:
I did the math: cooking a meal in summer heats the whole kitchen, which makes the AC work an extra half hour.
So I made a very rational call. No cooking in August.
A month later I opened my budgeting app. Power bill: down seven bucks. Delivery: up a hundred.
What I saved was electricity. What I spent was everything.
en.editorNote: For roasting the way saving power somehow costs more money; also a solid excuse for ordering in again
variations: To keep the kitchen from heating my apartment, I paid to heat up a delivery driver's scooter instead.
Saved seven dollars on power, spent a hundred on delivery. That's efficiency.

items.sourceNote: 夏季高溫悶熱與午後對流天氣的常見報導背景；情緒轉折為原創

zh-tw.content:
下午四點，天忽然黑掉，雷聲滾過來，雨嘩啦嘩啦下了二十分鐘。
我立刻關掉冷氣，打開窗，站在風口深呼吸，覺得老天爺今天幫我省了一筆。
雨停後十分鐘，柏油路開始冒白煙，空氣變成一鍋溫熱的湯。
我把窗關上，冷氣重開，這次還多按了除濕——老天爺剛剛不是幫我，是在幫我加價。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合午後雷陣雨過後貼；捕捉「以為降溫、結果更悶」的台灣夏天體感
variations: 雷陣雨不是降溫，是換一種熱法給你。
雨停之後的那十分鐘，是一天裡最貴的十分鐘。

en.content:
Four in the afternoon, the sky went dark, thunder rolled in, and it poured for twenty minutes.
I killed the AC, threw the windows open, stood in the breeze and figured the weather had just saved me money.
Ten minutes after it stopped, steam started rising off the asphalt and the air turned into warm soup.
Windows shut, AC back on, dehumidify mode added. The weather wasn't doing me a favor. It was upselling me.
en.editorNote: For posting right after an afternoon thunderstorm; captures the classic "thought it cooled down, actually got muggier" whiplash
variations: A summer downpour doesn't cool you down. It just switches you to a different kind of hot.
The ten minutes after the rain stops are the most expensive ten minutes of the day.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣保養常識：冷媒為密閉循環，不漏就不會自然減少；對話與吐槽為原創

zh-tw.content:
冷氣不冷，我第一個念頭是：一定是冷媒沒了，該補了。
師傅來看了三分鐘說：「冷媒是密閉循環的，不漏就不會自己變少。你這台是濾網卡死加室外機散熱不良。」
他洗一洗、清一清，當天晚上房間就涼了，帳單下一期也降了。
我信了五年的「冷氣要定期補冷媒」，原來是我自己每年花錢買的一個安心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 破解常見冷氣迷思：冷媒不會自然消耗，不冷通常是髒與散熱問題；適合傳給每年準備補冷媒的家人
variations: 冷媒不會自己蒸發，會蒸發的是你的錢。
我以為冷氣缺冷媒，其實它只是缺一次洗澡。

en.content:
AC not cooling. My first thought: must be low on refrigerant, time for a top-up.
The tech looked at it for three minutes. "Refrigerant runs in a sealed loop. If it isn't leaking, it doesn't just disappear. Your filter is caked and your outdoor unit can't breathe."
He cleaned both. The room was cold that night and the next bill came down.
The "you need a refrigerant refill every year" rule I believed for five years was just peace of mind I paid for annually.
en.editorNote: Busts a common AC myth: refrigerant isn't consumed, weak cooling is usually dirt and airflow; good to forward to whoever books a refill every summer
variations: Refrigerant doesn't evaporate. Your money does.
I thought my AC was low on refrigerant. It just needed a bath.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電價說明：住宅用電共六個累進級距，120 度以下每度 1.78 元，1000 度以上每度 8.86 元，採分段累進計費

zh-tw.content:
「一旦超過那條線，整份電費就變成一度八塊多。」這句話我信了三年，每年七月都過得像通緝犯。
後來才看懂：住宅電價有六個級距，是分段收的。前面那 120 度還是一度 1.78 元，貴的只有你多爬出來的那一段。
所以我從來沒有被整份加價，我只是每往上一階，就被溫柔地多刮一層。
知道真相之後我也沒有比較放鬆，只是換了一種算法繼續害怕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 破解最常見的級距誤解——超過門檻不是整份跳貴，而是超出部分才適用高費率；適合在群組有人恐慌時貼出來，闢謠又不說教
variations: 累進電價不是一刀砍下去，是一層一層慢慢刮。
我怕的其實不是那條線，是我每年都會越過它。

en.content:
"Cross that line and your whole bill jumps to the top rate." I believed it for three years and spent every July living like a fugitive.
Then I actually read it: residential power has six tiers and they stack. Your first chunk still bills at the cheap rate. Only the part you climbed past gets the expensive one.
So I was never charged top rate on everything. I just got shaved one thin layer at a time, one tier at a time.
Knowing the truth didn't relax me. It just gave me a more accurate way to be scared.
en.editorNote: Debunks the most common tier myth: crossing a threshold reprices only the excess, not the whole bill; good for calming a panicking group chat without lecturing
variations: Tiered pricing isn't one big cut. It's a lot of small shavings.
I wasn't afraid of the line. I was afraid I cross it every year.

items.sourceNote: 台電約每兩個月抄表一次，一期帳單的累進級距額度須乘以兩倍計算

zh-tw.content:
台電大約兩個月抄一次表，所以帳單上的級距門檻，全部要乘以二。
我第一次看懂的時候超開心：「哇，我的免死金牌變成兩倍。」
然後我發現，被乘二的不只是額度，還有我開冷氣的天數。
台電從來沒有虧待我。是我把加倍的空間，加倍地用完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 解釋雙月抄表為什麼級距要加倍，順便吐槽「額度變大＝可以多用」的錯覺；適合第一次認真看懂帳單的人
variations: 額度乘二，我的冷氣時數也很爭氣地乘二。
台電給我兩倍的空間，我用兩倍的速度填滿它。

en.content:
The meter gets read roughly every two months, so every tier threshold on the bill is doubled.
The first time I understood that, I was thrilled. "My free pass is twice as big."
Then I noticed what else got doubled: the number of days I ran the AC.
The power company never shortchanged me. I just filled twice the room twice as fast.
en.editorNote: Explains why bimonthly meter reads double the tier limits, and mocks the illusion that a bigger allowance means room to spare; good for anyone reading their bill closely for the first time
variations: They doubled my allowance. My AC hours rose to the occasion.
Twice the headroom, same me, half the time.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價期間為 6/1 至 9/30；帳單計費期間若跨越夏月與非夏月，台電依各自適用天數按比例分算

zh-tw.content:
「夏月電價九月三十號結束」——我把這天圈在月曆上，像在等刑期屆滿。
後來才知道，如果帳單期間剛好跨過那條線，台電會按各自的天數比例分開算。
所以那不是一道門，是一個斜坡：九月最後那幾天，我的每一度電，是一點一點變便宜的。
我人生第一次感謝「按比例」這三個字。原來解脫也可以分期到貨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 說明跨夏月／非夏月的帳單是依天數比例分算，不是整期一個價；適合九月倒數夏月電價結束時使用，帶點知識也帶點盼頭
variations: 九月三十號不是終點線，是一段慢慢下坡的路。
我的解脫沒有一次到位，它是按天數分期付款給我的。

en.content:
"Summer rates end September 30." I circled it on the calendar like a release date.
Then I learned that if your billing period straddles that line, they split it by the actual number of days on each side.
So it isn't a door. It's a ramp. Over those last September days, every unit I use gets a little cheaper.
First time in my life I've been grateful for the word "prorated." Turns out relief can arrive in installments.
en.editorNote: Explains that a bill spanning the summer/non-summer boundary is prorated by days rather than billed at one flat rate; good for the September countdown, informative with a bit of hope
variations: September 30 isn't a finish line. It's a downhill stretch.
My relief didn't arrive all at once. It got paid to me by the day.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價期間社區公共用電（電梯、抽水馬達、公設照明與空調）成本上升，常反映在管理費

zh-tw.content:
管委會公告：「夏月電價期間，社區公電支出成長四成，請住戶共體時艱。」
公電是什麼？是電梯、抽水馬達、地下室那盞永遠不關的燈，還有大廳那台冷氣。
那台大廳冷氣，我一天經過它兩次，每次三秒。
所以今年夏天我付了兩份電費：一份讓我家涼，一份讓一個我從來沒坐下來過的地方，涼得非常舒適。
zh-tw.editorNote: 切入很少被寫到的公共用電分攤——夏月電價也會推高公設電費並轉嫁到管理費；適合社區公告調漲時在鄰居群組發洩
variations: 我家的冷氣要省，大廳的冷氣不用，因為它花的是大家的錢。
全社區最涼的地方，是一個沒有人真的待著的地方。

en.content:
Building notice: "Summer rates have pushed common-area power costs up 40%. Thank you for your understanding."
Common-area power means the elevator, the water pump, the basement light nobody ever switches off, and the lobby AC.
That lobby AC. I walk past it twice a day, three seconds each way.
So this summer I'm paying two electric bills: one to keep my apartment cool, and one to keep a room I have never once sat down in extremely comfortable.
en.editorNote: Covers the rarely-written angle of shared common-area power: summer rates raise building costs and land in your HOA fee; good to vent in the neighbor chat when the notice goes up
variations: I ration my AC. The lobby AC doesn't, because it spends everyone's money.
The coldest room in the building is the one nobody stays in.

items.sourceNote: 台電用戶申請電子帳單、不印寄紙本帳單，每期可減收電費 10 元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台電說：申請電子帳單、不寄紙本，每期減收十元。
我三十秒就辦好了。十元、兩個月，換算下來一天省不到兩毛。
但我真的很滿意——因為那是這整個夏天，唯一一個我按一下就會變小的數字。
其他數字，我按什麼它都只會往上長。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛申請電子帳單、發現省下的十元跟帳單金額完全不成比例的人；也適合拿來推坑朋友一起辦
variations: 我這輩子效率最高的省錢，是線上點三十秒，換一期十元。
十元買不到一杯飲料，但買得到一種「我有在努力」的感覺。

en.content:
Go paperless on your power bill and they knock ten bucks off every billing cycle.
Signed up in thirty seconds. Ten dollars across two months works out to about six cents a day.
And honestly? Thrilled. It's the only number all summer that got smaller because I pressed something.
Every other number goes up no matter what I press.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just switched to e-billing and noticed the discount is comically small next to the bill itself; also works for talking a friend into signing up
variations: Thirty seconds of online paperwork for ten dollars off. Peak financial efficiency.
Ten dollars doesn't buy a drink, but it buys the feeling that I tried.

items.sourceNote: 2026 十大吃電怪獸報導；冰箱為住宅耗電大戶，且環境溫度越高壓縮機運轉越頻繁；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我一直以為夏天的兇手只有冷氣。
後來才想到：冰箱從來沒被關過。它站在全家最熱的那間廚房，一整個夏天都在跟室溫拔河，室溫越高，它跑得越勤。
冷氣至少還會被我心痛地按掉，冰箱連休息一秒的資格都沒有。
今年夏天最累的不是我，是那個從來不抱怨、也從來不下班的同事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享「不是只有冷氣在吃電」這個冷知識；也能當成寫給全年無休的自己的一句話
variations: 全家最耐操的員工是冰箱，最會抱怨的是我。
冷氣是夏天的主角，冰箱是那個沒有台詞、卻從來沒下班的人。

en.content:
I always blamed the AC for summer.
Then it hit me: the fridge never gets switched off. It stands in the hottest room in the house, playing tug-of-war with the room temperature all summer, and the hotter that room gets, the harder it runs.
At least the AC gets guiltily shut down. The fridge doesn't get one second off.
The most exhausted thing in my apartment this summer isn't me. It's the coworker who never complains and never clocks out.
en.editorNote: Good for sharing the "it's not only the AC" fact; also lands as a joke about your own no-days-off summer
variations: Hardest worker in the house is the fridge. Loudest complainer is me.
The AC gets top billing. The fridge has no lines and never goes home.

items.sourceNote: 2026 節能家電補助：一級能效冷氣可退貨物稅最高 2000 元，須於購買日次日起 6 個月內提出申請；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
「一級能效的冷氣，貨物稅可以退兩千，記得買完六個月內去申請喔。」
店員講這句話的時候，我點頭如搗蒜，還把發票收到一個我覺得非常安全的地方。
六個月後，我在抽屜最深處找到那張發票，上面的日期，剛好過期兩天。
我這輩子最貴的兩千塊，是我親手放到過期的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合買了節能家電卻忘記申請退稅的人；也很適合拿來提醒朋友「補助是有時效的」
variations: 我不是省不下錢，我是每次都在最後一步睡著。
發票我收得很好，好到連我自己都找不到。

en.content:
"Top-efficiency unit? You get two thousand back in tax — just file within six months of the purchase date."
I nodded at the salesman like a man who would never forget, then filed the receipt somewhere extremely safe.
Six months later I found it at the back of a drawer. The deadline had passed two days earlier.
Most expensive two thousand dollars of my life, and I'm the one who let it expire.
en.editorNote: For anyone who bought an efficient appliance and forgot to claim the rebate; also a good nudge to remind friends that these programs have deadlines
variations: It's not that I can't save money. It's that I fall asleep on the last step.
I filed that receipt so carefully that even I couldn't find it.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季用電高峰報導；改寫成老屋多台大功率家電同時運轉導致開關跳脫的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
昨天晚上，冷氣、微波爐、吹風機同時在跑，我家「啪」一聲全暗了。
我摸黑走去把總開關推回去，腦中冒出一個很陌生的念頭：
原來夏天的極限不是我的荷包，是這間老房子三十年前拉的那條電線。
它比我誠實。我還在硬撐的時候，它已經先幫我喊停了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住老公寓的租屋族；跳電當下拍一張黑漆漆的房間就能發
variations: 我以為夏天的天花板是電費，結果是電線。
這間房子唯一懂得節制的，是那顆會自己跳掉的開關。

en.content:
Last night: AC, microwave, and hair dryer all running. Then a click, and the whole apartment went dark.
Feeling my way to the breaker box, I had a genuinely new thought.
The ceiling on summer isn't my bank account. It's the wiring somebody ran through these walls thirty years ago.
It's more honest than I am. I was still pushing. It called it.
en.editorNote: For renters in older buildings; post it with a photo of the pitch-dark apartment the second the breaker trips
variations: Thought my summer limit was the bill. Turns out it was the wiring.
The only thing in this apartment with any self-control is the breaker.

items.sourceNote: 2026 冷氣噸數選購報導：噸數不足會讓壓縮機長時間高速運轉、反而更耗電；改寫成「省下的購機費變成電費分期」的原創比喻

zh-tw.content:
當初買冷氣，我在兩台之間站了半小時，最後挑了小一級的那台，省下八千塊，走出賣場的時候還很得意。
這個夏天我才懂：那台機器永遠追不上房間的熱，所以它的壓縮機從六月開始就沒有真正停過。
八千塊我確實省下來了，只是改成每兩個月一期，繳給台電。
那不是折扣，那是分期。而且沒有零利率。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在挑冷氣、或已經買錯噸數的人；可以配在「冷氣選購懶人包」的分享底下
variations: 買小一台省下來的錢，會用電費的形式，一期一期還回去。
我以為我在殺價，其實我在簽一份為期十年的合約。

en.content:
When I bought the AC, I stood between two models for half an hour and picked the smaller one. Saved about two hundred and fifty bucks. Walked out of the store feeling brilliant.
This summer I finally get it. That unit can never catch up to the room, so the compressor hasn't truly shut off since June.
I did save the money. I just moved it onto a payment plan, due every two months, payable to the power company.
That's not a discount. That's financing. And the rate is awful.
en.editorNote: For anyone shopping for an AC, or anyone who already sized one wrong; works as a reply under buying-guide posts
variations: The money you save buying one size down comes back as a bill, in installments.
I thought I was negotiating. I was signing a ten-year contract.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電費報導（6/1 起夏月電價、累進計費）；改寫成信用卡繳費回饋的原創自嘲情境

zh-tw.content:
我特地辦了一張繳公用事業費有回饋的信用卡，這期電費五千二，回饋百分之一。
五十二塊。剛好一顆茶葉蛋加一瓶運動飲料。
但我真的很滿意，因為那五十二塊是整張帳單上，唯一站在我這邊的數字。
其他每一行，都是我自己伸手按出來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合信用卡回饋、記帳社群；繳完電費把回饋金額截圖一起發
variations: 電費五千二，回饋五十二——這是我在這場戰役裡唯一的戰利品。
我不是靠回饋省錢，我是靠回饋維持尊嚴。

en.content:
I opened a card just for the cashback on utility bills. This cycle: a hundred and sixty-five dollars of electricity, one percent back.
A dollar sixty-five. Exactly one tea egg and a sports drink.
And I'm genuinely pleased, because that dollar sixty-five is the only number on the whole statement that's on my side.
Every other line, I pressed the button for myself.
en.editorNote: For points-and-cashback and budgeting communities; pair it with a screenshot of the tiny rebate after you pay
variations: A hundred sixty-five out, a dollar sixty-five back. That's my entire war trophy.
The cashback doesn't save me money. It preserves my dignity.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電價與尖峰用電成本報導；改寫成辦公大樓下班後延長空調需申請、按小時計費的原創上班族情境

zh-tw.content:
我們大樓的規矩是：六點以後要繼續吹冷氣，得先上系統填一張「延長空調申請」，寫清楚時段跟原因，按小時計費。
第一次填的時候我卡在原因欄很久，因為我唯一想得到的答案是「因為我事情做不完」。
那天我忽然懂了：公司從來沒有小看冷氣的成本，它算得比誰都清楚。
它只是決定，把那筆錢算在我下班的時間上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合加班族、在辦公大樓上班的人；六點一到辦公室開始變悶的時候發
variations: 公司不是不知道冷氣很貴，它只是選擇用我的時間來付。
六點以後的涼要填單申請，六點以後的累不用。

en.content:
House rule in our building: if you want AC past six, you file an extended-HVAC request in the system. Hours, reason, billed hourly.
The first time, I stalled on the reason field, because the only honest answer I had was that I'm not done yet.
That's when it landed. The company never underestimated what cooling costs. It knows the number better than anyone in the building.
It just decided to bill it to my evenings.
en.editorNote: For anyone who works late in an office tower; post it the moment the air goes still at six
variations: They know exactly what the AC costs. They just pay for it with my time.
Cool air after six needs a form. Being tired after six doesn't.

items.sourceNote: 2026 電價攻略提到換一級能效冷氣最多可省約三成七電力；改寫成回老家幫長輩算回本年限的原創溫馨情境

zh-tw.content:
回老家才發現，阿嬤房間那台窗型冷氣還在用，聲音大到講話要講兩次。
我查了型號，認真跟她算：換一台一級能效的，夏天每個月大概省下多少，三年就回本。
她聽完點點頭，說：「那我再撐三年。」
我本來是要幫她省錢的。那天下午我什麼都沒算了，只想跟她多坐一會兒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合回老家、跟長輩聊省電的情境；溫馨向，可配老家客廳或舊冷氣的照片
variations: 我算的是回本年限，她聽到的是還剩幾年。
那台冷氣吵了二十年，我卻是那天下午才聽懂它在說什麼。

en.content:
Went back to my grandmother's place and her old window unit is still running. Loud enough that you say everything twice.
I looked up the model and walked her through it: swap in a top-efficiency one, save this much a month all summer, pays for itself in three years.
She nodded and said, alright, I'll hang on three more years then.
I came to save her money. That afternoon I stopped doing math and just wanted to sit with her a while longer.
en.editorNote: For visiting family and the efficiency talk with grandparents; warm tone, pairs with a photo of the old living room
variations: I was calculating a payback period. She heard a countdown.
That AC has been loud for twenty years. That was the afternoon I heard it.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季用電計算與家電耗電比較文章；改寫成用智慧插座逐台抓吃電兇手、最後結論指向自己的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
為了抓出家裡的吃電兇手，我買了三個智慧插座，一台一台量：電視、電腦、烘碗機。
量了兩個禮拜，數據漂亮又整齊，兇手一直沒抓到。
因為真正耗電的那台，沒有插頭給我量——是冷氣。而冷氣之所以整天開著，是因為我在家。
儀表板最後給我的結論很簡單：這個夏天最耗電的家電，是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合愛買小工具、在家工作的人；配智慧插座 App 的用電圖表一起發
variations: 我量遍了家裡每一個插座，只有我自己沒有插頭可以拔。
數據很誠實：我不在家的那幾天，我家超省電。

en.content:
To catch the power hog in my apartment, I bought three smart plugs and measured everything: TV, desktop, dish dryer.
Two weeks of beautiful, tidy data, and still no suspect.
Because the real one doesn't plug into anything I can measure. It's the AC, and the AC runs all day because I'm home.
The dashboard's verdict was simple. The appliance drawing the most power this summer is me.
en.editorNote: For gadget people and anyone working from home; post it with the usage graph from your smart-plug app
variations: I metered every outlet in the place. I'm the only thing here without a plug to pull.
The data doesn't lie: my apartment is extremely efficient on the days I'm not in it.

items.sourceNote: 「班班有冷氣」政策報導：教育部規定不得向國中小學生收取冷氣電費，補助以每班兩台、每天八小時、一年八十八天計算，學校一班發一張冷氣卡；改寫成出社會後翻到舊冷氣卡的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
整理老家抽屜，翻出一張塑膠卡，上面用奇異筆寫著班級跟座號——是我們教室的冷氣卡，那時候由班長保管，第一節課去刷一下，整間就涼了。
我記得我們會為了「今天誰忘記帶卡」吵架，但沒有人吵過電費，因為那從來不是我們要煩惱的事。
後來我才知道，那筆錢是有人替我們算好的：一間教室兩台，一天八小時，一年八十八天。
現在我家的冷氣卡叫薪水。沒有班長幫我保管，也沒有人幫我算那八十八天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合出社會後回望學生時代的貼文；配畢業照、舊書包或老教室的照片
variations: 學生時代最公平的一件事：全班一起涼，而且沒有人看得到帳單。
那張卡刷下去整間就涼了，我當時真的以為冷氣是免費的空氣。

en.content:
Cleaning out a drawer at my parents' place, I found a plastic card with my class and seat number written on it in marker. It's the AC card from our classroom. The class rep kept it, swiped it before first period, and the whole room went cool.
We used to argue about who forgot to bring it. Nobody ever argued about the bill, because the bill was never our problem.
I found out later that someone had done that math for us: two units per room, eight hours a day, eighty-eight days a year.
My AC card now is called a paycheck. No class rep holds it for me, and nobody counts those eighty-eight days on my behalf.
en.editorNote: For the post-graduation nostalgia post; pairs with a yearbook photo or an empty classroom
variations: Fairest thing about being a student: the whole room got cool and none of us ever saw the bill.
One swipe and the room went cold. I honestly thought cool air was just weather.

items.sourceNote: 北捷車廂空調設定新聞稿：尖峰時段 21 度、離峰 22 度；改寫成通勤族把車廂當免費冷氣房、故意多坐兩站的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
上班尖峰的捷運車廂設 21 度，離峰 22 度。我認真算過：一段票二十塊，坐二十分鐘，這是全台北最便宜的冷氣房，還附免費訊號跟一點點推擠。
所以下班我常常故意多坐兩站，再慢慢走回來。
不是因為我愛捷運，是因為那二十分鐘的涼，是我一整天唯一不用自己付的。
回到家，我把冷氣設 28 度，坐在客廳，一邊吹一邊在心裡算它跑了幾分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合通勤族；下班在車廂裡捨不得下車、或走出站被熱氣打到的時候發
variations: 全台北最划算的冷氣房，二十塊，而且它會自己開到你家附近。
我不是坐過站，我是在幫我的涼續約。

en.content:
Peak-hour trains here run at 21 degrees, 22 off-peak. I did the math: twenty NT for a twenty-minute ride makes this the cheapest air-conditioned room in the city, free signal and mild shoving included.
So on the way home I ride two stops past mine and walk back.
Not because I love the subway. Because those twenty minutes are the only cool air all day that isn't coming out of my own pocket.
Then I get home, set mine to 28, sit on the couch, and quietly count how long the compressor has been running.
en.editorNote: For commuters; post it when you can't make yourself get off the train, or the second you hit the street outside the station
variations: Cheapest air-conditioned room in town, and it drives you home.
I didn't miss my stop. I was renewing the lease on being cool.

items.sourceNote: 2026 露營用電相關文章提到營區每帳限電多在 250W 至 500W；改寫成上山避暑卻熱到想念家裡冷氣的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
為了避暑，我們花錢上山露營。營區公告寫得清清楚楚：每帳限電 500W。
算一算，剛好夠一台電風扇加一顆小燈，冷氣是連想都不用想的東西。
半夜兩點，全家在帳篷裡翻來覆去，外面的蟬叫得比室外機還大聲。
那個晚上我第一次認真地想念家裡那台冷氣。原來一個你每個月都在罵的東西，也是會被想念的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合露營、出遊回來的貼文；配帳篷夜景或營區電箱的照片
variations: 花錢上山避暑，換到一個開不起冷氣的夜晚。
山上比較涼是真的，只是涼不進帳篷裡面。

en.content:
We paid to go camping in the mountains to get away from the heat. The sign at the campground is very clear: 500 watts per site.
That's one fan and a small lamp. AC isn't even part of the conversation.
Two in the morning, the whole family rolling around inside the tent, cicadas outside louder than any condenser back home.
That was the first night I genuinely missed our AC. Turns out you can miss a thing you complain about every single month.
en.editorNote: For the post-camping-trip post; pairs with a night shot of the tent or the campsite power box
variations: Paid good money to escape the heat and landed somewhere I couldn't afford to cool at all.
The mountains really are cooler. Just not inside the tent.

items.sourceNote: 台電預估今年夏季夜間尖峰用電創新高、強調夜尖峰備轉容量率維持 7% 以上的報導；改寫成「原來最耗電的時刻是晚上大家一起開冷氣」的原創體悟

zh-tw.content:
新聞說，今年夏天的夜間尖峰用電會創新高，台電得想辦法把備轉容量率守在 7% 以上。
我一直以為一天最耗電的時刻是中午的工廠。原來不是，是晚上八點多——大家下班、洗完澡、關上房門，然後在差不多同一分鐘，按下同一顆按鈕。
那個全國最緊張的數字，其實是幾百萬個人各自的一句「好熱喔」加起來的。
所以我家那台冷氣不是特例。它只是那條曲線上，非常小、也非常誠實的一格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合晚上開冷氣的時候發；配窗外整排亮著燈的大樓照片
variations: 全台灣最有默契的一件事，是晚上八點一起按下冷氣遙控器。
我以為我是一個人在跟電費打仗，其實那一秒有幾百萬人跟我一起。

en.content:
The news says the evening peak will set a record this summer, and the utility has to hold its reserve margin above 7 percent.
I always assumed the heaviest hour was midday factories. It isn't. It's a little past eight at night, when everyone gets home, showers, shuts the bedroom door, and hits the same button within the same minute.
That one tense national number is really a few million people each saying it's so hot in here.
So my AC isn't an outlier. It's one very small, very honest tick on that curve.
en.editorNote: Post it at night with the AC running; pairs with a shot of lit-up apartment windows
variations: The most coordinated thing this whole country does is reach for the remote at eight p.m.
I thought I was fighting the bill alone. That second, a few million people were in it with me.

items.sourceNote: 「立秋之後為什麼還這麼熱、秋老虎」的科普專欄；改寫成日曆入秋但房間還在吹冷氣的原創情境，未引用任何費率或金額

zh-tw.content:
月曆翻到立秋那天，我很有儀式感地截圖傳到家族群組，配一句：「撐過去了。」
那天下午三點，我房間的溫度計還是三十四度，冷氣從中午開到現在，一次都沒停。
後來我才弄懂，節氣寫的是太陽走到哪裡，不是我房間走到哪裡。
夏天不會因為日期到了就結束。它結束的那天，是某個傍晚我伸手要按遙控器，按到一半發現自己不用按了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合立秋、處暑前後還在開冷氣的時候發；配溫度計或冷氣顯示面板的照片
variations: 日曆說秋天到了，我房間投了反對票。
立秋是太陽的進度條，跟我家的溫度沒有連動。

en.content:
Autumn started this week, according to the calendar. I screenshotted the date, sent it to the family chat, added: we made it.
Three that afternoon, the thermometer in my room still said 34, and the AC hadn't cut out once since noon.
Turns out the date marks where the sun is, not where my bedroom is.
Summer doesn't end on a date. It ends on the evening I reach for the remote and realize halfway there that I don't need it.
en.editorNote: For the stretch when the calendar says fall but the AC is still running; pairs with a thermometer or the unit's display panel
variations: Calendar says autumn. My apartment has filed a dissent.
The date only tells you where the sun is. It has no opinion about my bedroom.

items.sourceNote: 「明明立秋怎麼還這麼熱、秋老虎發威冷氣吹不停」的季節報導；改寫成天氣稍微轉涼才收到最熱那兩個月帳單的時差感，原創情境，未引用任何費率或金額

zh-tw.content:
電費帳單有一種時差。
最熱的那段日子過完了，傍晚甚至開始有一點點風的時候，那張帳單才慢慢晃進我家信箱。
於是我常常是在一個不用開冷氣的晚上，替一個我已經想不太起來有多熱的自己付錢。
繳完的那一刻，我總會有種錯覺：這筆好像不是我花的。然後下一張會很有耐心地提醒我，是。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合天氣稍微轉涼、卻剛收到最熱那兩個月帳單的時候發
variations: 帳單永遠比熱浪晚到，所以我每次都在涼快的日子裡後悔。
我不是在繳這個月的電費，我是在替七月的自己還錢。

en.content:
Delayed reaction is the electric bill's whole personality. The hottest stretch is over, there's finally some air in the evenings, and only then does the envelope wander into my mailbox.
So I pay, on a night cool enough to leave the AC off, for a version of me I can barely remember being that desperate.
Every time I settle it I get the same illusion: surely somebody else spent this.
The next one always shows up to patiently correct me.
en.editorNote: Post it when the weather has eased but the bill for the hottest weeks just landed
variations: Bills run months behind the heat, which is why I always regret it on a comfortable night.
This isn't this month's bill. This is me paying off July.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣風向自動擺動功能的原廠說明頁；改寫成「家中座位順序由掃風決定」的原創生活情境

zh-tw.content:
我家客廳的座位順序，不是照輩分排的，是照掃風排的。
冷氣葉片每十幾秒左右擺一次，掃得到的那一段沙發是頭等艙，掃不到的角落是站票；我弟去上個廁所回來，位子就沒了。
沒有人講明這件事，但每個人都很清楚自己現在坐第幾名。
這大概是我們家最公平的一條規則——那片葉片從來不看誰比較大。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合全家擠在同一間冷氣房的晚上；配沙發或出風口的照片
variations: 在我家，離冷氣最近的那個位子，比遙控器還難搶。
我弟不是不敢喝水，他是不敢離開那一格風。

en.content:
Seating in our living room isn't by seniority. It's by airflow.
The louver sweeps across every fifteen seconds or so. The stretch of couch it reaches is first class, the corner it misses is standing room, and if my brother goes to the bathroom his seat is gone.
Nobody has ever said any of this out loud, and everybody knows exactly what rank they're sitting in.
It's the fairest rule in this house. That little plastic flap has never once cared who's older.
en.editorNote: For nights when the whole family piles into the one cooled room; pairs with a couch or vent photo
variations: Best seat in our house isn't the one facing the TV. It's the one the vent can reach.
My brother isn't avoiding water. He's defending his slice of the breeze.

items.sourceNote: 空調品牌知識文提到開冷氣時關閉門窗、避免冷空氣外洩；改寫成「夏天全家對話只剩一個門字」的原創生活觀察

zh-tw.content:
夏天一到，我家的對話會自動變短。
六月以前還會好好地說一整句：「你進來怎麼沒把門帶上？」七月以後只剩一個字：「門！」
沒有主詞，沒有動詞，但全家都聽得懂，而且會在半秒內回頭把門關上。
語言會為了效率演化，這件事我可以作證。而逼我們家進化得最快的，是那扇門一開，就偷偷跑掉的涼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡有人老是忘記把冷氣房門帶上的時候發
variations: 我家夏天最短的一句話是「門」，最長的一句話是「我剛剛是不是講過門」。
我們不是感情變差，我們只是把整句話省下來，跟冷氣一起省。

en.content:
Shorter is what our family's sentences get in summer.
In May it was still a full request: hey, could you pull the door shut behind you. By July it's one word. Door.
No subject, no verb, and everyone understands instantly and turns around within half a second.
Language evolves for efficiency, and I can confirm it. What sped ours up was the cool air sneaking out every time that door stayed open.
en.editorNote: For when somebody in the house keeps leaving the cooled room wide open
variations: Shortest sentence in our house is "door." The longest is "what did I just say about the door."
We're not getting colder with each other. We're just economizing, same as with the AC.

items.sourceNote: 電風扇擺位可把冷空氣送得更遠、搭配冷氣更省電的報導；改寫成「全家用三台電扇把涼接力送進房間」的原創生活情境

zh-tw.content:
我家只有客廳那台冷氣還會涼，所以夏天晚上，我們發展出一套物流系統。
客廳一台立扇對著出風口，把涼往走道推；走道再擺一台，接力往前送；房間門口那台負責最後分配。
三台電扇加起來，一小時不到一塊錢，比再開一台冷氣便宜太多。
所以我們不是在吹冷氣，我們是在替那台冷氣，跑最後一哩路的配送。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡只有一台冷氣、全家靠電扇接力續命的時候發
variations: 我家的涼是有物流的：客廳出貨，走道轉運，房間簽收。
一台冷氣配三台電扇，我家夏天的核心技術叫做「把涼運到最遠那間房」。

en.content:
Only the living room AC still gets properly cold at my place, so on summer nights we run a delivery network.
One fan sits under the vents pushing cool air toward the hallway. A second one in the hallway relays it forward. A third parks at the bedroom door and handles distribution.
All three fans together cost pennies an hour, far less than firing up a second AC.
So we're not running the AC. We're running last-mile delivery for it.
en.editorNote: For households where one AC and a relay of fans keep everyone alive
variations: Cool air in my house has a supply chain: living room ships, hallway forwards, bedroom signs for it.
One AC, three fans. Our entire summer strategy is getting cold to the farthest room.

items.sourceNote: 2026 租屋電費規範整理（房東須照實收、不得賺取電費價差）；改寫成「租金含電費的房子改用時間收費」的原創租屋觀察

zh-tw.content:
看房的時候房東說：「電費含在租金裡，冷氣隨便你吹。」我當下覺得自己中了一個小獎。
住進來的第一個夏天我才懂：那台冷氣十幾年了，風吹出來像在嘆氣，開滿四小時，房間才勉強算是不悶。
免費的涼不是不用錢，它只是換一種單位收——收你的時間。
我省下的每一塊電費，都在等它變涼的那幾個小時裡，一分一秒還了回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在比較「電費另計」跟「租金含電」到底哪個划算的租屋族
variations: 租金含電費的房子，收費單位不是台幣，是你的耐心。
房東說冷氣隨便吹，冷氣本人表示：可以吹，但不保證會涼。

en.content:
At the viewing, the landlord said electricity was included and I could run the AC all I wanted. I left feeling like I'd won something small.
My first summer in, I got it. The unit is over a decade old and breathes out air like a long sigh. Four hours in, the room is merely less stuffy.
Free cool air isn't free. It just bills you in a different currency, and that currency is time.
Every dollar I saved on the meter, I paid back in the hours I spent waiting for the room to turn cold.
en.editorNote: For anyone weighing a place with utilities included against one billed by the unit
variations: Rent with electricity included doesn't charge money. It charges patience.
Landlord says run the AC freely. The AC says it can run, but it won't promise cold.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣滴水成因說明（排水管積塵堵塞、冷凝水來自空氣中的濕氣）；改寫成「樓下鄰居上來按門鈴」的原創生活情境

zh-tw.content:
樓下鄰居昨天上來按門鈴，很客氣地說：「不好意思，你們家冷氣好像在滴水。」
我趴在陽台看了半天，那條排水管確實一滴一滴地往下掉。
師傅來通了一次管子就好了，還順口提醒我：那些水，本來就是冷氣從空氣裡榨出來的濕氣。
那個下午我才想通——我付了一整個夏天的電費，把水榨出來，然後免費送給樓下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合冷氣排水管塞住、被鄰居敲過門的人共鳴
variations: 夏天會來按我家門鈴的有兩種：電費單，跟樓下鄰居。
我以為我買的是涼，帳單說我買的是涼，樓下說我在製造雨。

en.content:
The neighbor downstairs rang my bell yesterday, very politely: sorry, I think your AC is dripping.
I leaned over the balcony and watched. Sure enough, the drain line was letting go one drop at a time.
The repair guy cleared the pipe in ten minutes and mentioned offhand that the water is just humidity the AC wrings out of the air.
That was the afternoon it clicked. I pay a full summer of bills to squeeze water out of my apartment, then hand it to the floor below for free.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose drain line clogged and earned a knock from downstairs
variations: Two things ring my doorbell in summer: the bill, and the neighbor below me.
I thought I was buying cool air. The bill agrees. Downstairs says I'm manufacturing rain.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣送風、除濕等各模式功能說明文；改寫成「遙控器十四顆鍵只用得到兩顆」的原創自嘲

zh-tw.content:
我家冷氣的遙控器上有十四顆按鍵。
除濕、送風、自動、強力、靜音、擺風、定時、自我清潔，還有兩顆我到現在都不知道是做什麼的。
整個夏天，我只用兩顆：開機，跟溫度往下。
當初買的時候，我是為了那十四種功能才選這台的。現在我懂了，夏天只會跟你要一種：涼。剩下那十二顆，是我買來證明自己有做功課的心意。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡遙控器功能一大堆、實際只按兩顆的人自嘲
variations: 遙控器上最常按的那兩顆，字都磨掉了；其他十二顆還很新。
我買的是十四種功能，我用的是兩種：開，跟更冷。

en.content:
The remote for my AC has fourteen buttons.
Dry, fan, auto, turbo, quiet, swing, timer, self-clean, and two I still can't identify.
All summer I use exactly two: power, and temperature down.
I picked this model for those fourteen functions. Turns out summer only ever asks for one, and it's cold. The other twelve were me buying proof that I'd done my research.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose loaded AC remote gets used for exactly two buttons
variations: Two buttons on my remote have worn blank. The other twelve still look brand new.
I bought fourteen modes. I use two: on, and colder.

items.sourceNote: 高樓層門窗緊閉仍出現蚊子、疑從冷氣縫隙鑽入的討論報導；改寫成密封房間與整夜電費的原創自嘲

zh-tw.content:
為了不讓冷氣的涼漏出去，我把門窗關到一條縫都不留，連排水孔都塞起來。
昨晚房間裡照樣冒出一隻蚊子。
我開燈找了四十分鐘，冷氣全程沒關，那四十分鐘的電，是我付的。
所以我封住的不是縫，是我自己——現在全社區睡得最涼的，是牠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合房間封得密不透風、還是被一隻蚊子搞到整夜開燈的人自嘲
variations: 門窗封死的意義，最後只是幫一隻蚊子省下找地方乘涼的力氣。
我付了一整晚的電費，養出一隻全棟最嬌貴的蚊子。

en.content:
To keep the cold from leaking out, I sealed every window until there wasn't a gap left. I even plugged the floor drain.
Last night a mosquito turned up in my room anyway.
I hunted it for forty minutes with the lights on and the AC running the whole time. I paid for those forty minutes.
So what I sealed in wasn't the cold air. It was me. That mosquito is now the best air-conditioned resident in the building.
en.editorNote: For the sealed-tight bedroom that still produced one mosquito at 2am
variations: I closed every gap in the apartment. All I did was save one mosquito the trouble of finding somewhere cool.
A whole night of billed electricity, and the only one enjoying it had wings.

items.sourceNote: 變頻冷氣何時開關最省的說明文；延伸改寫成用手機提前開冷氣、人卻沒回家的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
新冷氣可以連手機，我在捷運上就先把家裡開起來，回到家一開門就是涼的，爽度破表。
用了兩個禮拜，有一天我臨時被留下來加班到十點。
那天我家客廳從六點涼到十點，涼得很完整、很安靜，也很沒有觀眾。
遠端遙控最厲害的地方，是它讓我連不在家的時候都能付錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合買了可連手機的冷氣、習慣先開再回家，結果行程被打亂的上班族
variations: 科技讓我提前四十分鐘涼快，也讓我提前四十分鐘開始計費。
那天晚上最舒服的不是我，是我家那張沒人坐的沙發。

en.content:
My new AC pairs with my phone, so I switch it on from the train. Walking into an already-cold apartment is genuinely great.
Two weeks in, I got pulled into a late shift and didn't get home until ten.
That evening my living room was beautifully cool from six to ten. Perfectly cool. Completely empty.
The best feature of remote control is that it lets me pay for comfort in a room I'm not standing in.
en.editorNote: For anyone who pre-cools the apartment from their phone and then gets held up at work
variations: Tech gets me cold forty minutes early, and billed forty minutes early too.
The most comfortable thing in my apartment that night was the couch, and it was alone.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電費級距與帳單計算懶人包；延伸改寫成分租房客均分電費的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
我們這層樓有五個房間，電費的規矩很簡單：帳單來了，除以五。
問題是，一號房整天在家接案，冷氣沒關過；我朝九晚九，房間白天是空的。
收錢那天大家都笑笑的，沒有人想當第一個開口的人。
所以我每兩個月付的不只是電費，還有一筆維持和平的費用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分租雅房、電費一律均分但用量落差很大的租屋族
variations: 均分聽起來最公平，直到你發現大家在家的時數差三倍。
帳單除以五很簡單，難的是誰要先說出這樣不太公平。

en.content:
Five rooms on my floor, and the rule for electricity is simple: bill comes, divide by five.
Problem is, Room 1 freelances from home with the AC on all day. I leave at nine and get back at nine, so my room sits empty and warm.
On payment day everyone smiles. Nobody wants to be the first one to bring it up.
So every two months I'm not just paying for electricity. I'm paying a small fee to keep the peace.
en.editorNote: For shared apartments where the bill gets split evenly and the usage really isn't
variations: Splitting five ways sounds fair right up until you count who's actually home.
Dividing the bill is the easy part. Saying it out loud is not.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電費月份、時段與計算方式報導；延伸改寫成小吃店開著門吹冷氣的原創觀察

zh-tw.content:
巷口那間麵店，冷氣開得比誰都強，門卻整天敞著。
我吃到一半忍不住問老闆：這樣不是一直在把涼氣送給馬路嗎？
老闆笑一笑說：門一關，走過的人就以為今天沒開。
那碗麵我吃得特別慢。原來有一種電費，是花錢買「看起來有在營業」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊到店家開著門狂吹冷氣、把電費當招牌成本的日常觀察
variations: 那家店的冷氣不是吹給客人的，是吹給還沒走進來的人。
門口那陣涼風，是整條巷子最貴的招牌。

en.content:
The noodle shop on my corner runs its AC harder than anyone, and keeps the door wide open all day.
Halfway through my bowl I finally asked the owner: isn't that just air-conditioning the street?
He laughed and said that if he shuts the door, people walking by assume he's closed.
I ate that bowl very slowly. Turns out there's a kind of electric bill that's really just the cost of looking open.
en.editorNote: For the shops that blast AC through a permanently open door
variations: That cold air isn't for the customers inside. It's for the ones still on the sidewalk.
The draft spilling out that doorway is the most expensive sign on the block.

items.sourceNote: 夏季電費時段與家電用電懶人包；延伸改寫成「唯一不用電的家電是太陽」的原創觀察

zh-tw.content:
夏天我家所有家電都在花我的錢，只有一台不用電。
中午洗好的衣服掛上陽台，兩個小時就乾透，還帶著一股被曬過的味道。
那是這整個夏天，唯一一件熱幫我做的事，而且它從來不寄帳單。
我一邊收衣服一邊想：如果它肯順便把房間也吹涼就好了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合收衣服那一刻、突然覺得高溫終於有點用處的心情
variations: 夏天唯一免費的家電，掛在天上，而且從不寄帳單。
衣服兩小時乾透，是這個季節唯一站在我這邊的事。

en.content:
Every appliance in my place is costing me money this summer. Exactly one of them runs on nothing.
I hang the laundry on the balcony at noon and it's bone dry in two hours, smelling like sunlight.
That's the only thing the heat has done for me all season, and it never sends a bill.
Folding it all up, I had one thought: if only it would cool the bedroom on the way out.
en.editorNote: For the one moment each summer when the heat is actually doing you a favor
variations: The only free appliance I own is in the sky, and it never bills me.
Two hours to bone dry. The one thing this season got right.

items.sourceNote: 報導討論離家自住後對水電費的認知落差；延伸改寫成「第一次拿到寫自己名字的電費單」的原創觀察

zh-tw.content:
住在家裡的那些年，我每個夏天都覺得冷氣開得不夠久。
搬出來的第一個七月，我在信箱裡拿到一張電費單，收件人欄位印著我的名字。
它沒有教訓我，也沒有叫我省一點，它只是很平靜地列出一個金額，告訴我涼是有價錢的。
而過去二十幾年，這個價錢一直有人在幫我付。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合搬出來獨立的第一個夏天，或想謝謝家人卻說不出口的那一刻
variations: 涼是有價錢的。這件事我活到二十幾歲，才第一次看到金額。
以前我以為冷氣是空氣，直到那張單子上印的是我的名字。

en.content:
Twenty-odd summers, someone else covered the cool air. I never once saw the number.
My first July in my own place, an envelope showed up with my name in the addressee line.
It didn't lecture me or tell me to cut back. It just listed an amount, calmly, and let me work out that comfort has a price.
Somebody had been quietly paying that price my whole life.
en.editorNote: For your first summer paying your own bills, or when you want to thank your family and can't say it out loud
variations: Cool air has a price. I was in my twenties before I saw the figure.
Air conditioning felt like oxygen right up until the bill had my name on it.

items.sourceNote: 台電「委託金融機構代繳電費」說明頁；延伸改寫成「自動代繳讓痛感消音」的原創觀察

zh-tw.content:
我把電費改成銀行代繳，理由講得很成熟：不會忘記繳，也不用特地跑一趟。
實際效果是：從那天起，我沒有再打開過任何一個信封。
錢照樣走，只是走得很安靜，安靜到我整個夏天都覺得自己過得還算節制。
直到我為了別的事翻明細，看見三期的金額整整齊齊排成一列。
那個痛沒有消失，它只是被存起來，等一次還我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛把所有帳單自動化、才發現自己完全不知道花了多少的人
variations: 代繳不會讓電費變便宜，只會讓它變安靜。
痛感沒有不見，它排成一行躺在明細裡，等我哪天自己去翻。

en.content:
Signed up for auto-debit in four minutes. Never opened another envelope all summer.
The money still left the account. It just left quietly, and quiet money is easy to mistake for money you didn't spend.
Then I went digging through the statement for something unrelated and found three billing cycles stacked in a neat little column.
Auto-debit doesn't delete the flinch. It saves it up and hands it back all at once.
en.editorNote: For anyone who automated every bill and lost track of what they actually spend
variations: Auto-debit doesn't shrink the bill. It mutes it.
Three charges, same line item, one after another. That's a whole summer, itemized.

items.sourceNote: 吊扇耗電量與冷氣的比較（吊扇每小時約 0.08 度、冷氣 0.8～1.2 度，靠風感而非降室溫）；延伸改寫成原創

zh-tw.content:
我家客廳那台吊扇掛了八年，這八年它的工作只有一項：好看。
今年夏天我搬椅子上去，把扇葉一片一片擦乾淨，按下開關，它慢慢轉起來，聲音有點老。
查了才知道，它轉一小時大概吃 0.08 度，冷氣是它的十倍以上。
可是它不會讓房間變涼，它只是把空氣推動，讓皮膚以為涼了。
所以它真正的專長不是降溫，是用全家最便宜的成本，幫我騙我自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡有一台從沒開過的吊扇、今年終於想起它的時候
variations: 吊扇不降室溫，它只負責說服你的皮膚。
一小時 0.08 度，全家最便宜的員工，在上面掛了八年沒領過薪水。

en.content:
Eight years on that ceiling, and its entire job was looking nice.
This summer I dragged a chair over, wiped every blade, and hit the switch. It came around slowly, sounding its age.
0.08 kWh an hour. The air conditioner pulls more than ten times that.
It doesn't cool the room, though. It just moves the air until my skin decides things have improved.
Cheapest worker in the house, and the whole job is helping me fool myself.
en.editorNote: For the ceiling fan nobody in your house has switched on in years
variations: 0.08 kWh an hour, ten times cheaper than the AC and far more honest about what it can't do.
The fan never lowers the temperature. It only convinces your skin.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣遙控器說明書中的記憶設定（重新開機會回到上次的溫度與模式）；延伸改寫成原創

zh-tw.content:
每天回到家，我按下遙控器，冷氣自己回到 27 度。
這個功能我沒設定過，是它自己記著的：上次關機停在幾度，下次開機就從幾度開始。
問題是 27 度從來不是我想要的溫度。
我想要的是 24，27 是我每天晚上跟自己來回幾次之後，最後停下來的地方。
它記住的從來不是我的喜好，是我的讓步。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合每天按下遙控器、看到那個數字覺得又好笑又有點酸的時候
variations: 冷氣不記得我喜歡幾度，只記得我最後退到幾度。
27 度不是我的偏好，是我跟帳單來回之後留下來的數字。

en.content:
Press the button and it wakes up at 27. Nobody programmed that. It just keeps whatever I left it on.
27 was never the temperature I wanted. I wanted 24.
27 is where I stop every night, after going back and forth with a bill that hasn't even arrived yet.
It isn't remembering my preference. It's remembering how far I backed down.
en.editorNote: For the small daily moment when your own compromise gets handed back to you
variations: It remembers the last setting, which is never my favorite one. It's my concession.
24 is what I want, 27 is what I accept, and the remote only ever saves the second number.

items.sourceNote: 能源效率標示的年耗電量公式：額定冷氣能力/EER×1200 小時；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
買冷氣那天，我最信任的是機身上那張黃色的能源效率標示，上面寫著一年耗電幾百度，看起來便宜到有點感人。
後來我才查到那個數字是怎麼算出來的：它假設你一年只吹一千兩百小時，換算大概是四個月、每天十小時。
我家那台從六月一號到現在，幾乎沒有真正停過。
所以標示沒有騙我。是我把整整一年的份額，在一個夏天裡刷完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在比較冷氣型號、或剛收到夏月帳單開始懷疑人生的朋友
variations: 能源效率標示上的那個「年」，跟我過的這個年，顯然不是同一個單位。
那張貼紙算的是一個很有節制的人，可惜買下它的是我。

en.content:
The day I bought the unit, the thing I trusted most was that yellow efficiency label. A few hundred kilowatt-hours a year. Almost touching, how cheap that looked.
Later I found out how the number is built: it assumes you run the thing 1,200 hours a year. Four months, ten hours a day.
Mine hasn't truly stopped since the first of June.
The label never lied to me. I just burned a full year's allowance in a single summer.
en.editorNote: For anyone comparing AC models, or staring at a summer bill wondering where the math went wrong
variations: The 'year' on that efficiency label and the year I actually live are not the same unit.
That sticker was calculated for a very disciplined person. Unfortunately I'm the one who bought it.

items.sourceNote: 台灣用電結構：住宅部門約 18%、工業部門逾 55%；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
每年夏天，節電宣導都非常努力地對著我：冷氣調高一度、隨手關燈、拔掉待機的插頭。
後來我去翻用電結構才發現，住宅用電大概只佔全國的一成八，工業那邊超過五成五。
倒不是說我不該省，只是那些海報，好像貼在一個效果比較不明顯的地方。
不過那一成八裡面，屬於我家的那幾度，倒是真的一塊一塊都從我戶頭裡出去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在又一波節電宣導洗版、心裡覺得哪裡怪怪的時候發出來
variations: 全國省電的希望，壓在住宅那一成八身上，而那一成八還得自己繳電費。
我調高一度救不了電網，但確實救得了我下期的帳單。

en.content:
Every summer the save-energy campaign comes for me personally: raise the thermostat a degree, kill the lights, unplug the standby loads.
Then I looked up where the power actually goes. Households are about eighteen percent of national consumption. Industry is over fifty-five.
I'm not saying I shouldn't save. I'm saying those posters may be hanging in a fairly low-impact location.
Still, the handful of kilowatt-hours inside that eighteen percent that belong to my apartment leave my account one at a time.
en.editorNote: For that faintly annoyed feeling when another save-energy campaign shows up aimed at your thermostat
variations: The grid's hopes rest on the eighteen percent that also has to pay its own bill.
One degree higher won't save the grid. It will, however, save me on the next statement.

items.sourceNote: 分離式冷氣移機行情約 6000 元起、外牆需加計高空作業費，2026 銅管漲價；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
退租前一週，我打給師傅：「這台冷氣是我自己出錢裝的，拆走要多少？」
師傅：「拆加裝一組六千起跳，銅管今年又漲，室外機掛在外牆還要算高空。」
我：「那不拆呢？」
師傅：「那它就是牆的一部分了。」
我算了很久，最後決定把它留在那面牆上。
我在那間套房付了兩個夏天的電費，離開的時候留下一台冷氣，讓下一則租屋廣告，可以多寫一行「含冷氣」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租、搬家、或正在跟房東討論設備到底算誰的時候
variations: 租屋處的冷氣只有兩種結局：跟著你搬，或者默默變成房東的資產。
我沒有把冷氣帶走，我只是把它升級成了別人的「含冷氣」。

en.content:
A week before move-out I called the installer. 'I paid for this AC myself. What does it cost to take it with me?'
Him: 'Six thousand and up to pull it and remount it. Copper went up again this year, and your outdoor unit hangs off the exterior wall, so that's a height surcharge.'
Me: 'And if I leave it?'
Him: 'Then it's part of the wall.'
I ran the numbers for a long time and left it where it was.
I paid two summers of electricity in that studio, and I moved out leaving an air conditioner behind, so the next listing could add one more line: AC included.
en.editorNote: For move-out week, or any conversation with a landlord about who owns what on the wall
variations: A rental AC has two possible endings: it moves with you, or it quietly becomes the landlord's.
I didn't take the air conditioner with me. I just upgraded it into somebody else's 'AC included.'

items.sourceNote: 依各類家電額定功率換算一度電可運轉時數（LED 約 10W、電風扇約 45W、分離式冷氣約 1kW）；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
同樣一度電，交到不同家電手上，壽命完全不一樣：
LED 燈泡：亮一百個小時。
電風扇：吹一整天還有剩。
手機：充飽六十幾次，大概是我兩個月的份。
冷氣：一個小時。
所以我不是不會省，我只是很專情地，愛上了那個花錢最快的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合有人問你「冷氣有那麼耗電嗎」的時候，直接把這串貼過去
variations: 同樣一度電，電扇可以撐一整天，冷氣只撐一小時，而我兩個都需要。
我家最貴的不是那台冷氣，是我對「涼」的那點堅持。

en.content:
One kilowatt-hour buys wildly different amounts of life depending on which appliance gets it:
LED bulb: a hundred hours of light.
Fan: a full day, with some left over.
Phone: sixty-some full charges, roughly two months of me.
Air conditioner: one hour.
So it isn't that I can't economize. I just fell devotedly in love with the one that spends it fastest.
en.editorNote: For the friend who asks whether AC is really that power-hungry — just paste this
variations: Same kilowatt-hour: a fan stretches it across a day, the AC eats it in an hour, and I need both.
The expensive thing in my apartment isn't the air conditioner. It's my refusal to be warm.

items.sourceNote: 節氣處暑 2026 落在 8/23，「處」有躲藏、終止之意；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
處暑的「處」是躲起來的意思。
暑氣確實躲了——躲進我這期的電費單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 8/23 處暑，貼給那個說天氣要轉涼的朋友
variations: 暑氣是躲起來了，只是躲的地方比較貴。
處暑那天，我家最涼的地方還是冰箱門口。

en.content:
The solar term on August 23rd literally means the heat goes into hiding.
It did. It's hiding in my electric bill.
en.editorNote: For Aug 23, when someone insists the heat is packing up
variations: The heat did retreat. It just picked an expensive place to hide.
On the day heat officially retreats, the coolest spot in my place is still the open fridge.

items.sourceNote: 2026 七夕為 8/19；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
七夕他問我想要什麼禮物。
我說：這期的電費單，你去拆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 8/19 七夕，傳給那個說什麼都給你的人
variations: 玫瑰會謝，電費單不會，它每兩個月準時回來。
真愛不是幫我搧風，是幫我按下繳費。

en.content:
On Chinese Valentine's Day he asked what gift I wanted.
I said: you open the electric bill this time.
en.editorNote: For Aug 19 — send it to whoever says they'd give you anything
variations: Roses wilt. The electric bill comes back every two months, right on time.
True love isn't fanning me. It's hitting pay on this cycle.

items.sourceNote: 2026 暑假 7/1–8/30、8/31 開學（各縣市略有調整）；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八月的最後一週，註冊費、書包、電費，排隊進我家。
只有電費那張最誠實：
它就是這兩個月，我們在家裡活下來的價錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一週拆信箱時的心情
variations: 八月底最貴的不是開學，是開學前那兩個月。
別的帳單買到東西，電費買到的是我沒中暑。

en.content:
Last week of August: school fees, a new backpack, and the electric bill all line up at my door.
Only the last one is honest.
It's the price of surviving two months indoors.
en.editorNote: For opening the mailbox the week before school starts
