variations: The expensive part of back-to-school is the two months before it.
Other bills buy you something. This one bought me not overheating.

items.sourceNote: 秋老虎：立秋後仍持續高溫的現象；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
氣象說這波熱「週末起稍稍緩和」。
我立刻關冷氣、把窗推開，坐在客廳等那個緩和。
十分鐘後，窗關回去，遙控器拿起來。
那十分鐘我記著，當作這期帳單唯一的折扣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 每次看到「這波熱可望趨緩」就想貼一次
variations: 稍稍緩和的意思是：從很熱，變成有點熱。
秋老虎沒有要走，牠只是換一個比較溫柔的說法。

en.content:
Forecast said the heat would 'ease slightly' by the weekend.
I killed the AC, opened every window, and sat in the living room waiting for the easing.
Ten minutes later the windows were shut and the remote was back in my hand.
I'm counting those ten minutes as the only discount on this bill.
en.editorNote: For every 'relief is coming' headline in late August
variations: 'Eases slightly' means: from very hot down to fairly hot.
The late-summer heat isn't leaving. It just got a gentler name.

items.sourceNote: 台電夏季節電建議：冷氣設定 26 至 28 度；家庭情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
白天二十八度，是我家的官方立場。
凌晨兩點的真實溫度，沒有人願意作證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 全家講好省電、實際上各過各的時候貼
variations: 官方溫度二十八度，實際溫度看誰最後起床。
我家的節電成果，只存在有人醒著的時候。

en.content:
Twenty-eight degrees is my family's official position by day.
At 2 a.m. there's a real temperature, and nobody will testify.
en.editorNote: For households that agreed to save power in theory only
variations: Official setting: 28. Actual setting: whoever woke up last.
Our energy savings only exist while someone is awake to watch.

items.sourceNote: 空調溫度設定與家庭共用情境；原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
那台冷氣昨晚被調了四次。
四次都沒有人承認自己有起來過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 早上發現溫度跟睡前不一樣的時候貼
variations: 遙控器整晚都在動，全家都說自己睡得很沉。
溫度是唯一會自己走動的家人。

en.content:
That AC got adjusted four times last night.
Four times, and nobody admits getting out of bed.
en.editorNote: For the morning the setting doesn't match what you left it on
variations: The remote moved all night. Everyone claims they slept straight through.
The thermostat is the only family member that walks around alone.

items.sourceNote: 節電宣導中「冷氣調高一度省約 6%」的家庭執行情境；原創

zh-tw.content:
我媽調溫度從來不講話。
走過去，按兩下，再走回房間，像在關瓦斯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 家裡有沉默型省電執法者的時候貼
variations: 她不是在調冷氣，她是在巡邏。
按兩下的聲音，是我家夏天的門禁。

en.content:
My mom never announces it.
She walks over, taps twice, walks back, same face as shutting off the gas.
en.editorNote: For the household's silent energy-saving enforcer
variations: She isn't adjusting the AC. She's doing a patrol.
Those two beeps are my family's summer curfew.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣定溫記憶與家庭共居情境；原創

zh-tw.content:
早上起來，冷氣停在二十八度。
全家都睡得很好，這件事本身就很可疑。
zh-tw.editorNote: 當你確定有人半夜動過手腳但抓不到的時候貼
variations: 證據被關掉了，只剩下大家的好氣色。
二十八度的早上，配上四張睡飽的臉。

en.content:
Woke up and the AC read 28 again.
Everybody slept great, which is exactly the suspicious part.
en.editorNote: For when you know someone tampered overnight but can't prove it
variations: The evidence got switched off. All that's left is four well-rested faces.
A 28-degree morning, and not one person looks tired.

items.sourceNote: 台電資料：電熱水瓶／開飲機保溫一年耗電約 500 多度，與冰箱相當；瞬熱型約 21 度；改寫為第二人稱提醒

zh-tw.content:
你會為了冷氣一小時幾塊錢跟自己吵一整個晚上，卻沒認真看過廚房那台開飲機。
它光是保溫，一年就吃掉五百多度，跟你家冰箱整年的量差不多——冰箱好歹二十四小時都在做事，它只是在等你想喝水的那三杯。
不用把它丟掉。保溫從九十八度調到九十度，出遠門時拔掉，就夠了。
夏天最貴的那台，通常不是你天天在心裡審問的那台。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想提醒家人省電又不想被當碎念的時候貼，或自嘲抓錯兇手
variations: 你盯著冷氣盯了一整個夏天，那台開飲機在你背後，安安靜靜地燒了五百多度。
它不吵、不冷、也不用遙控器，所以整個夏天沒被懷疑過一次。

en.content:
You'll argue with yourself all evening over what the AC costs per hour, and you've never once looked hard at the hot water dispenser in the kitchen.
Just keeping that tank hot runs about 500 kWh a year — roughly what your fridge uses. Except the fridge is actually working the whole time. Yours is standing by for the three cups you drink.
You don't have to throw it out. Drop the hold temperature from 98 to 90, unplug it when you travel. That's it.
The priciest thing in a summer house is usually not the one you keep interrogating.
en.editorNote: For nudging the family about power use without sounding preachy
variations: You watched the AC all summer. Behind you, the water dispenser quietly burned 500 kWh.
It's not loud, not cold, and has no remote — so nobody ever suspected it.

items.sourceNote: 停電後復電瞬間的家庭場景；原創

zh-tw.content:
復電是從一聲很輕的「嗶」開始的：路由器的燈一顆一顆亮回來，牆上的鐘閃著 0:00 等人重設。
只有冷氣沒有自己回來。它記得上次的溫度，但要有人走過去，再按一次。
我站在原地，聽整間房子重新開始耗電，才發現剛剛停掉的那半小時，是這個夏天最安靜的一段時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 颱風天或社區跳電後貼，也適合半夜復電睡不著的時候
variations: 停電時家裡沒有聲音，復電時才聽得出每一台都在花錢。
電回來了，冷氣還在等一個人走過去。

en.content:
The power comes back with one small beep: the router's lights blink on one by one, the wall clock flashes 0:00, waiting for someone to reset it.
Only the AC doesn't return on its own. It remembers the temperature. It just needs a person to walk over and press it again.
I stood there listening to the whole house start spending money again, and realized that half hour without power was the quietest stretch of the entire summer.
en.editorNote: For a typhoon-day outage, or the night the building's breaker went
variations: In a blackout the house makes no sound. When the power returns, you can hear every appliance spending.
The electricity came back. The AC is still waiting for someone to walk over.

items.sourceNote: 建築牆體蓄熱、日落後仍持續放熱的體感經驗；原創

zh-tw.content:
半夜起來倒水，手背擦過走廊的牆，是溫的。
太陽下山好幾個小時了，牆還在慢慢把白天存進去的熱，一點一點還給我。
冷氣不是在跟氣溫打，是在跟一整面牆的記性打——它每個晚上都得重新贏一次，我每個月幫它付那筆贏的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜熱到睡不著、或西曬房間的租屋族
variations: 牆記得白天的太陽，然後整晚慢慢說給我聽。
手背碰到牆的那一下，我就知道今晚冷氣要加班。

en.content:
Got up for water at 2 a.m., brushed the hallway wall with the back of my hand. Still warm.
The sun set hours ago. The wall is handing back the heat it stored all day, a little at a time.
The AC isn't fighting the air temperature. It's fighting a whole wall's memory — it has to win again every night, and every month I pay for the win.
en.editorNote: For west-facing rentals and nights you can't sleep through the heat
variations: The wall remembers the afternoon sun and tells me about it all night.
One touch of the wall and I know the AC is working overtime tonight.

items.sourceNote: 2026 住宅簡易型時間電價：尖峰 5.16 元、離峰 2.06 元，需單月用電 700 度以上才可申請；改寫為量販店大包裝的類比

zh-tw.content:
我很認真研究過那個聽起來超划算的時間電價：尖峰一度五塊一，離峰兩塊零六，中間差了三塊多。
往下滑才看到門檻——單月要用到七百度以上，才有資格申請。
這件事很像量販店的大包裝：單價確實比較低，前提是你得先有一個吃得完一整箱的胃。
那張省錢的入場券，要先證明自己夠會花，才領得到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 查完電價方案發現自己不符資格時貼，或朋友推薦你換方案的時候
variations: 便宜的那個級距不是給省的人，是給用得夠多的人。
七百度是入場費，我連報名資格都省掉了。

en.content:
I looked seriously into that time-of-use rate that sounds like such a deal: about NT$5.16 per unit at peak, NT$2.06 off-peak, a gap of more than three dollars.
Then I scrolled down to the fine print — you need to burn over 700 units in a single month to even qualify.
It's the warehouse-store bulk pack, basically: the unit price really is lower, provided you have the stomach to finish an entire case.
The ticket to saving money goes to whoever can prove they spend enough.
en.editorNote: For when you check the rate plans and find out you don't qualify
variations: The cheap tier isn't for people who save. It's for people who use enough.
700 units is the cover charge. I saved so hard I couldn't even get in line.

items.sourceNote: 台灣「乖乖文化」：把綠色乖乖放在機器上祈求運作正常；中元普渡與家電求平安的家庭情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
普渡那天，我在供桌上擺了餅乾、飲料，還有一盤切好的鳳梨。
拜完收拾的時候，我把多買的兩包綠色乖乖拆出來，一包放在路由器上，一包踮腳擺到冷氣的機殼上。
我媽在旁邊笑我迷信，我說一包十幾塊，比八月請師傅上門便宜太多。
那天晚上冷氣照樣吹到天亮，電費照樣往上跑，只有那包乖乖，是我這個夏天花得最安心的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拜拜或普渡完在家電上放乖乖時貼，也適合跟朋友聊夏天最怕冷氣罷工
variations: 供桌拜的是平安，冷氣上那包拜的是這個月別出事。
十幾塊買一包心安，比八月的維修費划算太多。

en.content:
On offering day during Ghost Month, I laid out cookies, drinks, and a plate of sliced pineapple on the altar table.
While clearing up afterward, I opened the two spare bags of green Kuai Kuai I'd bought, set one on the router, and stood on my toes to park the other on top of the AC.
My mom laughed and called me superstitious, so I told her a bag costs about fifteen NT dollars, way less than getting a technician out here in August.
The AC still ran till sunrise and the bill still climbed, but that snack was the most reassuring money I spent all summer.
en.editorNote: For when you're placing a lucky snack on your appliances, or joking about summer breakdowns
variations: The altar is for peace of mind. The bag on the AC is for no surprises this month.
Fifteen bucks of snack insurance beats an August service call.

items.sourceNote: 冷氣遙控器耗用乾電池的頻率可反映夏季操作次數；半夜換電池的家庭情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
昨天半夜，我對著冷氣按了五下遙控器，它一點反應都沒有。
我翻了三個抽屜，找到兩顆三號電池，換上去，房間才重新開始涼。
這是今年夏天換的第二組——去年一整年，我只換過一次。
那兩顆電池比帳單早兩個禮拜告訴我，這個夏天我到底伸手按了多少下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 換冷氣遙控器電池時貼，或想吐槽自己今年開了多少次冷氣
variations: 電池比帳單早兩個禮拜給我答案。
今年夏天最誠實的計數器，是兩顆三號電池。

en.content:
Last night I pointed the remote at the AC and pressed five times, and it didn't blink.
I dug through three drawers, found two AA batteries, swapped them in, and the room finally started cooling again.
That's the second set this summer — last year one set lasted me the whole year.
Those two batteries told me two weeks before the bill did exactly how many times I reached over and pressed.
en.editorNote: For remote-battery-swap night, or admitting how often you've touched that button
variations: The batteries gave me the answer two weeks before the bill did.
The most honest counter in my house this summer was a pair of AAs.

items.sourceNote: 台電第一線人員的工作範圍以電力設備與線路維護為主，與電費計收分屬不同單位；同學會情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
同學會上，大家一知道阿凱在台電上班，話題就再也回不去了。
有人問他今年為什麼這麼貴，有人要他解釋級距，還有人直接把手機裡的帳單拍照舉到他面前。
阿凱夾了一口菜，很平靜地說：「我修的是線路，不是帳單。」
那頓飯他被敬了六次酒，每一次的開場白都是「拜託你幫我看一下」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給在公用事業上班、每年夏天都被親友當成客服的朋友
variations: 他修的是線路，我們卻拿帳單堵他。
認識台電的人不會讓電費變便宜，只會讓你有地方講。

en.content:
At the class reunion, the second everyone found out Kai works at the power company, the conversation never went anywhere else.
One guy asked why it's so expensive this year, another wanted the rate tiers explained, and someone just held a photo of their bill up to his face.
Kai took a bite of his food and said, very calmly, "I fix power lines, not bills."
He got toasted six times that night, and every toast opened with "hey, take a look at this for me."
en.editorNote: For friends who work in utilities and get treated as customer service every summer
variations: He fixes the lines. We cornered him with our bills anyway.
Knowing someone at the power company doesn't lower the bill. It just gives you somewhere to complain.

items.sourceNote: 夏月電價每年 6/1 至 9/30 實施；為夏季電費預先存錢的理財情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
三年前，我開了一個小帳戶，名字取叫「夏天」。
每年十月開始，每個月自動轉四百塊進去，轉到隔年五月，裡面剛好三千二。
六月一號夏月電價一開跑，我就從這個帳戶開始扣，扣到九月底通常剛好見底。
這樣做沒有讓電費變便宜，只是把一次的痛，改成八個月一點一點先付完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分享電費預算做法時貼，或解釋為什麼你每年十月就開始存錢
variations: 電費沒有變便宜，只是被我提前分期。
十月開始存，六月開始花，這就是我的夏天。

en.content:
Three years ago I opened a small savings account and named it Summer.
Every October it starts pulling four hundred NT a month, and by the following May there's exactly thirty-two hundred sitting in there.
On June first, when summer rates kick in, I start drawing it down, and it usually hits zero right at the end of September.
It never made the electricity cheaper. It just spread one painful month across eight quiet ones.
en.editorNote: For sharing your summer-bill budgeting trick, or explaining why you save starting in October
variations: The bill didn't shrink. I just paid it in installments before it arrived.
Save from October, spend from June. That's my whole summer.

items.sourceNote: 台電智慧電表可自動回傳用電資料，取代人工到府抄表；抄表員消失的生活觀察為原創

zh-tw.content:
以前每兩個月，會有一個穿背心的人走進我家騎樓，拿機器對著電表按一下，再在紙上寫下幾個數字。
換成智慧電表之後，他就沒有再出現過，度數自己每天飛去台電。
我偶爾會想起他——不是想念抄表這件事，是那大概是唯一一次，有人親眼看過我家的用電，然後什麼都沒說就走了。
現在沒有人來了，帳單還是準時到，而且比他知道得更多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 換裝智慧電表後貼，或聊那些被自動化悄悄取代掉的日常畫面
variations: 以前是有人來看一眼，現在是機器每天回報。
抄表的人不來了，帳單反而更清楚我在幹嘛。

en.content:
Every couple of months, a guy in a work vest used to walk into my alley, point a handheld at the meter, and write a few numbers down on a slip.
After the smart meter went in he never showed up again, and the readings started flying to the power company on their own.
I still think about him once in a while — not about the meter reading itself, but because he was the one person who ever saw my usage with his own eyes and then walked off without saying a word.
Nobody comes by anymore, the bill still lands on time, and it knows more than he ever did.
en.editorNote: For when your smart meter goes in, or for talking about the small routines automation quietly removed
variations: Someone used to glance at it every two months. Now a machine reports it daily.
The meter reader stopped coming, and the bill got even better informed.

items.sourceNote: 遠見〈2026夏季電價怎麼算〉整理夏月電價與省電方式，延伸改寫成「出門避暑省電」的生活場景

zh-tw.content:
週六下午，我帶著泳鏡走進社區運動中心，盤算著這三個小時家裡可以一度電都不用。
門票一百塊，換三小時的水，還附熱水澡，怎麼算都比讓那台機器對著空房間空轉划算。
我跳下去，水是溫的，像有人清晨就先幫我把整池洗澡水放好了。
泡到第四十分鐘我才想通，這一池水從天亮就攤在太陽底下，我花一百塊，買到了一缸免費的溫泉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在你為了省電跑出門泡水、結果發現外面比家裡還熱的那天
variations: 為了省電跑去泳池，泡的是一池曬了一整天的水。
門票一百塊，換到的是一缸免費溫泉。

en.content:
Saturday afternoon I walked into the community rec center with my goggles, doing the math on three whole hours of not running the AC at home.
Six bucks for three hours of water plus a hot shower beats paying that machine to hum at an empty apartment.
I jumped in and the water was warm, like somebody had drawn me a bath at sunrise and left it sitting there.
Forty minutes in it hit me that the pool had been lying under the sun since daybreak, so my six bucks bought me a free hot spring.
en.editorNote: For the day your cheap cooling plan turns out to be warmer than your living room
variations: Went to the pool to save power and swam in a full day of stored sunlight.
Six dollars in, and the prize was a free hot spring.

items.sourceNote: 商周〈2026夏季電價怎麼計算〉的省電建議，改寫成傳統消暑寢具與冷氣對照的擬人場景

zh-tw.content:
我在衣櫃最上層捲著躺了三年，沒有人想起我。
今年夏天他們把我攤開，說要試試看少開一點冷氣，我有點緊張，也很想表現。
前二十分鐘我確實是涼的，他背一貼上來還會抖一下那種涼。
第二十一分鐘，他伸手按了遙控器，然後躺回我身上，於是我成為一張很涼快的、被冷氣吹著的蓆子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在你翻出老物件想省電、最後還是回頭按下遙控器的那個晚上
variations: 我涼了二十分鐘，第二十一分鐘冷氣就來接手了。
被翻出來的那天我很努力，可惜夏天不看努力。

en.content:
I spent three summers rolled up on the top shelf of the closet with nobody giving me a thought.
This year they unrolled me and announced they were going to try running the AC less, and honestly I was nervous and eager to do well.
For the first twenty minutes I was genuinely cool, the kind of cool that makes a bare back flinch on contact.
At minute twenty-one he reached for the remote, then lay back down on me, and that is how I became a very cool mat with air conditioning blowing across it.
en.editorNote: For when the old low-tech fix gets a heroic twenty minutes before the remote wins
variations: I was cool for twenty minutes, and then the AC took over my shift.
They unrolled me with high hopes, and summer was not impressed.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報：2026 夏季電價調漲，一般家庭夏月電費約多出四五百元，改寫成家中自訂用電規矩的場景

zh-tw.content:
冰箱門上多了一張紙，我媽用紅筆寫了三條家規。
一、最後離開客廳的人負責關冷氣。
二、門開超過三秒的人，晚餐後洗碗。
三、想把溫度調低的人先在紙上簽名，那一格到今天還是空的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在全家開始為了電費立規矩、卻沒有人敢當第一個違規者的那幾天
variations: 三條家規貼在冰箱上，最後一格從來沒有人簽過。
我家真正在管冷氣的，是冰箱門上那張紙。

en.content:
A sheet of paper showed up on the fridge door, three house rules in my mom's red marker.
One, last person out of the living room kills the AC.
Two, hold the door open longer than three seconds and you are on dishes.
Three, anyone who wants the temperature lower signs their name below, and that line is still blank.
en.editorNote: For the stretch when a family starts writing electricity rules nobody wants to be the first to break
variations: Three rules on the fridge, and nobody has signed the last one yet.
The thing actually running our AC is a sheet of paper on the fridge door.

items.sourceNote: 中時報導：冷氣不必死守 26 度、每調低一度耗電約增一成，改寫成小孩發問的對話場景

zh-tw.content:
姪子指著遙控器上的數字問我：「你為什麼一直把它調來調去？」
我說：「因為每低一度，我們家就要多付一點錢給發電的人。」
他想了三秒，抬頭很認真地問：「那可以把太陽關掉嗎？」
那個下午我沒有再碰遙控器，讓他把二十四度吹好吹滿。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在小孩問了一個你答不出來的問題、你就當場放棄省電的那天
variations: 他問可不可以把太陽關掉，那天我就沒再碰遙控器了。
小孩的省電方案比較徹底，直接從源頭處理。

en.content:
My nephew pointed at the number on the remote and asked, "Why do you keep moving it around?"
I told him, "Because every degree lower costs us a little more money to the people who make the electricity."
He thought about it for three seconds, looked up, and asked very seriously, "Can we just turn off the sun?"
I didn't touch the remote again that afternoon, and I let him keep it at seventy-five for as long as he wanted.
en.editorNote: For the day a kid asks a question you can't answer and you quietly give up on saving power
variations: He asked if we could turn off the sun, and I set the remote down.
Kids go straight to the root cause of the electric bill.

items.sourceNote: 遠見雜誌：2026 夏季電價計算與冷氣設定溫度建議，改寫成「就算不用自己付錢也不敢調低」的自問自答

zh-tw.content:
我認真想過一個問題：有人願意替我付整季電費的話，我會把冷氣調到幾度？
我以為自己會很豪邁地一路按到十八度，吹到要蓋兩件棉被那種。
可是真的把那個畫面想到底，我的手還是停在二十六。
這個夏天最厲害的地方，是它把節制直接刻進了我的手指。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在你發現自己就算不用付錢，也已經不敢把溫度調低的那個瞬間
variations: 就算有人幫我付，我的手還是停在二十六度。
省電省久了，節制會自己長進手指裡。

en.content:
I put a real question to myself: someone else is covering my whole summer bill, so how low do I crank the AC?
I figured I'd slam it down to sixty-four and sleep under two blankets like a rich guy.
But when I actually pictured it, my hand still stopped at seventy-eight.
That's the scary part of this summer, it filed the restraint straight down into my fingers.
en.editorNote: For the moment you realize you'd keep the thermostat modest even if the bill wasn't yours
variations: Even on someone else's dime, my hand stops at seventy-eight.
Save power long enough and the restraint moves into your fingers.

items.sourceNote: 商周：2026 夏季電價與冷氣使用建議，改寫成計程車司機旁觀乘客的場景

zh-tw.content:
那個計程車司機大概是整個八月唯一注意到我的人。
他說我一上車第一句永遠是「冷氣可以再強一點嗎」，而且從頭到尾都不看窗外。
下車前他多問了一句：你家是不是都沒在開冷氣？
我笑一笑，付了錢，走進一棟連樓梯間都在冒熱氣的舊公寓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在你把冷氣省在家裡、靠別人的車廂跟賣場續命的那種夏天
variations: 司機比我自己更早發現，我家沒在開冷氣。
我一整個八月的涼，都是跟別人借來的。

en.content:
That cab driver was probably the only person all August who actually noticed me.
He said the first thing out of my mouth every ride is "can you turn the AC up," and I never once look out the window.
Before I got out he asked one more thing: you don't run the AC at home, do you?
I smiled, paid him, and walked into an old walk-up where even the stairwell was breathing heat.
en.editorNote: For the summer you skip AC at home and borrow it from cabs, stores, and other people's lobbies
variations: The cab driver figured out my home AC situation before I admitted it.
Every cool minute I got in August, I borrowed from somebody else.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報：2026 夏季電費調漲與家庭省電，改寫成家中對「開一下就好」這句話的自訂定義

zh-tw.content:
「冷氣開一下就好，不要開整晚喔。」
「好啦。」
「你上次也是這樣講，我早上六點進你房間，冷得跟冰庫一樣。」
「那我設兩點自動關掉好了。」
「設兩點你三點就會爬起來重開，我看過，而且你還會順手把溫度再調低。」
「那你說要設幾點？」
「我又沒有說不能開，我是說開一下就好。」
「所以到底是幾點。」
「就開一下就好啊。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個家裡每晚都在為冷氣定時吵三分鐘的人
variations: 「那要設幾點？」「就開一下就好啊。」
我媽說的一下，長度大概等於一個晚上。

en.content:
"Just run the AC for a bit, don't leave it on all night."
"Okay, okay."
"You said that last time too. I opened your door at six and it was a walk-in freezer."
"Fine, I'll set the timer to shut off at two."
"Set it for two and you'll be up at three turning it back on. I've seen you. You turn it down a degree while you're at it."
"Then you tell me what time."
"I never said you can't run it. I said run it for a bit."
"Okay but what time."
"For a bit is what time."
en.editorNote: For anyone whose household relitigates the AC timer every single night
variations: "So what time?" "Just for a bit."
My mom's "a bit" runs about eight hours.

items.sourceNote: 公視新聞：台電估今年夏夜尖峰用電創新高，改寫成期待入秋第一個不用開冷氣的夜晚

zh-tw.content:
今年一定會有那麼一個晚上，我伸手要拿遙控器，然後停在半空中。
窗戶那邊會有一陣涼風灌進來，房間的溫度剛剛好，我大概要愣個兩秒才反應得過來。
我會把遙控器放回桌上，把被子拉好，睡一場不用花錢的覺。
那一晚遲早會到，日期還沒公布而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在暑氣還沒退、但你已經開始期待第一個不用開冷氣的夜晚的時候
variations: 第一個不用開冷氣的晚上，遲早會到。
今年一定有一晚，我的手會停在遙控器前面。

en.content:
There's going to be a night this year when I reach for the remote and stop halfway.
Cool air will come through the window, the room will already be the right temperature, and it'll take me two full seconds to catch up.
I'll set the remote back down, pull the blanket up, and sleep a night that costs nothing.
That night is coming, they just haven't announced the date yet.
en.editorNote: For the stretch when the heat hasn't broken but you're already counting on the first AC-free night
variations: The first night I don't need the AC is coming.
One night this year, my hand is going to stop short of the remote.

items.sourceNote: 臺中市里活動中心 E 化資訊網 場地借用制度取靈感；申請書內容全為改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
借用場地：里民活動中心二樓，靠窗那一間
借用單位：本里三鄰，一戶，一人
借用時段：每週二、四，下午一點到五點
活動名稱：讀書會
預計人數：一人。我媽那天沒事的話，兩人
需求設備：桌子一張、插座一個，燈開一半就好
借用事由：想讓家裡那台，下午先休息四個小時
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個八月都在外面待到傍晚才願意回家的朋友
variations: 夏天最搶手的公共設施，是有桌子、有插座、而且不用你付電費的那一種。
我在借用事由那一欄想了很久，最後只寫了「讀書」兩個字。

en.content:
Space requested: Community center, second floor, the room by the window
Applicant: One household, one person
Time slot: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 1pm to 5pm
Activity: Book club
Expected attendance: One. Two, if my mom is free
Equipment needed: One table, one outlet, half the lights is plenty
Reason for booking: So the unit at home can take four hours off
en.editorNote: For the friend who spends all of August somewhere with a public outlet
variations: The hottest amenity of the summer is a table, an outlet, and a bill somebody else pays.
I sat on the 'reason for booking' field for a long time and finally wrote: reading.

items.sourceNote: 遠見 2026 夏季電價說明報導；場景與情節全為改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
設計師把梳子壓在我的瀏海上，問我這次想留多長。
我盯著鏡子想了三秒，手在圍布底下伸進口袋，把手機翻過去，讓螢幕暗掉。
那封通知我還沒點開，可是在一整面鏡子前面，我的表情大概已經先幫我點開了。
剪短一點吧——我這個月剩下的每一件事，都是用同一個理由決定的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼給那個剛好坐在鏡子前面收到帳單通知的人
variations: 理髮店的鏡子最誠實的地方，是你連把手機朝下放都藏不住。
剪短一點，吹頭髮就快一點，這句話今年聽起來特別有道理。

en.content:
The stylist pressed the comb flat against my bangs and asked how long I wanted to keep it.
I stared at the mirror for three seconds, slid a hand under the cape, and turned my phone face down.
I hadn't opened the notification yet, but in front of a full wall of mirrors, my face had already opened it for me.
Take it short — everything else I've decided this month came down to the same reason.
en.editorNote: For anyone who got the bill alert while stuck in a barber's chair
variations: A barbershop mirror's cruelest feature: face down doesn't hide anything.
Shorter hair, shorter blow-dry. This year that math finally makes sense.

items.sourceNote: 城市學 老宅二手書店專題取氛圍靈感；情節全為改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上禮拜我在家裡的地板上翻開那本小說，看了兩頁，字就開始在眼前浮起來，只好闔上去洗臉。
昨天下午在轉角那家二手書店，我靠著書架把同一本書從第二頁看到第八十頁，中間只換過一次腳。
同一本書、同一個人、同一個八月，差別只在那四十分鐘的涼是誰在付。
最後我把書買回家了，然後它就一直躺在桌上，安安靜靜地回到那個看不下去的溫度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個整個夏天都在別人店裡把書看完的書蟲
variations: 同一本書在店裡看得完，在家看不完，中間隔的是四度。
二手書店最珍貴的館藏，是靠牆那排書架前面的空氣。

en.content:
Last week I opened that novel on my living room floor, made it two pages in, and the letters started floating.
Yesterday afternoon I leaned against a shelf in the used bookstore around the corner and read the same book from page two to page eighty, shifting my weight exactly once.
Same book, same person, same August — the only difference was who paid for those forty cool minutes.
I bought it and carried it home, where it has been lying on the table ever since, quietly back at the temperature I can't read in.
en.editorNote: For the reader who finished the whole summer's books inside other people's shops
variations: Finishable in the shop, unfinishable at home — the gap between them is four degrees.
A used bookstore's most valuable holding is the air in front of the back shelf.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報 2026 夏季電價報導；傳統市場攤商作息情節全為改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
04:40　鐵捲門拉開，第一件事是把攤子上那排燈全部點亮。
05:20　賣魚的先開工，碎冰倒下去的聲音整條街都聽得到。
07:05　我把最外側那盞燈關掉，外面已經亮到不需要它。
10:30　太陽爬過對面屋頂，光直接打在攤子上，我把遮陽布再往外拉一格。
13:00　收攤前把冰櫃塞滿，塞得越滿，它下午越省力。
14:10　關燈的順序跟早上完全相反，最後關的是冰櫃旁邊那一盞。
隔月上旬　帳單送到，上面那個數字，是這條街醒著的時間加起來的樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個天還沒亮就得先開燈做生意的攤商朋友
variations: 攤商算成本的方式很簡單：一盞燈亮了幾個小時，就是幾個小時。
市場的作息表寫在燈上，開幾盞、關幾盞，比時鐘還準。

en.content:
04:40 Shutter up. First job: switch on the whole row of lights over the stall.
05:20 The fish guy opens first; crushed ice hitting the counter carries down the entire street.
07:05 I kill the outermost bulb — it's bright enough out there now.
10:30 Sun clears the roof across the way and lands straight on the stall; I pull the awning out one more notch.
13:00 Before closing, pack the chiller full. The fuller it is, the less it has to work all afternoon.
14:10 Lights go off in exactly the reverse order. The last one is beside the chiller.
Early next month The bill arrives, and that number is what this street's waking hours add up to.
en.editorNote: For the vendor friend who turns the lights on before the sun does
variations: A market vendor's cost accounting is simple: how many hours a bulb was on, that's the number.
You can read this market's schedule off its lights better than off any clock.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報 2026 夏季電價報導（住宅夏月電價 6/1-9/30、六段式累進）；ATM 服務區廣播情節為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
本行自動櫃員機服務區溫馨提醒——
本區冷氣全日運轉，歡迎您在操作期間安心使用。
提醒您，查詢餘額後請取回卡片，勿因螢幕上的數字滯留原地。
提醒您，隔壁那位先生已重複查詢三次，本行系統並未故障。
提醒您，若您的餘額變化與本月天氣有關，本行恕難為您調整。
祝您操作順利，離開前記得帶走卡片、明細與心情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 繳完電費後在提款機前站到懷疑人生時，發給同樣剛看完餘額的朋友
variations: 提款機前那三十秒的冷氣，是這個月我唯一覺得划算的公共財。
螢幕上那個數字沒有壞，壞的是我八月每天二十四小時的用電習慣。

en.content:
Attention, customers in the ATM lobby.
The air conditioning in this area runs all day. Please make yourself comfortable while you bank.
Please remember to take your card after checking your balance, and do not linger over the number on screen.
Please note that the gentleman beside you has now checked three times. Our system is not broken.
Please note that if your balance shifted along with this month's weather, we are unable to adjust it for you.
Thank you, and on your way out please take your card, your receipt, and your feelings.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend who also just checked their balance after paying the power bill
variations: Those thirty seconds of cold air in the ATM lobby were the best value I got all month.
The number on the screen isn't the malfunction. My twenty-four-hour August is.

items.sourceNote: 秋老虎／處暑後仍高溫的科普報導；賣場冷凍區廣播情節為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
賣場廣播：各位顧客午安，冷凍食品區溫度穩定，歡迎選購。
第七排冷凍櫃前的那位先生，您已經在同一個位置比較了二十分鐘的水餃。
本賣場理解八月的走道很涼，也理解您家很熱。
不過櫃門開太久會影響品質，麻煩您先關上，站旁邊一樣涼。
再次提醒，本區販售水餃，不販售整個下午。祝您購物愉快。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個週末寧可去賣場逛三小時也不肯在家開冷氣的省電夥伴
variations: 冷凍區的涼是免費的，代價是我推著推車假裝自己還在挑東西。
秋老虎最忠實的信徒，週末都站在冷凍櫃前面研究水餃成分表。

en.content:
Store announcement: good afternoon, shoppers. The frozen section is holding temperature nicely.
To the gentleman at freezer aisle seven: you have now compared the same two bags of dumplings for twenty minutes.
We understand the aisle is cool in August. We also understand your apartment is not.
Still, holding the door open hurts the product, so please close it. It is just as cold standing beside it.
A reminder: this aisle sells dumplings, not entire afternoons. Enjoy your shopping.
en.editorNote: For the friend who'd rather browse a store for three hours than run the AC at home
variations: The chill in the frozen aisle is free. The price is pushing a cart around pretending to shop.
Every true believer in the late-summer heat spends Saturday reading dumpling labels at the freezer.

items.sourceNote: 2026 處暑落在 8/23、處暑後秋老虎仍猖狂；搭配夏月電價計費至 9/30 的常識，問答內容為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
Ｑ：處暑一到，電費會跟著變便宜嗎？
Ａ：夏月電價算到九月三十日為止，節氣不參與計費。
Ｑ：冷氣調高一度真的有用嗎？
Ａ：有用，大約省百分之六，通常會被您半夜爬起來調回去的那一下抵銷。
Ｑ：那為什麼公司的冷氣感覺特別涼？
Ａ：因為那筆錢沒有出現在您的帳單上。這也是本季最有效的省電法。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給每年立秋、處暑都以為電費要打折的那位家人
variations: 節氣管的是太陽的行程，台電管的是月曆上的六月到九月，兩邊沒在對帳。
我在公司最涼的位置坐了一整個八月，回家才想起來自己有多會省。

en.content:
Q: The end-of-heat solar term just hit. Does the bill get cheaper now?
A: Summer rates run through September 30. The old calendar doesn't get a vote in billing.
Q: Does raising the AC by one degree actually help?
A: It does, around six percent, usually cancelled out by you getting up at 2am to lower it again.
Q: Then why does the office AC feel so much colder?
A: Because that money never shows up on your bill. Best energy-saving trick of the season.
en.editorNote: Forward it to the relative who expects a discount every time the calendar says autumn
variations: Solar terms track the sun's schedule; the power company tracks June through September. They don't compare notes.
I spent all of August in the coldest seat at the office, then went home and called myself thrifty.

items.sourceNote: 商周 2026 夏季電價說明（6/1-9/30、離峰時段與冷氣設定）；房東留言條情節為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
給三樓的你：
這期電費單我夾在你的信封裡了，兩個月，比上一期多一千二。
我沒有要唸你，八月那幾天三十六度，我自己也是開整晚的。
只是想講，你房間那台是十二年前的機器，該換了，我出一半。
另外一半，等九月三十號夏月電價結束再來談。
——房東 敬上
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在房客信箱上，或轉給那個正在跟老冷氣硬撐的租屋朋友
variations: 十二年的老冷氣沒有在幫你省錢，它把錢分期收走，收在每一期帳單裡。
房東肯出一半的那天，通常代表他自己也拆過那張帳單。

en.content:
To the tenant on the third floor:
This cycle's power bill is tucked into your envelope. Two months, twelve hundred more than last time.
I'm not scolding you. On those 36-degree days in August I ran mine all night too.
I just want to say: the unit in your room is twelve years old. It's time. I'll cover half.
The other half we can discuss after summer rates end on September 30.
— Your landlord
en.editorNote: Tape it to the mailbox, or send it to the friend still fighting a decade-old AC unit
variations: A twelve-year-old AC unit doesn't save you money. It just collects it in installments, one bill at a time.
The day a landlord offers to pay half is usually the day he opened his own bill.

items.sourceNote: 遠見雜誌 2026 夏季電價計算說明（累進費率、夏月 6/1-9/30）；驗光室情節為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
在眼鏡行等驗光等了二十二分鐘，那間不到五坪的小房間開二十四度，是我整個八月待過最涼的地方。
驗光師換了七片鏡片，要我念五公尺外那排字，右眼報出來是三百二十五度。
我聽見「度」這個字，腦子裡浮上來的卻是電費單上那個四百二十八。
走出店門外面三十六度，我夾著還沒配好的試鏡架，第一次發現看得清楚跟活得涼快，我大概只付得起一樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配眼鏡那天發，或給每次聽到「度」都會先想到電表的人
variations: 驗光室的冷氣是全店最強的，因為機器怕熱，這件事我在裡面坐了二十二分鐘才想通。
同樣一個字，眼睛量出來花的是一次錢，電表量出來花的是一整個夏天。

en.content:
I waited twenty-two minutes for my eye exam, and that little room, barely two hundred square feet and held at seventy-five degrees, was the coolest place I'd been all August.
The optometrist swapped seven lenses and had me read a chart sixteen feet away; my right eye came back at 325.
He said the number out loud and the one that surfaced in my head was 428, the reading printed on this cycle's power bill.
Outside it was ninety-seven, and with the trial frames still clamped to my nose I worked out that seeing clearly and living cool are two things I can only afford one of.
en.editorNote: Post it the day you pick out new frames, or send it to anyone who hears a number and thinks of the meter first
variations: The exam room has the strongest AC in the store because the machines hate heat. It took twenty-two minutes in that chair for me to work that out.
One reading costs you a single visit. The other one costs you an entire summer.

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網報導校園冷氣降載與教室用電上限；桃園市校園能源管理系統設定室溫二十八度才啟動冷氣為公開資訊，題目情節為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
Ｑ　下午一點的操場，跑道踩下去是燙的，體育老師說今天繞四圈。下列何者最接近你此刻的想法？
（Ａ）跑完就能回教室，教室有冷氣
（Ｂ）教室那台要室溫到二十八度才准開，現在室內二十七點五
（Ｃ）榕樹的影子只夠站六個人，我排第七
◯（Ｄ）先去水龍頭把整顆頭沖濕，這是我今天唯一免費的降溫
（Ｅ）以上皆是，只是我沒力氣圈四次
作答方式：單選。圈選處為原筆跡，塗改不予計分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前後貼給還要在大太陽底下上體育課的人，或給任何一個把教室冷氣門檻背起來的學生
variations: 室溫二十八度才開冷氣這條規則，訂的人多半沒在下午一點站過跑道。
全班最會算數的，是每次下課衝去卡住榕樹陰影的那六個人。

en.content:
Q. It's one in the afternoon, the track is hot enough to feel through your shoes, and the coach says four laps. Which is closest to what you're thinking?
(A) Finish, then get back to the classroom, the classroom has AC
(B) That unit won't switch on until the room hits 82°F, and it's 81.5 in there right now
(C) The banyan's shade fits six people and I'm number seven
◯ (D) Go soak my whole head under the tap, the only free cooling I get today
(E) All of the above, I just don't have the energy to circle it four times
Single answer only. The circle is the original mark; erasures will not be scored.
en.editorNote: For the first week back, when outdoor PE is still a heat event and everybody knows the AC threshold by heart
variations: Whoever wrote the 82-degree rule has never stood on a track at one in the afternoon.
The sharpest math students in the class are the six who sprint for the banyan shade at the bell.

items.sourceNote: 台電新聞稿：住宅夏月電價已實施 37 年、超過七成用戶每度平均不到 3 元；河堤涼亭借用本情節為原創

zh-tw.content:
借用本　河堤三號涼亭（納涼用具，用完請放回）
八月十四日：摺疊椅一張　陳先生　當晚放回
八月十六日：手持電風扇一台　陳先生　尚未放回
八月十七日：保冷冰桶一只　林太太　隔天放回，裡面多了兩罐冬瓜茶
八月十八日：延長線十公尺　林太太　尚未放回，說要接涼亭那個插座
八月二十日：摺疊椅四張　姓名空白　全被搬到堤頂看夕陽，天亮前自己回來了
最後一頁有人用鉛筆加寫一行：在家吹一晚要錢，在這裡吹一整個夏天，只要記得放回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傍晚去河堤走路的人會懂；也適合轉給整個夏天都關在家裡開冷氣的朋友
variations: 延長線借出去五天沒還，通常代表水邊已經自己長出一個乘涼社團。
那四張椅子沒有失蹤，它們只是先去堤頂看了一場夕陽。

en.content:
Loan book — Pavilion No. 3, riverbank walk (shared cooling gear, please put it back)
Aug 14 — one folding chair — Mr. Chen — returned that night
Aug 16 — one handheld fan — Mr. Chen — still out
Aug 17 — one cooler — Mrs. Lin — back the next day, with two extra bottles of winter melon tea inside
Aug 18 — thirty feet of extension cord — Mrs. Lin — still out, says it's reaching the pavilion outlet
Aug 20 — four folding chairs — name left blank — all carried up to the levee for sunset, walked home before dawn
Someone penciled a line on the last page: a night of cool air at home costs money, a whole summer of it out here only costs remembering to put things back.
en.editorNote: For anyone who walks the river at dusk, and for the friend who spent all of August sealed indoors with the AC running
variations: An extension cord five days overdue usually means a cooling club has quietly formed down by the water.
The four chairs were never missing. They went up to watch the sunset first.

items.sourceNote: 中央社報導住宅夏月電價 6/1 上路、每戶平均電費估月增 446 元；剪髮對話為原創

zh-tw.content:
「這次想剪多短？」
「剪到洗完頭不用吹就會乾的那種。」
「你上次也這樣講，最後留到肩膀。」
「上次那期電費還沒寄來。」
「所以是帳單在幫你決定髮型。」
「它管的可多了，冷氣幾度、風扇轉幾格，現在連瀏海都歸它——」
zh-tw.editorNote: 剪完頭走出店門那一刻發，或給任何一個因為太熱而衝動剪短的人
variations: 夏天剪短的人裡面，有一半是為了涼快，另外一半是看過帳單。
每年八月，設計師都會遇到一批客人，把「剪短一點」講得像在做財務決定。

en.content:
"How short are we going this time?"
"Short enough that it dries without a blow dryer."
"You said that last time and it ended up at your shoulders."
"Last time the power bill hadn't shown up yet."
"So the bill is picking your haircut now."
"It picks plenty. What the AC is set to, which speed the fan runs on, and now my bangs—"
en.editorNote: Post it walking out of the salon, or send it to anyone who cut it all off because of the heat
variations: Half the people going short this summer want to feel cooler. The other half opened a bill.
Every August a stylist meets a wave of clients who say 'take it shorter' the way you'd announce a financial decision.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday 寵物雲：獸醫建議夏天寵物室溫維持 26 度左右，溫差過大易造成慢性中暑

zh-tw.content:
不鏽鋼的診療台冰冰涼涼，牠一放上去就整隻趴平，連尾巴都懶得動。
醫師說牠十二歲了，心臟沒有以前有力，白天室內最好穩定在二十六度左右，別讓牠自己硬撐。
五年前我出門一定隨手把冷氣按掉，那時我心裡算的是一小時幾塊錢。
現在我踏出家門以前做的最後一件事，是把遙控器設成整天不停，再蹲下去跟牠說我很快回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享給家裡有老貓老狗的朋友——夏天帳單會變厚，但這一筆沒有人會後悔。
variations: 以前是牠陪我省電，現在換我陪牠花電。
帳單上多出來的那幾百塊，換算過來就是牠十二歲這年的室溫。

en.content:
The stainless steel exam table is cold, and she flattens herself onto it the second I set her down — she doesn't even bother wagging.
The vet says she's twelve now, her heart isn't what it used to be, and the room she spends the day in should hold steady around 79°F instead of making her tough it out.
Five years ago I never left the house without killing the AC, because what I was doing in my head was counting dollars per hour.
Now the last thing I do before I leave is set the remote to run all day, then crouch down and tell her I'll be right back.
en.editorNote: For friends with an aging cat or dog — the summer bill gets heavier, and nobody regrets this particular line item.
variations: She used to help me save power. Now I spend it on her.
That extra hundred bucks on the bill converts neatly into the room temperature of her twelfth summer.

items.sourceNote: 遠見雜誌：2026 夏季電價計算攻略，說明營業與住宅費率差異

zh-tw.content:
一百塊三十個圈，我從十點丟到十點半，一個都沒中。
攤子上頭那排燈亮得像白天，塑膠圈碰到瓶口又彈開的聲音，我大概聽了六十次。
有個阿姨拉著小孩經過，隨口說：這麼亮，他每個月電費一定很可怕。
老闆眼睛還盯著那排玻璃瓶，接了一句：不亮就沒有人會停下來，燈錢我早就算在圈子裡了。
我低頭看手裡剩下的四個圈，忽然明白這一百塊有一半是幫那排燈付的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在夜市玩到懷疑人生的時候可以拿出來說——你買的從來就不只是那罐飲料。
variations: 那排燈每晚亮五個小時，比我套中的獎品貴多了。
夜市最穩定的收入來源，是站在攤子外面捨不得走的我們。

en.content:
A hundred bucks buys thirty rings, and from ten to ten-thirty I didn't land a single one.
The strip of bulbs over the stall was bright as noon, and I heard plastic clip a bottle neck and bounce away maybe sixty times.
A woman pulling her kid past said, offhand, that a stall this bright must run a monstrous power bill.
The owner kept his eyes on the bottles and said dark stalls don't get anyone to slow down, so the lighting is already priced into every ring.
I looked at the four rings left in my hand and realized half of that hundred had gone to keeping those bulbs on.
en.editorNote: For the moment at a night market when you've spent way too much — you were never only paying for the prize.
variations: Those bulbs burn five hours a night. They cost more than anything I could have won.
The steadiest income at a night market comes from the people standing outside who can't walk away.

items.sourceNote: 農業部：農業動力用電申請及節能設施輔導現況，含灌溉抽水用電戶統計

zh-tw.content:
阿公，你那台抽水馬達我沒有拆，還接在田邊那根電線桿上。
七月最旱的那十天，我等天亮才去開它，一個月後看到電表上的數字，愣了很久。
後來我才懂，你四點半就騎車出門，算的不只是水什麼時候到得了田尾，還有那幾度電當時值多少錢。
昨天傍晚我走過那條產業道路，遠遠聽見馬達在嗡嗡響，就對著空氣說：這次我有記得早點來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫給家裡那個已經不在、卻教會你看電表的長輩。
variations: 你留下的其實是一個習慣——趁天還沒熱起來，把一天的事先做完。
田裡的水要有人去放，電表上的數字也是有人去換的。

en.content:
Grandpa, I never pulled out your water pump. It's still wired to the pole at the edge of the field.
During those ten bone-dry days in July I waited until sunrise to switch it on, and a month later the meter reading left me standing there for a while.
That's when I finally understood why you rode out at four-thirty every morning — you weren't only counting how long the water took to reach the far end.
Walking that farm road last evening I heard the pump humming somewhere out there, and I said out loud that this time I remembered to come early.
en.editorNote: For the relative who's gone but taught you how to read a meter.
variations: What you left me was a habit: get the day's work done while it's still cool.
Someone has to open the water, and someone has to pay for the current that moves it.

items.sourceNote: 早安樂活：夏季電費月份、時段與省電懶人包

zh-tw.content:
這個夏天我少繳的八百塊電費，一個晚上就全部還了回去。
往回推四個小時：凌晨兩點我被熱醒，乾脆把冷氣關掉下樓走一走，出門順手把門帶上。
再往回推一天：我跟自己約定八月每晚只吹到十二點，說這樣兩個月能少個幾百塊。
再往回推三個月：六月初的第一張帳單寄到，我看完把它貼在冰箱門上當提醒。
師傅開著小貨車來，工具伸進鎖孔十分鐘就開了，收我八百，還說這個時間出門已經算給我便宜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在做完一件很省的事、結果多花更多錢之後自嘲。
variations: 我這個夏天最貴的一度電，是我沒有用掉的那一度。
省電計畫通常不會敗在冷氣，會敗在門。

en.content:
The eight hundred I'd saved on electricity this summer went back out the door in a single night.
Rewind four hours: at two in the morning the heat woke me, so I shut the AC off, headed downstairs for a walk, and let the door swing closed behind me.
Rewind one day: I'd promised myself that for the rest of August the AC goes off at midnight, which was supposed to save a few hundred over the billing cycle.
Rewind three months: the first bill of June showed up and I taped it to the fridge as a reminder.
The locksmith pulled up in a little truck, had the cylinder open in ten minutes, charged me eight hundred, and said that was already a discount for the hour.
en.editorNote: For the aftermath of a very frugal decision that ended up costing more.
variations: The most expensive unit of power I bought this summer was the one I never used.
A power-saving plan rarely fails at the thermostat. It fails at the door.

items.sourceNote: 自由時報：物流中心設酷涼專區、增建空調降低高溫熱危害

zh-tw.content:
倉庫棧板區公告
這次要敲掉重做的，是我講了三年的那句「我很耐熱」。
施工期間：即日起到九月底，等夏季電費結束再驗收。
施工方式：每天在四十度的貨架之間搬完兩百箱，晚上回家不敢碰遙控器。
可能造成的不便：本人講話變少、笑點變低、看到冰塊會發呆。
本工程沒有經費也沒有承包商，造成不便敬請見諒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合上班環境本來就很熱、回家卻還要為了電費硬撐的人，用來自嘲兼求救。
variations: 我在四十度的地方工作，回家吹二十八度，所以我全年都在適應期。
耐熱這項技能，發證單位是台電，有效期限到夏季電費結束為止。

en.content:
NOTICE — pallet zone, aisle three
Work in progress: demolition of the sentence "I'm fine with heat," which I have been repeating for three years.
Duration: from today until the end of September, when the summer rate finally lets go.
Method: two hundred boxes a day between racks at forty degrees, then no touching the remote once I'm home.
Expected disruption: I talk less, laugh at worse jokes, and stare at ice.
There is no budget and no contractor for this job. We apologise for the inconvenience.
en.editorNote: For people whose workplace is already an oven and who still ration the AC at home to keep the bill down.
variations: I work at forty degrees and cool down to twenty-eight, so I am acclimatising all year round.
Heat tolerance: certificate issued by the power company, valid until the summer rate expires.

items.sourceNote: 遠見雜誌：2026 夏季電價計算、級距與省電建議

zh-tw.content:
致三號倉庫全體同仁，門口那張紙我再補一段說明。
工程名稱：把冷氣從「奢侈品」重新歸類成「耗材」。
動工原因：夏季電費一來，我家那台就從二十四度往上退到二十八度。
影響範圍：搬貨的時候我會一直盯著棧板上的收縮膜，因為它看起來比我涼。
預計完工：等我的薪水追上台電的漲幅。
工地就是我本人，造成不便請多包涵。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在公司群組或閒聊時丟出來，講夏天為了省電被迫調高溫度的心情。
variations: 冷氣在我家的財產清冊上，今年從必需品那一欄，改填到偶爾才捨得動用的耗材。
溫度往上調兩度很簡單，難的是說服自己這叫節能不叫忍耐。

en.content:
To everyone on the third-warehouse shift: one more line for the sign by the door.
Project title: reclassifying air conditioning from a luxury to a consumable.
Reason for works: summer rates arrived, so the unit at home retreated from twenty-four degrees to twenty-eight.
Affected area: I now stare at the shrink wrap on the pallets, because it looks cooler than I feel.
Completion: whenever my pay catches up with the utility's price rises.
The site is me. Thank you for your patience.
en.editorNote: For a work chat when someone brings up how high they've had to set the thermostat this summer.
variations: On the household inventory, air conditioning moved out of the essentials column this year and into occasional consumables.
Raising the setting by two degrees is easy. Calling it efficiency instead of endurance is the hard part.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報：2026 夏季電費上路、電價表與台電節電獎勵整理

zh-tw.content:
我把一張紙折成小方塊，塞進冷氣遙控器的電池蓋裡。
本區施工項目：屋主的忍耐度，全面翻新。
開工時間：每晚十一點，鬧鐘一響就停止送風。
施工影響：夜裡會有翻身聲、嘆氣聲，還有自己跟自己吵架的聲音。
工程效益：一個月大概省四百塊，換來六十個小時的清醒。
本案由屋主自行發包、自行監工、自行後悔，不便之處請自行體會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合設了定時關冷氣、結果每晚被熱醒的人，在半夜清醒時發出來。
variations: 定時關機那顆鍵，按下去的是省電，醒過來的是後悔。
本月結算：省下四百塊，從我原本可以睡著的那幾個鐘頭裡扣。

en.content:
I folded a note into a small square and slid it under the battery cover of the remote.
Works to be carried out: full refurbishment of the owner's tolerance.
Start time: eleven every night, when the timer cuts the airflow.
Expected disturbance: turning over, sighing, and one person arguing with himself in the dark.
Projected benefit: roughly four hundred saved a month, in exchange for sixty hours of being awake.
The owner is acting as client, supervisor and regretter. Please work out the inconvenience for yourself.
en.editorNote: To post at 3am when the sleep timer you set to save money has woken you up again.
variations: Pressing the sleep timer saves power. Waking up two hours later spends everything you saved.
Statement for the month: four hundred saved, deducted from the hours I could have slept through.

items.sourceNote: 商周：2026 夏季電價怎麼算、冷氣建議設定 26～28 度搭配電扇

zh-tw.content:
施工告示（家庭版，貼在客廳落地窗上）
這次動工的是：一家四口對於「幾度才算涼」的共識。
工期：從六月那張帳單寄到那天算起，做到天氣自己認輸為止。
施工方式：白天靠一台立扇輪流吹，晚上靠意志力硬撐。
會造成的不便：情緒可能斷斷續續，講話可能突然沒電。
本工程沒有編列預算，也不接受抗議，路過的家人請小心通行。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合全家人為了冷氣溫度吵不出結論的夏天，用來緩和氣氛。
variations: 冷氣溫度是我家唯一沒有共識、卻天天要表決的議題。
本戶最難施作的一項，是把四個人對「涼」的定義接到同一條線路上。

en.content:
NOTICE OF WORKS (household edition, taped to the living-room window)
Under construction: a family of four agreeing on what counts as cool.
Schedule: from the day the June bill landed until the weather concedes.
Method: one standing fan taking turns on us by day, willpower by night.
Expected disruption: moods may cut in and out, sentences may lose power halfway.
No budget was allocated and no objections will be heard. Family members, please pass with care.
en.editorNote: For a summer where nobody at home can agree on the thermostat and the argument restarts every evening.
variations: The thermostat is the only issue in this house with no consensus and a daily vote.
Hardest item on this site: wiring four people's definitions of "cool" into a single circuit.

items.sourceNote: 維基百科：風鈴條目，記載風鈴在夏季被用來以聲音帶來涼意的用法

zh-tw.content:
我在客廳窗框上釘了一根釘子，把去年在老街買的那串風鈴掛上去。
電風扇擺在斜對角，轉到二段，風剛好夠它一直響。
那個聲音在的時候，我可以把冷氣往後拖四十分鐘，一個晚上省下大概一度半。
我太太問我在忙什麼，我說我在調整室內的體感溫度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友問你「你家怎麼還沒開冷氣」的時候，用來說明自己那套沒什麼科學根據的省電流程。
variations: 短版：釘子一根、風鈴一串、電扇二段，這是我家夏天最便宜的降溫設備。
延伸版：那串風鈴的功能是讓我相信現在還沒熱到要花錢，功效大約可以維持四十分鐘。

en.content:
I hammered a nail into the living room window frame and hung up the wind chimes I bought on an old street last year.
The electric fan sits diagonally across the room on setting two, which is just enough breeze to keep them going.
As long as that sound is in the air I can hold off on the AC for another forty minutes, which works out to about one and a half units a night.
My wife asked what I was doing and I told her I was adjusting the perceived temperature indoors.
en.editorNote: For when someone asks why your AC still isn't on and you want to explain your entirely unscientific cooling routine.
variations: Short: one nail, one string of chimes, one fan on medium. Cheapest cooling equipment in the house.
Extended: the chimes exist to convince me it isn't hot enough to spend money yet, and the effect lasts roughly forty minutes.

items.sourceNote: 潔客幫：2026 夏季用電計算與冷氣設定溫度建議

zh-tw.content:
冷氣出風口底下我用釣魚線垂了一小串風鈴，長度抓十五公分，剛好落在葉片掃得到的地方。
設定二十八度以後，人其實感覺不出來機器有沒有在運轉，那串鈴會替我確認。
它響，代表錢正在流；它安靜，代表壓縮機休息，我也可以跟著鬆一口氣。
朋友來吃飯抬頭看了一眼，我說那是儀表板。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合冷氣調到二十八度以後懷疑自己買到壞機器、又捨不得調低的人。
variations: 短版：二十八度的冷氣感覺不到，所以我在出風口掛了一個會替我報告的東西。
延伸版：那串鈴不會降溫，它只負責告訴我這一刻的電費花得值不值得。

en.content:
I hung a tiny string of chimes under the AC vent on fishing line, fifteen centimeters down, right where the louvers can reach them.
Once you set the thing to twenty-eight degrees you honestly cannot feel whether it is running, so the chimes confirm it for me.
Ringing means money is moving; silence means the compressor is resting and so can I.
A friend came for dinner, looked up at it, and I told him it was the dashboard.
en.editorNote: For anyone who sets the AC to twenty-eight, suspects the unit is broken, and still refuses to turn it down.
variations: Short: at twenty-eight degrees you can't feel the AC, so I installed something at the vent to report back to me.
Extended: the chimes don't cool anything. They just tell me whether this particular minute of electricity was worth it.

items.sourceNote: NOWnews：2026 節電獎勵登錄步驟與獎勵規則整理，每節省一度回饋 0.6 元

zh-tw.content:
手機備忘錄裡我列了一條巡邏路線，二十七個插頭，從電視底下那一組開始，繞一圈回到房間。
睡前走完要八分多鐘，蹲下再起身的次數比我做過的任何運動都多。
這個月結算下來，待機的電省了五十六塊。
我還是每天照走，因為現在不走一遍我會睡不著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合為了省一點點錢、卻養成一堆奇怪儀式的人，用來自嘲兼炫耀。
variations: 短版：二十七個插頭，八分鐘，一個月五十六塊，我算過了，時薪很難看。
延伸版：一開始是為了省電，後來變成不做就睡不著，中間那個轉折我自己也沒發現。

en.content:
There is a patrol route in my phone's notes app: twenty-seven plugs, starting with the cluster under the TV and looping back to the bedroom.
Doing the round before bed takes just over eight minutes, and involves more squatting than any exercise I have ever kept up.
This month it saved fifty-six dollars of standby power.
I still walk it every night, because at this point I can't fall asleep if I skip it.
en.editorNote: For people who built an elaborate ritual around saving a very small amount of money, and are quietly proud of it.
variations: Short: twenty-seven plugs, eight minutes, fifty-six dollars a month. I worked out the hourly rate and I'd rather not say it.
Extended: it started as a way to save power and became something I can't sleep without. I never noticed the moment it changed.

items.sourceNote: 四季線上：台電提醒洗冷氣濾網的錯誤行為與夏季耗電要點

zh-tw.content:
色鉛筆畫的那張圖我特地拿去護貝，現在貼在電閘的鐵蓋上。
冷氣、烤箱、除濕機各佔一個顏色，兩兩之間畫叉叉，標明誰跟誰不能同時工作。
八月到今天跳了三次，每一次我都先站在那裡看圖，再伸手把保險絲那排扳回去。
我媽說這種事用記的就好，我說用記的那些，都會在最熱的那天失效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡夏天常跳電、又被家人笑說小題大作的時候發出來。
variations: 短版：我家的電器關係圖有護貝，因為它比我的記憶可靠。
延伸版：三次之後我學會的事情是，最熱的那天你會忘記所有你以為記得住的規則。

en.content:
I had the colored-pencil chart laminated, and now it lives on the metal cover of the breaker box.
The AC, the oven and the dehumidifier each get a color, with an X drawn between any two that can't run at the same time.
The breaker has tripped three times since August began, and every time I stand there reading the chart before I reach up and flip the switch back.
My mother says I should just remember it, and I told her the things I remember all stop working on the hottest day.
en.editorNote: For a household where the breaker trips every summer and your family thinks your countermeasures are excessive.
variations: Short: the appliance chart is laminated because it is more reliable than my memory.
Extended: what three trips taught me is that on the hottest day of the year you forget every rule you were sure you knew.

items.sourceNote: 王牌氣密窗：玻璃結露起霧成因（室內外溫差與濕度）

zh-tw.content:
你把喝到一半的冰水擱在筆電旁邊，杯身外面開始起霧，水珠繞著杯底積成一小圈。
你抽了一張紙巾墊在杯子下面，順手把遙控器撈過來，從二十四按到二十六。
按完你沒有放下遙控器，就坐在原地看那杯水，霧氣退到剩下半截。
你喝掉剩下的，杯子拿去沖乾淨，走回位子的時候，溫度還是二十六。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在辦公桌前跟自己拉鋸冷氣溫度的下午發出來。
variations: 短版：你看著杯子外面起霧，一直到桌上多出一圈水痕。
延伸版：那杯水退霧要十分鐘，你把冷氣從二十四調到二十六，也用掉差不多的時間。

en.content:
You set the half-finished glass of ice water beside your laptop, the outside of it starts to fog, and beads gather into a small ring under the base.
You pull a napkin loose and slide it under the glass, then reach for the remote and move it from 24 up to 26.
After pressing it you don't put the remote down; you sit there watching the glass while the fog drops to half its height.
You drink what's left, rinse the glass, and by the time you walk back to your seat it still reads 26.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you spend negotiating with yourself over the thermostat at your desk.
variations: Short: you watch the glass fog over until there is a ring of water on the desk.
Extended: the fog took ten minutes to clear, and moving the AC from 24 to 26 took about the same.

items.sourceNote: TVBS：夏天進出冷氣房、室內外溫差引發的不適與建議溫差範圍

zh-tw.content:
你戴著眼鏡從有冷氣的辦公室走出去，鏡片在三秒之內整片起霧，你先停下來不動。
你把眼鏡摘下來夾在領口，眯著眼往機車那邊走，鑰匙插了兩次才對準。
等鏡片自己退乾淨的那段時間，你在心裡把這個月吹了幾天冷氣算了一遍。
戴回去以後，路口的號誌已經換過一輪。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合下班走出冷氣房、被熱氣糊了一臉的那一刻發出來。
variations: 短版：鏡片起霧的那幾秒，你站在原地什麼也沒看見。
延伸版：你算出來的天數比你以為的多，鏡片剛好在這時候退乾淨。

en.content:
You walk out of the air-conditioned office with your glasses on, the lenses fog over completely within three seconds, and you stop where you are.
You take the glasses off and hook them on your collar, squint your way toward the scooter, and miss the ignition twice before the key goes in.
While the lenses clear on their own, you count up how many days you ran the AC this month.
By the time you put them back on, the light at the corner has already cycled once.
en.editorNote: For the moment you step out of the cold office and the heat smears itself across your face.
variations: Short: for those few seconds of fog, you stand there seeing nothing at all.
Extended: the number you counted was higher than you thought, and the lenses cleared right about then.

items.sourceNote: TVBS：夏季電費計算與除濕模式耗電討論

zh-tw.content:
你把那張電費單對折兩次才放回信封，數字那一面朝內。
你打開手機查除濕模式，看到有人說除濕跑起來比冷氣還吃電，你截圖存進相簿。
回到客廳，靠冷氣那一側的窗玻璃正在起霧，你按掉遙控器上的水滴，換成雪花。
睡前你又走過去看了一次，圖示還是雪花。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛拆完帳單、開始懷疑自己每個省電習慣的晚上。
variations: 短版：你把水滴按成雪花，然後又走回去看一次。
延伸版：你存了那張截圖，隔天又滑到它，還是只按了雪花那一顆。

en.content:
You fold the bill in half twice before it goes back in the envelope, numbers facing inward.
You look up dehumidify mode on your phone, find people saying it burns more power than cooling does, and screenshot it into your album.
Back in the living room the window on the AC side is fogging up, and you tap the water drop on the remote off and switch it to the snowflake.
Before bed you walk over and check once more, and the icon is still the snowflake.
en.editorNote: For the night you open the bill and start doubting every power-saving habit you have.
variations: Short: you switch the water drop to the snowflake, then walk back to check it again.
Extended: you kept that screenshot, scrolled past it the next day, and still pressed only the snowflake.

items.sourceNote: 遠見：夏季電價計算方式、離峰時段與冷氣溫度建議

zh-tw.content:
你蹲在電表前，用手機把那排數字拍下來，日期記在記事本的第一行。
隔天同一個時段你再拍一張，兩張照片擺在一起相減，得到一個四位數。
你把那個四位數乘上三塊多，念出聲的時候把音量壓得很低。
念完你走回房間，把冷氣的定時從八小時改成六小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開始自己抄電表、想在帳單來之前先知道結果的人。
variations: 短版：你拍了兩天的電表，得到一個你不太想念出來的四位數。
延伸版：你把定時從八小時改成六小時，隔天早上五點半醒過來，沒有再按回去。

en.content:
You crouch in front of the meter, photograph that row of digits with your phone, and write the date on the first line of your notes.
The next day at the same hour you take another shot, line the two photos up, subtract, and land on a four-digit number.
You multiply that number by a little over three, and when you say it out loud you keep the volume down.
Then you walk back to your room and change the AC timer from eight hours to six.
en.editorNote: For anyone reading their own meter to find out the damage before the bill arrives.
variations: Short: two days of meter photos gave you a four-digit number you would rather not say out loud.
Extended: you moved the timer from eight hours to six, woke up at five thirty the next morning, and did not set it back.

items.sourceNote: 經濟部能源署油價資訊系統：95無鉛等汽柴油參考零售價

zh-tw.content:
兩公升的九五無鉛，加完剛好三十九塊，我把發票折進安全帽裡。
油槍離開油箱口，汽油味整個貼上來，我沒有退開。
騎回家的路上我算了一下，這兩公升跑的距離，跟客廳那台冷氣吹掉的一個晚上差不多錢。
進門先開冷氣，安全帽擱在鞋櫃上，那股汽油味在玄關留了半小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合夏天騎車通勤、把每一筆小錢都換算成冷氣時數的人。
variations: 短版：兩公升三十九塊，汽油味留在玄關比涼意留得久。
延伸版：那兩公升我騎了四天，冷氣那個晚上只撐了七個小時。

en.content:
Two liters of ninety-five octane, thirty-nine dollars on the nose, and I fold the receipt into my helmet.
The nozzle leaves the tank, the smell of gasoline climbs right onto me, and I do not step back.
Riding home I run the numbers: what those two liters cover costs about the same as one night of the living room AC.
I turn the AC on before anything else, park the helmet on the shoe cabinet, and the gasoline smell hangs in the entryway for half an hour.
en.editorNote: For summer commuters who convert every small expense into hours of air conditioning.
variations: Short: two liters for thirty-nine dollars, and the gasoline smell outlasts the cool.
Extended: those two liters lasted me four days; that night of AC lasted seven hours.

items.sourceNote: 商周：2026 夏季電價計算、住宅平均月用電量與冷氣溫度建議

zh-tw.content:
四百一十八度，是新聞說夏天一戶人家平均會用掉的電。
我把自己上一期的數字翻出來對，多了六十幾度，那六十幾度全長在客廳那面牆上。
我媽聽完只問一句，那你是要吹到幾點。
我沒回答，起身把風速從強按到中，再按一次變成自動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看完平均用電量新聞、發現自己是那個把平均拉高的人時使用。
variations: 短版：平均四百一十八度，我多的那六十幾度全長在同一面牆上。
延伸版：我把風速按成自動，然後盯著那顆燈看了很久才回房間。

en.content:
Four hundred eighteen units is what the news says an average household burns through in a summer month.
I dig out my own figure from last cycle, sixty-some units higher, and all sixty-some of them grew on that one living room wall.
My mom hears it and asks exactly one thing: so how late are you planning to run it.
I do not answer, I get up and push the fan speed from high to medium, then press again and land on auto.
en.editorNote: For the moment you read the average household usage figure and realize you are what pulled the average up.
variations: Short: the average is four hundred eighteen; my extra sixty-some all grew on the same wall.
Extended: I set the fan to auto, stared at that little light for a while, and only then went back to my room.

items.sourceNote: 自由時報：交通部機車使用狀況調查，燃油與電動機車養車費用比較

zh-tw.content:
五次，是師傅發動我那台機車、它才肯出聲的次數。
引擎終於醒過來，整間店都是汽油味，混著他背後那台工業電扇吹出來的熱風。
他說夏天車跟人一樣，放著曬一整天就不想動。
我牽車出去，回家第一件事是開冷氣，然後坐在原地等它變冷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合送修完騎回家、發現自己也需要被吹涼一下的那種下午。
variations: 短版：五次才發動，汽油味比涼氣先到我身上。
延伸版：師傅那台工業電扇整個夏天沒關過，他說關了車比較難修。

en.content:
Five is how many tries it took the mechanic before my scooter would make a sound.
The engine finally woke up, the whole shop smelled of gasoline, mixed into the hot air off the big industrial fan behind him.
He said bikes are like people in summer: leave them baking all day and they do not want to move.
I wheeled it out, and the first thing I did at home was turn on the AC and sit there waiting for it to get cold.
en.editorNote: For the kind of afternoon when you pick up the bike and realize you could use some cooling down yourself.
variations: Short: five tries to start it, and the gasoline smell reached me before any cool air did.
Extended: that industrial fan of his has not been switched off all summer; he says bikes are harder to fix without it.

items.sourceNote: 早安樂活：夏季電費一度多少錢、夏季時段與省電做法整理

zh-tw.content:
十七公分，是我把電扇搬到離床頭最近的位置以後量到的距離。
這樣就不用開冷氣了，我這樣跟自己說了三個晚上。
第四個晚上兩點多醒過來，電扇還在轉，枕頭那一面已經是熱的。
我伸手去拿遙控器，按下去之前先把上個月那張單子的數字除以三十。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合每年都想靠電扇撐過去、然後每年都失敗的那幾天。
variations: 短版：十七公分換來三個晚上，第四個晚上我還是伸手去拿遙控器。
延伸版：除以三十以後那個數字小到有點好笑，我就按下去了。

en.content:
Seventeen centimeters is the distance I measured after dragging the fan as close to the head of the bed as it would go.
This way I will not need the AC, I told myself for three nights running.
On the fourth night I woke a little after two, the fan still turning, that side of the pillow already warm.
I reached for the remote, and before pressing it I divided last month's bill figure by thirty.
en.editorNote: For the few nights every year when you try to get by on a fan and fail the same way you did last year.
variations: Short: seventeen centimeters bought me three nights; on the fourth I reached for the remote anyway.
Extended: divided by thirty the number looked almost funny, so I pressed the button.

items.sourceNote: 商周：2026 夏季電價怎麼計算、冷氣設幾度最省的整理報導

zh-tw.content:
被護貝膜包住的第三個夏天，我的邊角捲了，膜還是平的。
我身上寫的二十六度，被人用指甲點到起毛，那一格摸起來最厚。
有人拿筆在我旁邊補了一行小字，寫完又用手掌抹，抹不掉。
今天冷氣先開了半小時，才有人走過來把我壓回牆上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種規則貼了很久、大家都看得到、卻沒有人真的照做的辦公室。
variations: 短版：那一格被指甲點到起毛，摸起來比別的地方厚。
延伸版：冷氣先開了半小時，才有人想起牆上還有我這一張。

en.content:
This is my third summer inside the laminate; my corners have curled and the film has not.
The twenty-six degrees written on me has been picked at by fingernails until the spot went fuzzy, and that patch is the thickest part of the sheet.
Someone added a line of small handwriting beside me, then rubbed at it with a palm, and it would not come off.
Today the AC ran for half an hour before anyone walked over and pressed me back onto the wall.
en.editorNote: For the office where the rule has been up for years, everyone can see it, and nobody actually follows it.
variations: Short: fingernails wore that one spot fuzzy, and it is thicker there than anywhere else.
Extended: the AC ran half an hour before anyone remembered the sheet still on the wall.

items.sourceNote: udn 科技玩家：台電說明夏月電價與冷氣濾網清洗等省電做法

zh-tw.content:
六月到現在，他們掀開我兩次，中間隔了七十幾天。
抱去水槽那次沖到水變灰才停，回來時機身側邊那張護貝膜上的日期被人改掉了。
另一次只用面紙沿著我的邊緣抹一圈，抹完就闔起來，燈也亮了。
風從我身上過去的聲音，現在比六月低，他們說是外面太熱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫給那台已經很努力、只是沒人記得幫它洗一下的冷氣。
variations: 短版：沖到水變灰才停，那是他們今年唯一認真的一次。
延伸版：日期被改掉以後，我身上的灰還在，只是沒人再提。

en.content:
Since June they have opened me up twice, with seventy-odd days in between.
The time I was carried to the sink they rinsed me until the water ran gray, and when I came back the date on the laminated card on the side panel had been changed.
The other time a tissue went once around my edge, then I was shut again and the light came on.
The sound of air passing through me is lower now than it was in June, and they say it is because of the heat outside.
en.editorNote: For the air conditioner that is trying hard and that nobody remembers to clean.
variations: Short: rinsed until the water ran gray, which was their one serious attempt this year.
Extended: the date got changed, the dust on me stayed, and nobody brought it up again.

items.sourceNote: 遠見雜誌：夏季電價算法與冷氣設定溫度建議

zh-tw.content:
我掉進沙發縫裡兩天，沒人找。
第三天有人翻遍座墊，抓到我先連按三下，我身上溫度那一排的字早就磨白了。
他們晚餐後設二十七度，睡前又改成二十八度，改回去的時候手指壓得比較用力。
背後的電池蓋鬆了，整夜被壓在手臂下面，我照樣會亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合每晚都在兩度之間來回、最後誰也沒省到的那種夏夜。
variations: 短版：溫度那一排的字磨白了，按的人還是每晚都按。
延伸版：電池蓋鬆歸鬆，整夜被壓著，我照樣亮。

en.content:
I spent two days down the gap in the couch and nobody looked.
On the third day someone dug through the cushions, grabbed me, and pressed three times in a row; the numbers along my temperature row had long since worn white.
After dinner they set twenty-seven, before bed they changed it to twenty-eight, and the finger pushed harder on the way back down.
The battery cover on my back is loose, I stayed pinned under an arm all night, and I still lit up.
en.editorNote: For the summer nights spent going back and forth between two degrees and saving nothing.
variations: Short: the numbers on that row wore white, and the same finger keeps pressing them.
Extended: loose cover, pinned under an arm all night, and I still lit up.

items.sourceNote: 工商時報：2026 夏季電費上路，電價表與省電、節電獎勵整理

zh-tw.content:
我朝西的那一面，三點以後就開始燙。
他們把我拉滿，中間那道縫用長尾夾夾起來，房間立刻暗得像傍晚。
冷氣的風打在我身上，我鼓起來又落下，一分鐘大概八次。
天黑很久才有人把我拉開，外面的空氣那時已經比屋裡涼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給西曬那一面的房間，以及在那裡撐到天黑才敢開窗的人。
variations: 短版：鼓起來又落下，一分鐘大概八次，冷氣就是這樣算錢的。
延伸版：天黑很久才被拉開，外面的空氣已經比屋裡涼。

en.content:
The side of me that faces west starts to run hot after three.
They pull me shut and clip the middle gap with a binder clip, and the room goes dim as early evening.
The air from the AC hits me and I billow and fall back, about eight times a minute.
It was dark a long while before anyone pulled me open, and by then the air outside was cooler than the air in the room.
en.editorNote: For west-facing rooms, and for whoever waits there until dark before daring to open a window.
variations: Short: billowing and falling back, about eight times a minute, is what the meter is counting.
Extended: pulled open long after dark, when outside had already turned cooler than in.

items.sourceNote: 中時新聞網：冷氣搭循環扇，台電建議關掉擺頭、以約 45 度仰角朝室內深處吹

zh-tw.content:
我把量角器從國小的鉛筆盒翻出來，中心那個小洞對準循環扇的轉軸。
量角器貼著扇殼，我把扇頭往上抬，抬到刻度停在四十五，手指按住不放。
退開三步，蹲低，再回來看一次，偏了兩度，我又推回去。
這個動作我做了七次，冷氣還沒開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把省電這件事做到很細、但帳單還沒來的那幾天。
variations: 短版：量角器停在四十五，手指按住不放，冷氣還沒開。
延伸版：退開三步再回來看一次，偏兩度就再推一次，做了七次。

en.content:
I dug the protractor out of my grade-school pencil case and set the little hole at its center on the circulation fan's hub.
Holding it flat against the shell, I tipped the head upward until the mark stopped at forty-five, and kept my finger pressed there.
Three steps back, down low, then back for another look; it had drifted two degrees, so I nudged it over.
I ran through that seven times before the AC was ever switched on.
en.editorNote: For the few days when you are doing the saving very precisely and the bill has not arrived yet.
variations: Short: the protractor stopped at forty-five, my finger stayed on it, and the AC was still off.
Extended: three steps back, another look, two degrees off, another nudge — seven rounds of that.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday 房產雲：台電說明循環扇擺放位置與 45 度仰角，冷氣調高 1 度約省 6% 電

zh-tw.content:
站上那張塑膠椅，左手扶著牆，右手把量角器貼上冷氣的出風葉片。
葉片原本朝下十五度，我一下一下往上撥，撥到零那條線和葉片重疊。
椅腳在磁磚上滑了半公分，我停了大概五秒，才把手放回葉片邊緣。
下來以後又上去量一次，兩次的讀數差三度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給那種為了幾度角願意爬上爬下、卻沒跟任何人提起的夏天。
variations: 短版：葉片從朝下十五度撥到零，椅腳在磁磚上滑了半公分。
延伸版：下來量一次，上去再量一次，兩次差三度。

en.content:
Up on the plastic chair, left hand braced on the wall, right hand laying the protractor against the AC's louver.
The louver sat fifteen degrees below level; I flicked it up a notch at a time until the zero line and the blade lay over each other.
A chair leg slid half a centimeter on the tile, and about five seconds passed before my hand went back to the edge of the blade.
I measured once on the way down, climbed back up, and measured again — three degrees apart.
en.editorNote: For the summer you spend climbing up and down over a few degrees and mention to nobody.
variations: Short: the louver went from fifteen down to level, and a chair leg slid half a centimeter on the tile.
Extended: measured on the way down, measured again on the way up, three degrees apart.

items.sourceNote: 發票怪獸：變頻冷氣省電迷思整理，含濾網清潔與 2026 夏季累進電價級距

zh-tw.content:
濾網拆下來的時候，灰是整片的，像一層薄毯。
水龍頭開到最小，舊牙刷順著同一個方向刷，刷了大概四十下，水才變清。
甩乾晾著，我去看了三趟，每趟都用手背貼一下確認乾了沒。
裝回去卡榫沒對上，拔出來重裝，第三下才進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種每年只做一次、做完也不會跟人講的夏日例行事。
variations: 短版：舊牙刷順著同一個方向刷四十下，水才變清。
延伸版：卡榫沒對上就拔出來重裝，第三下才進去。

en.content:
The filter came out with the dust in one piece, like a thin blanket.
Tap barely open, an old toothbrush going one direction, maybe forty strokes, before the water ran clear.
Shaken off and hung up, checked three times, the back of my hand touching it each time to see whether it had dried.
The clip missed the slot going back in, out it came, and the third try seated it.
en.editorNote: For the yearly summer chore you do once and never bring up afterward.
variations: Short: forty strokes of an old toothbrush in one direction before the water ran clear.
Extended: the clip missed, out it came, and the third try seated it.

items.sourceNote: NOWnews：冷氣溫差設定法實測，每調低 1 度耗電約增 10%，四台冷氣三個月省 1296 元

zh-tw.content:
鞋帶綁到一半，我起身回房間，遙控器躺在床上。
按上鍵兩下，二十六變二十八，螢幕閃了一下，我把遙控器放在枕頭正中央。
走到門口又折回來，看了一眼溫度，沒有再按。
鑰匙在手上轉了兩圈，門帶上，我在外面站著數到十才走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給出門前那三十秒，明明什麼都決定好了還是回頭看一次的人。
variations: 短版：按上鍵兩下，二十六變二十八，遙控器放在枕頭正中央。
延伸版：走到門口折回來看一眼溫度，沒有再按。

en.content:
Shoelace half tied, I stood up and went back to the room, where the remote lay on the bed.
Two taps on the up arrow, twenty-six to twenty-eight, the display blinked once, and I set the remote in the middle of the pillow.
I got to the door, turned around, looked at the number, and pressed nothing else.
The keys spun twice in my hand, the door pulled to, and I stood outside counting to ten before I moved.
en.editorNote: For the thirty seconds before leaving, when everything is decided and you turn back to look anyway.
variations: Short: two taps up, twenty-six to twenty-eight, remote set in the middle of the pillow.
Extended: walked to the door, came back for one look at the number, pressed nothing.
